FILE #52: backend/prisma/schema.prisma
Dung lượng: 8,304 bytes | Tổng số dòng: 249 | Định dạng: prisma
================================================================================

````prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  CUSTOMER
  BARISTA
}

enum UserStatus {
  ACTIVE
  INACTIVE
  BANNED
}

enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  PREPARING
  READY
  COMPLETED
  PAYMENT_FAILED
  CANCELLED
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  WALLET
  CARD
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PROCESSING
  PAID
  PAYMENT_FAILED
  UNKNOWN
}

model User {
  id            String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email         String     @unique
  passwordHash  String     @map("password_hash")
  fullName      String     @map("full_name")
  phone         String?
  role          Role        @default(CUSTOMER)
  loyaltyPoints Int         @default(0) @map("loyalty_points")
  sessionVersion Int        @default(0) @map("session_version")
  status        UserStatus  @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt     DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  orders        Order[]
  cart          Cart?
  payments      Payment[]

  @@map("users")
}

model Product {
  id          String           @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name        String
  price       Int
  imageUrl    String           @map("image_url")
  stock       Int              @default(0)
  version     Int              @default(1)
  description String           @default("")
  sizes       ProductSize[]
  toppings    ProductTopping[]
  orderItems  OrderItem[]
  cartItems   CartItem[]

  @@map("products")
}

enum ProductSizeCode {
  S
  M
  L
}

model ProductSize {
  id         String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  productId  String          @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  code       ProductSizeCode
  name       String
  extraPrice Int             @map("extra_price")
  available  Boolean         @default(true)
  isDefault  Boolean         @default(false) @map("is_default")
  product    Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([productId, code])
  @@map("product_sizes")
}

model Topping {
  id                String             @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name              String
  products          ProductTopping[]
  orderItemToppings OrderItemTopping[]

  @@map("toppings")
}

model ProductTopping {
  productId  String  @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  toppingId  String  @map("topping_id") @db.Uuid
  extraPrice Int     @map("extra_price")
  available  Boolean @default(true)
  product    Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  topping    Topping @relation(fields: [toppingId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@id([productId, toppingId])
  @@index([toppingId])
  @@map("product_toppings")
}

model Order {
  id             String               @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId         String               @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  status         OrderStatus          @default(PENDING)
  version        Int                  @default(1)
  subtotal       Int
  discountAmount Int                  @default(0) @map("discount_amount")
  total          Int
  promotionCode  String?              @map("promotion_code")
  inventoryHeld  Boolean              @default(true) @map("inventory_held")
  cancelReason   String?              @map("cancel_reason") @db.VarChar(300)
  completedAt    DateTime?            @map("completed_at")
  createdAt      DateTime             @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime             @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  user           User                 @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  items          OrderItem[]
  statusHistory  OrderStatusHistory[]
  payments       Payment[]

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id        String             @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId   String             @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  productId String             @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  position  Int
  name      String
  imageUrl  String             @map("image_url")
  size      ProductSizeCode
  basePrice Int                @map("base_price")
  sizePrice Int                @map("size_price")
  unitPrice Int                @map("unit_price")
  qty       Int
  lineTotal Int                @map("line_total")
  ice       String
  sugar     String
  note      String?
  order     Order              @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product   Product            @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  toppings  OrderItemTopping[]

  @@unique([orderId, position])
  @@index([productId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model OrderItemTopping {
  orderItemId String    @map("order_item_id") @db.Uuid
  toppingId   String    @map("topping_id") @db.Uuid
  name        String
  extraPrice  Int       @map("extra_price")
  orderItem   OrderItem @relation(fields: [orderItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  topping     Topping   @relation(fields: [toppingId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@id([orderItemId, toppingId])
  @@index([toppingId])
  @@map("order_item_toppings")
}

model OrderStatusHistory {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId    String       @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  fromStatus OrderStatus? @map("from_status")
  toStatus   OrderStatus  @map("to_status")
  version    Int
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  order      Order        @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([orderId, version])
  @@map("order_status_history")
}

// Giỏ hàng lưu theo tài khoản; giá không lưu mà luôn tính lại từ Product khi đọc.
model Cart {
  id        String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String     @unique @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  user      User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items     CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

model CartItem {
  id         String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  cartId     String          @map("cart_id") @db.Uuid
  productId  String          @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  size       ProductSizeCode
  toppingIds String[]        @default([]) @map("topping_ids") @db.Uuid
  ice        String
  sugar      String
  note       String          @default("")
  // Khóa cấu hình (size|topping|đá|đường|ghi chú) để gộp các dòng trùng nhau.
  configKey  String          @map("config_key")
  quantity   Int
  createdAt  DateTime        @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime        @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  cart       Cart            @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product    Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([cartId, productId, configKey])
  @@index([productId])
  @@map("cart_items")
}

model Payment {
  id             String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId         String        @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  orderId        String        @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  amount         Int
  method         PaymentMethod
  status         PaymentStatus @default(PROCESSING)
  // Journal commits before Order settlement; null means outcome is not safely known.
  gatewayStatus  PaymentStatus? @map("gateway_status")
  appliedAt      DateTime?      @map("applied_at")
  idempotencyKey String        @map("idempotency_key") @db.Uuid
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  user           User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  order          Order         @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([userId, idempotencyKey])
  // SQL migration also owns a partial unique order_id index for live attempts.
  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("payments")
}
````

````typescript
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import type { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { sampleProducts } from './seed-products';
import { sampleCustomizations, sampleToppings, seedProductCustomization } from './seed-product-customization';

describe('Product customization development seed', () => {
  it('defines three stable UUID sizes and one available default for each known product', () => {
    const sizeIds = new Set<string>();
    expect(sampleCustomizations).toHaveLength(10);
    for (const config of sampleCustomizations) {
      expect(sampleProducts.some((product) => product.id === config.productId)).toBe(true);
      expect(config.description.trim()).not.toBe('');
      expect(config.sizes.map((size) => size.code)).toEqual(['S', 'M', 'L']);
      expect(config.sizes.filter((size) => size.isDefault && size.available)).toHaveLength(1);
      for (const size of config.sizes) {
        expect(size.productId).toBe(config.productId);
        expect(size.id).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/);
        expect(Number.isInteger(size.extraPrice) && size.extraPrice >= 0).toBe(true);
        expect(sizeIds.has(size.id)).toBe(false);
        sizeIds.add(size.id);
      }
      for (const topping of config.toppings) {
        expect(sampleToppings.some((item) => item.id === topping.toppingId)).toBe(true);
        expect(topping.productId).toBe(config.productId);
        expect(Number.isInteger(topping.extraPrice) && topping.extraPrice >= 0).toBe(true);
      }
    }
    expect(sizeIds.size).toBe(30);
    expect(sampleCustomizations[0].sizes[1].id).toBe('c075421a-1160-4e94-84d4-000000000002');
  });

  it('keeps existing size configurations and updates descriptions only when empty', async () => {
    const tx = {
      product: {
        findUnique: jest.fn<() => Promise<{ sizes: { id: string }[] }>>().mockResolvedValue({ sizes: [{ id: 'existing-size' }] }),
        updateMany: jest.fn<() => Promise<{ count: number }>>().mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 }),
      },
      productSize: { createMany: jest.fn() },
      topping: { createMany: jest.fn() },
      productTopping: { createMany: jest.fn() },
    };
    const prisma = { $transaction: async (callback: (client: typeof tx) => Promise<void>) => callback(tx) } as unknown as PrismaClient;
    await seedProductCustomization(prisma);
    expect(tx.productSize.createMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(tx.product.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(10);
    expect(tx.product.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      where: { id: sampleCustomizations[0].productId, description: '' },
      data: { description: sampleCustomizations[0].description },
    });
    expect(tx.topping.createMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ data: sampleToppings, skipDuplicates: true });
    expect(tx.productTopping.createMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ data: sampleCustomizations[0].toppings, skipDuplicates: true });
  });
});
````

import type { Prisma, PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { sampleProducts } from './seed-products';

// Development data adopted from the T4.1 example, not prices from design exports.
export const sampleToppings = [
  { id: 'b4151b67-4044-43ce-9cac-000000000001', name: 'Thêm espresso' },
  { id: 'b4151b67-4044-43ce-9cac-000000000002', name: 'Kem cheese' },
] satisfies Prisma.ToppingCreateManyInput[];

const descriptions: Record<string, string> = {
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001': 'Cà phê và sữa, phục vụ lạnh.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000002': 'Cà phê với lớp kem muối béo nhẹ.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000003': 'Trà đào kết hợp cam và sả.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000004': 'Trà với mãng cầu thơm dịu.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000005': 'Trà Oolong nướng kết hợp sữa.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000006': 'Matcha sữa với kem trứng.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000007': 'Cà phê ủ lạnh kết hợp cam.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000008': 'Trà vải hương hoa hồng.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000009': 'Cacao sữa với hạnh nhân.',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000010': 'Trà chanh tươi, phục vụ lạnh.',
};
// Explicit assignments by persistent Product ID, never guessed by product name.
const espressoProducts = new Set([
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000002',
  '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000007',
]);

export const sampleCustomizations = sampleProducts.map((product) => {
  // Fixed seed Product UUID suffix, not its array position: reordering preserves size IDs.
  const productNumber = Number(product.id.slice(-12));
  const sizes = (['S', 'M', 'L'] as const).map((code, offset) => ({
    id: `c075421a-1160-4e94-84d4-${String(productNumber * 3 - 2 + offset).padStart(12, '0')}`,
    productId: product.id,
    code,
    name: { S: 'Nhỏ (S)', M: 'Vừa (M)', L: 'Lớn (L)' }[code],
    extraPrice: { S: 0, M: 4000, L: 9000 }[code],
    available: true,
    isDefault: code === 'M',
  })) satisfies Prisma.ProductSizeCreateManyInput[];
  const toppings = sampleToppings
    .filter((topping) => topping.id === sampleToppings[1].id || espressoProducts.has(product.id))
    .map((topping) => ({
      productId: product.id,
      toppingId: topping.id,
      extraPrice: topping.id === sampleToppings[0].id ? 7000 : 6000,
      available: true,
    })) satisfies Prisma.ProductToppingCreateManyInput[];
  return { productId: product.id, description: descriptions[product.id], sizes, toppings };
});

export async function seedProductCustomization(prisma: PrismaClient): Promise<void> {
  for (const config of sampleCustomizations) {
    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const product = await tx.product.findUnique({ where: { id: config.productId }, select: { sizes: { select: { id: true } } } });
      if (!product) return;
      // Preserve edited descriptions, all current base prices/stock and existing size configurations.
      await tx.product.updateMany({ where: { id: config.productId, description: '' }, data: { description: config.description } });
      await tx.topping.createMany({ data: sampleToppings, skipDuplicates: true });
      if (product.sizes.length === 0) {
        await tx.productSize.createMany({ data: config.sizes, skipDuplicates: true });
      }
      await tx.productTopping.createMany({ data: config.toppings, skipDuplicates: true });
    });
  }
}
````

import { PrismaClient, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { sampleProducts } from './seed-products';
import { seedProductCustomization } from './seed-product-customization';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

async function provisionBarista() {
  const email = process.env.BARISTA_EMAIL?.trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = process.env.BARISTA_PASSWORD;
  if (!email && !password) return;
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') throw new Error('Không chạy seed nhân viên trong production');
  if (!email || !password || password.length < 8) throw new Error('Cần BARISTA_EMAIL và BARISTA_PASSWORD (ít nhất 8 ký tự)');
  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
  if (existing) {
    if (existing.role !== Role.BARISTA) throw new Error('Email đã thuộc về tài khoản không phải Barista');
    console.log('Tài khoản Barista đã tồn tại');
    return;
  }
  await prisma.user.create({
    data: { email, fullName: process.env.BARISTA_NAME?.trim() || 'Nhân viên pha chế', passwordHash: await bcrypt.hash(password, 10), role: Role.BARISTA },
  });
  console.log('Đã tạo tài khoản Barista');
}

async function main() {
  await provisionBarista();
  // Insert only: re-running seed must not restock products or overwrite edited prices.
  await prisma.product.createMany({ data: sampleProducts, skipDuplicates: true });
  await seedProductCustomization(prisma);
}

main()
  .catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());
````

-- Upgrade the existing users table in place; retain IDs, hashes and relationships.
DO $$ BEGIN
  CREATE TYPE "Role" AS ENUM ('CUSTOMER', 'BARISTA');
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL;
END $$;

DO $$ BEGIN
  CREATE TYPE "UserStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'BANNED');
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" (
  "id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "email" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "phone" TEXT,
  "role" "Role" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER',
  "loyalty_points" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "status" "UserStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "users_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'users' AND column_name = 'name')
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'users' AND column_name = 'full_name') THEN
    ALTER TABLE "users" RENAME COLUMN "name" TO "full_name";
  END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "phone" TEXT;
ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "role" "Role" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER';
ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "status" "UserStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "users_email_key" ON "users"("email");

ALTER TABLE "products" ADD COLUMN "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '';

CREATE TYPE "ProductSizeCode" AS ENUM ('S', 'M', 'L');

CREATE TABLE "product_sizes" (
    "id" UUID NOT NULL,
    "product_id" UUID NOT NULL,
    "code" "ProductSizeCode" NOT NULL,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "extra_price" INTEGER NOT NULL,

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "product_sizes_one_default_per_product" ON "product_sizes"("product_id") WHERE "is_default";

CREATE TABLE "toppings" (
    "id" UUID NOT NULL,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "toppings_name_nonempty" CHECK (length(btrim("name")) > 0)
);

    CONSTRAINT "product_toppings_extra_price_nonnegative" CHECK ("extra_price" >= 0),

    CONSTRAINT "product_toppings_topping_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("topping_id") REFERENCES "toppings"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

ALTER TABLE "orders"
ADD COLUMN "cancel_reason" VARCHAR(300),
ADD COLUMN "completed_at" TIMESTAMP(3);

-- Recover actual completion times from existing transition history, not created_at.
-- Legacy rows without a completion event remain NULL; do not invent timestamps.
UPDATE "orders" AS o
SET "completed_at" = (
  SELECT MAX(h."created_at")
  FROM "order_status_history" AS h
  WHERE h."order_id" = o."id" AND h."to_status" = 'COMPLETED'
)
WHERE o."status" = 'COMPLETED';
````

-- Durable gateway journal. Audit legacy Payment/Order discrepancies before deploy.
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE "payments"
  ADD COLUMN "gateway_status" "PaymentStatus",
  ADD COLUMN "applied_at" TIMESTAMP(3);

ALTER TABLE "payments" ADD CONSTRAINT "payments_gateway_result_check"
  CHECK ("gateway_status" IS NULL OR "gateway_status" <> 'PROCESSING');
ALTER TABLE "payments" ADD CONSTRAINT "payments_applied_result_check"
  CHECK ("applied_at" IS NULL OR (
    "status" <> 'PROCESSING' AND "gateway_status" IS NOT NULL
    AND "status" = "gateway_status"
  ));

-- Fail safely on duplicate live legacy attempts; never delete financial records.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "payments_one_live_attempt_per_order"
  ON "payments" ("order_id")
  WHERE "status" IN ('PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN', 'PAID');
COMMIT;
````

# BrewLite backend

NestJS + Prisma/PostgreSQL. Tài liệu khởi động chính ở `../README.md`; API contract ở `../docs/API_CONTRACT.md`. Module hiện có: Auth đầy đủ về mã và unit/integration-style tests, Products API; Orders/Payments/Promotion/Loyalty/Staff Orders chưa có. Dùng `.env` ở gốc repo, không commit bí mật. `npm run prisma:generate`, `npm run prisma:migrate`, `npm run prisma:seed`, `npm run start:dev`, `npm test -- --runInBand` là các script chính. Không dùng `prisma db push` cho môi trường cộng tác khi đã có migration.
````

import type { Config } from 'jest';
import { pathsToModuleNameMapper } from 'ts-jest';
import ts from 'typescript';

// Path aliases (e.g. the ones added by `nest g library`) live in tsconfig.json,
// so they are read from there instead of being duplicated here.
const { config: tsconfig } = ts.readConfigFile(
  './tsconfig.json',
  ts.sys.readFile,
);
const paths = tsconfig?.compilerOptions?.paths ?? {};

const config: Config = {
  moduleFileExtensions: ['js', 'json', 'ts'],
  rootDir: '.',
  extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts'],
  testRegex: '.*\\.spec\\.ts$',
  transform: {
    '^.+\\.(t|j)s$': ['ts-jest', { tsconfig: './tsconfig.test.json', useESM: true }],
  },
  moduleNameMapper: pathsToModuleNameMapper(paths, { prefix: '<rootDir>/' }),
  collectCoverageFrom: [
    'src/**/*.(t|j)s',
    'libs/**/*.(t|j)s',
    'apps/**/*.(t|j)s',
  ],
  coverageDirectory: './coverage',
  testEnvironment: 'node',
};

export default config;
````

import { ConflictException, Module, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { ConfigModule } from '@nestjs/config';
import { AppController } from './app.controller';
import { AppService } from './app.service';
import { PrismaModule } from './prisma.module';
import { PrismaService } from './prisma.service';
import { AuthModule } from './auth/auth.module';
import { ProductsModule } from './products/products.module';
import { CartModule } from './cart/cart.module';
import configuration from './configuration';
import { BaristaController } from './barista/barista.controller';
import { OrdersModule } from './orders/orders.module';
import { OrdersService } from './orders/orders.service';
import { InventoryModule } from './inventory/inventory.module';
import { PaymentsModule } from './payments/payments.module';
import {
  PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT,
  type PaymentOrderPort,
} from './payments/payment.types';

@Module({
  imports: [
    ConfigModule.forRoot({
      isGlobal: true,
      envFilePath: ['../.env', '.env'],
      load: [configuration],
    }),
    PrismaModule,
    AuthModule,
    ProductsModule,
    CartModule,
    InventoryModule,
    OrdersModule,
    PaymentsModule.register({
      imports: [OrdersModule, PrismaModule],
      orderProvider: {
        provide: PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT,
        useFactory: (
          orders: OrdersService,
          prisma: PrismaService,
        ): PaymentOrderPort => ({
          async findOwned(id: string, userId: string) {
            return orders.get(id, userId);
          },
          async prepareAttempt(input, tx) {
            const owned = await tx.order.findFirst({
              where: { id: input.orderId, userId: input.userId },
            });
            if (!owned) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
            if (owned.status === 'PAYMENT_FAILED') {
              return orders.preparePaymentRetry(owned.id, input.userId, tx);
            }
            if (owned.status !== 'PENDING') {
              throw new ConflictException('Đơn hàng không thể thanh toán');
            }
            return owned;
          },
          async applyPaymentResult(input, transaction) {
            const apply = async (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => {
              const owned = await tx.order.findFirst({
                where: { id: input.orderId, userId: input.userId },
                select: { id: true },
              });
              if (!owned)
                throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
              if (input.status === 'UNKNOWN') return;

              const order = await orders.transitionInTransaction(
                tx,
                input.orderId,
                input.status,
              );

              if (input.status === 'PAID') {
                const pointsToEarn = Math.floor(order.total / 10000);

                if (pointsToEarn > 0) {
                  await tx.user.update({
                    where: { id: order.userId },
                    data: {
                      loyaltyPoints: {
                        increment: pointsToEarn,
                      },
                    },
                  });
                }
              }
            };
            if (transaction) await apply(transaction);
            else await prisma.$transaction(apply);
          },
        }),
        inject: [OrdersService, PrismaService],
      },
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [AppController, BaristaController],
  providers: [AppService],
})
export class AppModule {}
````

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Header,
  Post,
  Req,
  Res,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from './jwt-auth.guard';
import { RegisterDto } from './dto/register.dto';
import { LoginDto } from './dto/login.dto';

const cookieOptions = () => ({
  httpOnly: true,
  sameSite: 'lax' as const,
  secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
  path: '/api',
});
@Controller('auth')
export class AuthController {
  constructor(private readonly auth: AuthService) {}
  @Post('register')
  @Header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  async register(
    @Body() input: RegisterDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) response: Response,
  ) {
    const result = await this.auth.register(input);
    response.cookie('brewlite_session', result.accessToken, {
      ...cookieOptions(),
      maxAge: 86400000,
    });
    return { user: result.user };
  }
  @Post('login')
  @Header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  async login(
    @Body() input: LoginDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) response: Response,
  ) {
    const result = await this.auth.login(input);
    response.cookie('brewlite_session', result.accessToken, {
      ...cookieOptions(),
      maxAge: 86400000,
    });
    return { user: result.user };
  }
  @Get('me')
  @Header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  me(
    @Req()
    request: Request & {
      user: {
        userId: string;
        email: string;
        name: string;
        loyaltyPoints: number;
        role: string;
      };
    },
  ) {
    const { userId, email, name, loyaltyPoints, role } = request.user;
    return { user: { id: userId, email, name, loyaltyPoints, role } };
  }
  @Post('logout')
  @Header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  async logout(
    @Req() request: Request & { user: { userId: string } },
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) response: Response,
  ) {
    await this.auth.logout(request.user.userId);
    response.clearCookie('brewlite_session', cookieOptions());
    return { message: 'Đã đăng xuất' };
  }
}
````

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtModule } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { ConfigModule, ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PassportModule } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { JwtStrategy } from './jwt.strategy';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from './jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from './roles.guard';

@Module({
  imports: [
    PassportModule,
    JwtModule.registerAsync({
      imports: [ConfigModule],
      inject: [ConfigService],
      useFactory: (config: ConfigService) => ({
        secret: config.getOrThrow<string>('JWT_SECRET'),
        signOptions: {
          expiresIn: (config.get<string>('JWT_EXPIRES_IN') ??
            '1d') as `${number}${'s' | 'm' | 'h' | 'd' | 'w' | 'y'}`,
        },
      }),
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [AuthController],
  providers: [AuthService, JwtStrategy, JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard],
  exports: [AuthService, JwtStrategy, JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard, PassportModule],
})
export class AuthModule {}

import { INestApplication, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { Role, UserStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import request from 'supertest';
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { AppModule } from '../app.module';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';

type TestUser = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
  passwordHash: string;
  loyaltyPoints: number;
  role: Role;
  status: UserStatus;
  sessionVersion: number;
};

let app: INestApplication;
let users: TestUser[];
let jwt: JwtService;

beforeAll(async () => {
  process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret-long-enough-for-rbac-tests';
  users = [
    {
      id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
      email: 'staff@example.com',
      fullName: 'Staff',
      passwordHash: await bcrypt.hash('Password123', 10),
      loyaltyPoints: 0,
      role: Role.BARISTA,
      status: UserStatus.ACTIVE,
      sessionVersion: 0,
    },
  ];
  const prisma = {
    user: {
      findUnique: jest.fn(
        async ({ where }: { where: { email?: string; id?: string } }) =>
          users.find((user) =>
            where.email ? user.email === where.email : user.id === where.id,
          ) ?? null,
      ),
      create: jest.fn(
        async ({
          data,
        }: {
          data: {
            email: string;
            fullName: string;
            passwordHash: string;
            role: Role;
          };
        }) => {
          const user: TestUser = {
            id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
            ...data,
            loyaltyPoints: 0,
            status: UserStatus.ACTIVE,
            sessionVersion: 0,
          };
          users.push(user);
          return user;
        },
      ),
      update: jest.fn(async ({ where }: { where: { id: string } }) => {
        const user = users.find((item) => item.id === where.id);
        if (!user) throw new Error('User not found');
        user.sessionVersion += 1;
        return user;
      }),
    },
    $connect: jest.fn(),
    $disconnect: jest.fn(),
  };
  const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
    .useValue(prisma)
    .compile();
  app = module.createNestApplication();
  app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
  app.useGlobalPipes(
    new ValidationPipe({
      whitelist: true,
      forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
      transform: true,
    }),
  );
  await app.init();
  jwt = module.get(JwtService);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await app.close();
});

describe('RBAC authentication', () => {
  it('registers a CUSTOMER and rejects a supplied role', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Fake Staff',
        email: 'fake@example.com',
        password: 'Password123',
        role: 'BARISTA',
      })
      .expect(400);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Customer',
        email: 'Customer@Example.COM',
        password: 'Password123',
      })
      .expect(201);
    expect(response.body.user.role).toBe(Role.CUSTOMER);
    expect(response.body.user.email).toBe('customer@example.com');
    expect(response.headers['cache-control']).toBe('no-store');
    expect(response.body.user.passwordHash).toBeUndefined();
    expect(
      users.find((user) => user.email === 'customer@example.com')?.role,
    ).toBe(Role.CUSTOMER);
    expect(
      await bcrypt.compare(
        'Password123',
        users.find((user) => user.email === 'customer@example.com')!
          .passwordHash,
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({
        name: 'Customer',
        email: 'CUSTOMER@example.com',
        password: 'Password123',
      })
      .expect(409);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .send({ name: 'Invalid', email: 'not-an-email', password: 'Password123' })
      .expect(400);
  });

  it('logs in both roles and restores a cookie session', async () => {
    for (const [email, role] of [
      ['customer@example.com', Role.CUSTOMER],
      ['staff@example.com', Role.BARISTA],
    ] as const) {
      const login = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/auth/login')
        .send({ email, password: 'Password123' })
        .expect(201);
      expect(login.body.user.role).toBe(role);
      expect(login.headers['cache-control']).toBe('no-store');
      expect(login.body.accessToken).toBeUndefined();
      expect(login.headers['set-cookie'][0]).toContain('HttpOnly');
      const me = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Cookie', login.headers['set-cookie'])
        .expect(200);
      expect(me.body.user.role).toBe(role);
      expect(me.headers['cache-control']).toBe('no-store');
      const loggedOut = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/auth/logout')
        .set('Cookie', login.headers['set-cookie'])
        .expect(201);
      expect(loggedOut.headers['set-cookie'][0]).toContain(
        'Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970',
      );
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Cookie', login.headers['set-cookie'])
        .expect(401);
    }
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: 'customer@example.com', password: 'WrongPassword123' })
      .expect(401);
  });

  it('requires valid authentication and current BARISTA role', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/barista/dashboard')
      .expect(401);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/barista/dashboard')
      .set('Authorization', 'Bearer invalid')
      .expect(401);
    const expired = await jwt.signAsync(
      { sub: users[0].id },
      { expiresIn: -1 },
    );
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/barista/dashboard')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${expired}`)
      .expect(401);
    const customer = users.find((user) => user.role === Role.CUSTOMER)!;
    const forgedRole = await jwt.signAsync({
      sub: customer.id,
      role: Role.BARISTA,
      sessionVersion: customer.sessionVersion,
    });
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/barista/dashboard')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${forgedRole}`)
      .expect(403);
    const staffToken = await jwt.signAsync({
      sub: users[0].id,
      sessionVersion: users[0].sessionVersion,
    });
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/barista/dashboard')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${staffToken}`)
      .expect(200);
  });

  it('rejects malformed registration and login payloads without leaking secrets', async () => {
    for (const body of [
      {},
      { name: 'A', email: 'invalid', password: 'Password123' },
      { name: 'Valid Name', email: 'person@example.com', password: 'weak' },
      { name: 'Valid Name', email: 'person@example.com', password: 'Password123', role: 'BARISTA' },
    ]) {
      const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/auth/register').send(body).expect(400);
      expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toContain('passwordHash');
    }
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/auth/login').send({}).expect(400);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: "' OR 1=1 --", password: 'Password123' }).expect(400);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: 'nobody@example.com', password: 'Password123' }).expect(401);
  });

  it('rejects tampered and incorrectly signed JWTs', async () => {
    const valid = await jwt.signAsync({
      sub: users[0].id,
      sessionVersion: users[0].sessionVersion,
    });
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${valid.slice(0, -2)}xx`).expect(401);
    const wrongSignature = await jwt.signAsync(
      { sub: users[0].id, sessionVersion: users[0].sessionVersion },
      { secret: 'another-test-secret-long-enough' },
    );
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${wrongSignature}`).expect(401);
  });
});
````

import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role, UserStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { RegisterDto } from './dto/register.dto';
import { LoginDto } from './dto/login.dto';

@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly jwt: JwtService,
  ) {}

  async register(input: RegisterDto) {
    const email = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const existing = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
    if (existing) throw new ConflictException('Email này đã được đăng ký');

    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(input.password, 10);
    let user;
    try {
      user = await this.prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          email,
          fullName: input.name.trim(),
          passwordHash,
          role: Role.CUSTOMER,
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          email: true,
          fullName: true,
          loyaltyPoints: true,
          role: true,
          sessionVersion: true,
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
        error.code === 'P2002'
      )
        throw new ConflictException('Email này đã được đăng ký');
      throw error;
    }
    return {
      user: this.publicUser(user),
      accessToken: await this.signToken(user.id, user.sessionVersion),
    };
  }

  async login(input: LoginDto) {
    const email = input.email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
    if (
      !user ||
      user.status !== UserStatus.ACTIVE ||
      !(await bcrypt.compare(input.password, user.passwordHash))
    ) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Email hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác');
    }
    return {
      user: this.publicUser(user),
      accessToken: await this.signToken(user.id, user.sessionVersion),
    };
  }

  publicUser(user: {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    fullName: string;
    loyaltyPoints: number;
    role: Role;
  }) {
    return {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      name: user.fullName,
      loyaltyPoints: user.loyaltyPoints,
      role: user.role,
    };
  }

  async logout(userId: string) {
    await this.prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { sessionVersion: { increment: 1 } },
    });
  }

  private signToken(sub: string, sessionVersion: number) {
    return this.jwt.signAsync({ sub, sessionVersion });
  }
}
````

import { cookieOriginGuard } from './csrf.middleware';
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
describe('cookie origin guard', () => {
  const run = (method: string, cookie?: string, origin?: string) => {
    const next = jest.fn() as NextFunction;
    const json = jest.fn();
    const status = jest.fn().mockReturnValue({ json });
    cookieOriginGuard(
      { method, headers: { cookie, origin } } as Request,
      { status } as unknown as Response,
      next,
    );
    return { next, status, json };
  };
  it('rejects cross-origin and missing-origin cookie writes', () => {
    expect(
      run('POST', 'brewlite_session=abc', 'https://other.test').status,
    ).toHaveBeenCalledWith(403);
    expect(run('PATCH', 'brewlite_session=abc').status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      403,
    );
    expect(
      run('POST', undefined, 'https://other.test').status,
    ).toHaveBeenCalledWith(403);
  });
  it('allows same-origin cookie writes, reads and bearer-only clients', () => {
    expect(
      run('POST', 'brewlite_session=abc', 'http://localhost:3000').next,
    ).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(run('GET', 'brewlite_session=abc').next).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(run('POST').next).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('accepts each configured frontend origin and rejects others', () => {
    const previous = process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN;
    process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN =
      'http://localhost:3000, http://localhost:3002';
    try {
      expect(
        run('POST', 'brewlite_session=abc', 'http://localhost:3002').next,
      ).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(
        run('POST', 'brewlite_session=abc', 'http://localhost:3003').status,
      ).toHaveBeenCalledWith(403);
      expect(run('POST', 'brewlite_session=abc').status).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        403,
      );
    } finally {
      if (previous === undefined) delete process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN;
      else process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN = previous;
    }
  });
});

````typescript
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { allowedFrontendOrigins } from '../configuration';
/** Cookie-authenticated writes must come from the configured browser origin. */
export function cookieOriginGuard(
  request: Request,
  response: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(request.method)) {
    const allowed = allowedFrontendOrigins();
    const validOrigin = Boolean(
      request.headers.origin && allowed.includes(request.headers.origin),
    );
    const hasSession = request.headers.cookie?.includes('brewlite_session=');
    if (
      (request.headers.origin && !validOrigin) ||
      (hasSession && !validOrigin)
    ) {
      response
        .status(403)
        .json({
          statusCode: 403,
          message: 'Nguồn yêu cầu không hợp lệ',
          error: 'Forbidden',
        });
      return;
    }
  }
  next();
}
````

  handleRequest<TUser = any>(error: unknown, user: TUser | false): TUser {
    if (error || !user)

import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { UserStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from 'passport-jwt';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';

const cookieExtractor = (request: {
  headers?: { cookie?: string };
}): string | null => {
  const cookie = request?.headers?.cookie
    ?.split('; ')
    .find((part) => part.startsWith('brewlite_session='));
  return cookie ? cookie.slice('brewlite_session='.length) : null;
};

@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  constructor(
    config: ConfigService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {
    super({
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromExtractors([
        cookieExtractor,
        ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
      ]),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: config.getOrThrow<string>('JWT_SECRET'),
    });
  }

  async validate(payload: { sub?: string; sessionVersion?: number }) {
    if (!payload.sub)
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ');
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: payload.sub },
    });
    if (
      !user ||
      user.status !== UserStatus.ACTIVE ||
      (payload.sessionVersion ?? 0) !== user.sessionVersion
    )
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Phiên đăng nhập đã hết hạn');
    return {
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      name: user.fullName,
      loyaltyPoints: user.loyaltyPoints,
    };
  }
}
````

import {
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  ForbiddenException,
  Injectable,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { ROLES_KEY } from './roles.decorator';

@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private readonly reflector: Reflector) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const roles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<Role[]>(ROLES_KEY, [
      context.getHandler(),
      context.getClass(),
    ]);
    if (!roles?.length) return true;
    const user = context.switchToHttp().getRequest().user as
      { role?: Role } | undefined;
    if (!user || !roles.includes(user.role as Role))
      throw new ForbiddenException('Bạn không có quyền truy cập trang này');
    return true;
  }
}
````

describe('cart pricing', () => {
  it('computes base + size + toppings as integer VND', () => {
    const priced = priceSelection(product, { size: 'M', toppingIds: [espresso] });
    expect(priced).toEqual({
      unitPrice: 29000 + 4000 + 7000,
      sizeName: 'Vừa (M)',
      toppings: [{ id: espresso, name: 'Thêm espresso', extraPrice: 7000 }],
      problems: [],
    });
  });

  it('ignores duplicated or uppercase topping ids when pricing', () => {
    expect(priceSelection(product, { size: 'S', toppingIds: [espresso, espresso.toUpperCase()] }).unitPrice).toBe(36000);
  });

  it('reports unavailable size/topping and foreign toppings', () => {
    const priced = priceSelection(product, { size: 'L', toppingIds: [cheese, '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000'] });
    expect(priced.problems).toEqual(['Size L tạm hết', 'Topping không thuộc món này', 'Kem cheese tạm hết']);
    expect(() => assertSelection(product, { size: 'L', toppingIds: [] })).toThrow(UnprocessableEntityException);
  });

  it('builds the same config key regardless of topping order or note padding', () => {
    const a = cartConfigKey({ size: 'M', toppingIds: [cheese, espresso], ice: '70% đá', sugar: 'Không đường', note: ' ít ngọt ' });
    const b = cartConfigKey({ size: 'M', toppingIds: [espresso.toUpperCase(), cheese], ice: '70% đá', sugar: 'Không đường', note: 'ít ngọt' });
    expect(a).toBe(b);
    expect(a).not.toBe(cartConfigKey({ size: 'L', toppingIds: [cheese, espresso], ice: '70% đá', sugar: 'Không đường', note: 'ít ngọt' }));
  });
});

import { UnprocessableEntityException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { ProductSizeCode } from '@prisma/client';
import type { ProductDetailRecord } from '../products/product-detail';

export const MAX_LINE_QUANTITY = 99;
export const NOTE_MAX_LENGTH = 120;
export const ICE_LEVELS = ['100% đá', '70% đá', '30% đá', 'Không đá'] as const;
export const SUGAR_LEVELS = ['100% chuẩn', '70% ngọt vừa', '50% ít ngọt', 'Không đường'] as const;

export type CartSelection = { size: ProductSizeCode; toppingIds: string[] };
export type PricedSelection = {
  unitPrice: number;
  sizeName: string;
  toppings: { id: string; name: string; extraPrice: number }[];
  problems: string[];
};

/** UUID không phân biệt hoa/thường, không trùng, có thứ tự để so sánh cấu hình. */
export const normalizeToppingIds = (ids: string[]) =>
  [...new Set(ids.map((id) => id.toLowerCase()))].sort();

/** Hai dòng giỏ có cùng khóa này được gộp số lượng thay vì tạo dòng mới. */
export const cartConfigKey = (line: {
  size: ProductSizeCode;
  toppingIds: string[];
  ice: string;
  sugar: string;
  note: string;
}) =>
  [line.size, normalizeToppingIds(line.toppingIds).join(','), line.ice, line.sugar, line.note.trim()].join('|');

/**
 * Tính đơn giá từ dữ liệu sản phẩm hiện tại (giá gốc + size + topping).
 * Không ném lỗi: các vấn đề (size/topping không hợp lệ hoặc tạm hết) trả về trong `problems`.
 */
export function priceSelection(product: ProductDetailRecord, selection: CartSelection): PricedSelection {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const size = product.sizes.find((option) => option.code === selection.size);
  if (!size) problems.push(`Size ${selection.size} không có cho món này`);
  else if (!size.available) problems.push(`Size ${selection.size} tạm hết`);

  const toppings: PricedSelection['toppings'] = [];
  for (const id of normalizeToppingIds(selection.toppingIds)) {
    const option = product.toppings.find((item) => item.topping.id.toLowerCase() === id);
    if (!option) {
      problems.push('Topping không thuộc món này');
      continue;
    }
    if (!option.available) problems.push(`${option.topping.name} tạm hết`);
    toppings.push({ id: option.topping.id, name: option.topping.name, extraPrice: option.extraPrice });
  }

  return {
    unitPrice: product.price + (size?.extraPrice ?? 0) + toppings.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.extraPrice, 0),
    sizeName: size?.name ?? selection.size,
    toppings,
    problems,
  };
}

/** Như `priceSelection` nhưng từ chối (422) khi lựa chọn không hợp lệ. */
export function assertSelection(product: ProductDetailRecord, selection: CartSelection): PricedSelection {
  const priced = priceSelection(product, selection);
  if (priced.problems.length) throw new UnprocessableEntityException(priced.problems.join('; '));
  return priced;
}

export const stockMessage = (product: Pick<ProductDetailRecord, 'name' | 'stock'>) =>
  product.stock === 0 ? `${product.name} đang hết hàng` : `${product.name} chỉ còn ${product.stock} phần`;
````

import { Body, Controller, Delete, Get, HttpCode, Param, ParseUUIDPipe, Patch, Post, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { CartLineDto, MergeCartDto, UpdateCartItemDto } from './dto/cart-line.dto';

type AuthedRequest = Request & { user: { userId: string } };

@Controller('cart')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
export class CartController {
  constructor(private readonly cart: CartService) {}

  @Get()
  get(@Req() request: AuthedRequest) {
    return this.cart.get(request.user.userId);
  }

  @Post('items')
  add(@Req() request: AuthedRequest, @Body() line: CartLineDto) {
    return this.cart.add(request.user.userId, line);
  }

  @Post('merge')
  @HttpCode(200)
  merge(@Req() request: AuthedRequest, @Body() input: MergeCartDto) {
    return this.cart.merge(request.user.userId, input);
  }

  @Patch('items/:id')
  update(
    @Req() request: AuthedRequest,
    @Param('id', new ParseUUIDPipe()) id: string,
    @Body() input: UpdateCartItemDto,
  ) {
    return this.cart.update(request.user.userId, id, input);
  }

  @Delete('items/:id')
  remove(@Req() request: AuthedRequest, @Param('id', new ParseUUIDPipe()) id: string) {
    return this.cart.remove(request.user.userId, id);
  }

  @Delete()
  clear(@Req() request: AuthedRequest) {
    return this.cart.clear(request.user.userId);
  }
}

type Row = {

  ice: string; sugar: string; note: string; configKey: string; quantity: number; createdAt: Date;
};
type ItemWhere = { id?: string; cartId?: string; productId?: string; cart?: { userId: string } };

const ALICE = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a';
const BOB = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b';
const product: ProductDetailRecord = { ...productDetailFixture(), stock: 5 };
const espresso = product.toppings[0].topping.id;

// Real HTTP, ValidationPipe, JWT guard and CartService; only Prisma is an in-memory fake.
function fakePrisma(products: Map<string, ProductDetailRecord>) {
  const carts: { id: string; userId: string }[] = [];
  let rows: Row[] = [];
  let tick = 0;
  const matches = (where: ItemWhere) => (row: Row) =>
    (!where.id || row.id === where.id) &&
    (!where.cartId || row.cartId === where.cartId) &&
    (!where.productId || row.productId === where.productId) &&
    (!where.cart || carts.find((cart) => cart.id === row.cartId)?.userId === where.cart.userId);
  const project = (row: Row, args: { include?: unknown; select?: Record<string, boolean> }) =>
    args.include
      ? { ...row, product: products.get(row.productId) }
      : args.select
        ? Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(args.select).map((key) => [key, row[key as keyof Row]]))
        : row;
  const client = {
    user: {
      findUnique: async ({ where }: { where: { id: string } }) =>
        [ALICE, BOB].includes(where.id) ? { id: where.id, email: `${where.id}@test`, fullName: 'Khách', role: Role.CUSTOMER, loyaltyPoints: 0, sessionVersion: 0, status: UserStatus.ACTIVE } : null,
    },
    product: {
      findUnique: async ({ where }: { where: { id: string } }) => products.get(where.id) ?? null,
    },
    cart: {
      upsert: async ({ where }: { where: { userId: string } }) => {
        let cart = carts.find((item) => item.userId === where.userId);
        if (!cart) carts.push((cart = { id: randomUUID(), userId: where.userId }));
        return { id: cart.id };
      },
    },
    cartItem: {
      findMany: async (args: { where: ItemWhere; include?: unknown; select?: Record<string, boolean> }) =>
        rows.filter(matches(args.where)).sort((a, b) => +a.createdAt - +b.createdAt).map((row) => project(row, args)),
      findFirst: async (args: { where: ItemWhere; include?: unknown }) => {
        const row = rows.find(matches(args.where));
        return row ? project(row, args) : null;
      },
      create: async ({ data }: { data: Omit<Row, 'id' | 'createdAt'> }) => {
        const row = { ...data, id: randomUUID(), createdAt: new Date(Date.now() + tick++) };
        rows.push(row);
        return row;
      },
      update: async ({ where, data }: { where: { id: string }; data: Partial<Row> }) =>
        Object.assign(rows.find((row) => row.id === where.id)!, data),
      delete: async ({ where }: { where: { id: string } }) => {
        rows = rows.filter((row) => row.id !== where.id);
      },
      deleteMany: async ({ where }: { where: ItemWhere }) => {
        const before = rows.length;
        rows = rows.filter((row) => !matches(where)(row));
        return { count: before - rows.length };
      },
    },
    $transaction: async (work: (tx: unknown) => Promise<void>) => work(client),
    reset: () => {
      carts.length = 0;
      rows = [];
    },
  };
  return client;
}

describe('Cart HTTP', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let token: (userId: string) => string;
  const products = new Map([[product.id, product]]);
  const prisma = fakePrisma(products);
  const api = () => request(app.getHttpServer());

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'test-secret-long-enough-for-cart-tests';
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [ConfigModule.forRoot({ isGlobal: true, ignoreEnvFile: true }), CartModule, JwtModule.register({ secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET })],
    })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue(prisma)
      .compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true }));
    await app.init();
    const jwt = module.get(JwtService);
    token = (userId) => `Bearer ${jwt.sign({ sub: userId })}`;
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    prisma.reset();
    product.stock = 5;
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('requires login for every cart route', async () => {
    await api().get('/api/cart').expect(401);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').send(line()).expect(401);
  });

  it('starts empty, adds a line with server-computed price and merges identical configurations', async () => {
    const empty = await api().get('/api/cart').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).expect(200);
    expect(empty.body).toEqual({ items: [], totalQuantity: 0, subtotal: 0, valid: true });

    // unitPrice sent by a client is not part of the contract and is rejected.
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).send(line({ unitPrice: 1 })).expect(400);

    const first = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).send(line()).expect(201);
    expect(first.body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(first.body.items[0]).toMatchObject({
      name: product.name, size: 'M', toppingNames: ['Thêm espresso'], quantity: 2,
      unitPrice: 40000, lineTotal: 80000, available: true,
    });
    expect(first.body.items[0].sizeOptions).toHaveLength(3);

    const merged = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', token(ALICE))
      .send(line({ quantity: 1, toppingIds: [espresso.toUpperCase()] })).expect(201);
    expect(merged.body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(merged.body).toMatchObject({ totalQuantity: 3, subtotal: 120000 });

    const other = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', token(ALICE))
      .send(line({ quantity: 1, size: 'S', toppingIds: [], note: 'mang đi' })).expect(201);
    expect(other.body.items).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(other.body.items[1]).toMatchObject({ unitPrice: 29000, note: 'mang đi' });
  });

  it('validates input and product options', async () => {
    const auth = token(ALICE);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ quantity: 0 })).expect(400);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ size: 'XL' })).expect(400);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ ice: 'nhiều đá' })).expect(400);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ note: 'x'.repeat(121) })).expect(400);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ productId: randomUUID() })).expect(404);
    const unavailable = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ size: 'L' })).expect(422);
    expect(unavailable.body.message).toBe('Size L tạm hết');
  });

  it('enforces stock across all lines of the same product', async () => {
    const auth = token(ALICE);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ quantity: 4 })).expect(201);
    const over = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ size: 'S', quantity: 2 })).expect(409);
    expect(over.body.message).toBe(`${product.name} chỉ còn 5 phần`);

    // Stock dropping afterwards flags the line instead of hiding it, and decreasing is still allowed.
    product.stock = 2;
    const flagged = await api().get('/api/cart').set('Authorization', auth).expect(200);
    expect(flagged.body.valid).toBe(false);
    expect(flagged.body.items[0].issue).toBe(`${product.name} chỉ còn 2 phần`);
    const id = flagged.body.items[0].id;
    await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${id}`).set('Authorization', auth).send({ quantity: 3 }).expect(200);
    const fixed = await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${id}`).set('Authorization', auth).send({ quantity: 2 }).expect(200);
    expect(fixed.body.valid).toBe(true);
  });

  it('updates quantity and size, re-pricing and merging into an existing line', async () => {
    const auth = token(ALICE);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ size: 'S', quantity: 1 })).expect(201);
    const both = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ size: 'M', quantity: 1 })).expect(201);
    const [small, medium] = both.body.items;

    await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${small.id}`).set('Authorization', auth).send({}).expect(400);
    await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${small.id}`).set('Authorization', auth).send({ size: 'L' }).expect(422);
    const qty = await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${medium.id}`).set('Authorization', auth).send({ quantity: 3 }).expect(200);
    expect(qty.body.items[1]).toMatchObject({ quantity: 3, lineTotal: 120000 });

    const mergedSize = await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${small.id}`).set('Authorization', auth).send({ size: 'M' }).expect(200);
    expect(mergedSize.body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(mergedSize.body.items[0]).toMatchObject({ id: medium.id, size: 'M', quantity: 4, unitPrice: 40000 });
  });

  it('keeps carts private per user and supports remove/clear', async () => {
    const added = await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).send(line()).expect(201);
    const id = added.body.items[0].id;
    expect((await api().get('/api/cart').set('Authorization', token(BOB)).expect(200)).body.items).toEqual([]);
    await api().patch(`/api/cart/items/${id}`).set('Authorization', token(BOB)).send({ quantity: 1 }).expect(404);
    await api().delete(`/api/cart/items/${id}`).set('Authorization', token(BOB)).expect(404);
    await api().delete('/api/cart/items/not-a-uuid').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).expect(400);

    const removed = await api().delete(`/api/cart/items/${id}`).set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).expect(200);
    expect(removed.body.items).toEqual([]);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).send(line()).expect(201);
    const cleared = await api().delete('/api/cart').set('Authorization', token(ALICE)).expect(200);
    expect(cleared.body).toMatchObject({ items: [], subtotal: 0 });
  });

  it('merges a guest cart after login and reports skipped lines', async () => {
    const auth = token(ALICE);
    await api().post('/api/cart/items').set('Authorization', auth).send(line({ quantity: 1 })).expect(201);
    const result = await api().post('/api/cart/merge').set('Authorization', auth).send({
      items: [line({ quantity: 1 }), line({ size: 'L' }), line({ productId: randomUUID() })],
    }).expect(200);
    expect(result.body.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.body.items[0].quantity).toBe(2);
    expect(result.body.skipped).toEqual([
      { productId: product.id, reason: 'Size L tạm hết' },
      { productId: expect.any(String), reason: 'Không tìm thấy sản phẩm' },
    ]);
    await api().post('/api/cart/merge').set('Authorization', auth).send({ items: [line({ quantity: 'x' })] }).expect(400);
  });
});
````

import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  HttpException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, type ProductSizeCode } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { productDetailSelect, type ProductDetailRecord } from '../products/product-detail';
import {
  MAX_LINE_QUANTITY,
  assertSelection,
  cartConfigKey,
  normalizeToppingIds,
  priceSelection,
  stockMessage,
} from './cart-pricing';
import type { CartLineDto, MergeCartDto, UpdateCartItemDto } from './dto/cart-line.dto';

const itemInclude = { product: { select: productDetailSelect } } satisfies Prisma.CartItemInclude;
type CartItemRecord = Prisma.CartItemGetPayload<{ include: typeof itemInclude }>;
type Tx = Prisma.TransactionClient;
type QuantityRow = { id: string; configKey: string; quantity: number };

export type CartItemView = {
  id: string;
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  size: ProductSizeCode;
  sizeName: string;
  sizeOptions: { code: ProductSizeCode; name: string; extraPrice: number; available: boolean }[];
  toppingIds: string[];
  toppingNames: string[];
  ice: string;
  sugar: string;
  note: string;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  lineTotal: number;
  available: boolean;
  issue?: string;
};
export type CartView = { items: CartItemView[]; totalQuantity: number; subtotal: number; valid: boolean };
export type MergeResult = CartView & { skipped: { productId: string; reason: string }[] };

const sum = (rows: { quantity: number }[]) => rows.reduce((total, row) => total + row.quantity, 0);

/** Chỉ chặn khi tổng số lượng của món tăng lên và vượt tồn kho; giảm luôn được phép. */
function assertStock(product: ProductDetailRecord, before: number, after: number) {
  if (after > before && after > product.stock) throw new ConflictException(stockMessage(product));
}

export function toCartView(items: CartItemRecord[]): CartView {
  const totals = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const item of items) totals.set(item.productId, (totals.get(item.productId) ?? 0) + item.quantity);
  const views = items.map((item): CartItemView => {
    const priced = priceSelection(item.product, item);
    const problems = [...priced.problems];
    if ((totals.get(item.productId) ?? 0) > item.product.stock) problems.push(stockMessage(item.product));
    return {
      id: item.id,
      productId: item.productId,
      name: item.product.name,
      imageUrl: item.product.imageUrl,
      size: item.size,
      sizeName: priced.sizeName,
      sizeOptions: item.product.sizes.map(({ code, name, extraPrice, available }) => ({ code, name, extraPrice, available })),
      toppingIds: priced.toppings.map((topping) => topping.id),
      toppingNames: priced.toppings.map((topping) => topping.name),
      ice: item.ice,
      sugar: item.sugar,
      note: item.note,
      quantity: item.quantity,
      unitPrice: priced.unitPrice,
      lineTotal: priced.unitPrice * item.quantity,
      available: problems.length === 0,
      ...(problems.length ? { issue: problems.join('; ') } : {}),
    };
  });
  return {
    items: views,
    totalQuantity: sum(views),
    subtotal: views.reduce((total, item) => total + item.lineTotal, 0),
    valid: views.every((item) => item.available),
  };
}

@Injectable()
export class CartService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async get(userId: string): Promise<CartView> {
    const items = await this.prisma.cartItem.findMany({
      where: { cart: { userId } },
      include: itemInclude,
      orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
    });
    return toCartView(items);
  }

  async add(userId: string, line: CartLineDto): Promise<CartView> {
    await this.addLine(userId, line);
    return this.get(userId);
  }

  async update(userId: string, itemId: string, input: UpdateCartItemDto): Promise<CartView> {
    if (input.quantity === undefined && input.size === undefined)
      throw new BadRequestException('Cần truyền quantity hoặc size');
    await this.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const item = await tx.cartItem.findFirst({ where: { id: itemId, cart: { userId } }, include: itemInclude });
      if (!item) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy món trong giỏ');
      const size = input.size ?? item.size;
      const quantity = input.quantity ?? item.quantity;
      if (size !== item.size) assertSelection(item.product, { size, toppingIds: item.toppingIds });
      const configKey = cartConfigKey({ ...item, size });
      const rows = await this.sameProductRows(tx, item.cartId, item.productId);
      const target = rows.find((row) => row.id !== item.id && row.configKey === configKey);
      const others = rows.filter((row) => row.id !== item.id && row !== target);
      if (target) {
        // Đổi size trùng với một dòng đã có: gộp vào dòng đó.
        const merged = Math.min(MAX_LINE_QUANTITY, target.quantity + quantity);
        assertStock(item.product, sum(rows), sum(others) + merged);
        await tx.cartItem.delete({ where: { id: item.id } });
        await tx.cartItem.update({ where: { id: target.id }, data: { quantity: merged } });
      } else {
        assertStock(item.product, sum(rows), sum(others) + quantity);
        await tx.cartItem.update({ where: { id: item.id }, data: { size, configKey, quantity } });
      }
    });
    return this.get(userId);
  }

  async remove(userId: string, itemId: string): Promise<CartView> {
    const { count } = await this.prisma.cartItem.deleteMany({ where: { id: itemId, cart: { userId } } });
    if (!count) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy món trong giỏ');
    return this.get(userId);
  }

  async clear(userId: string): Promise<CartView> {
    await this.prisma.cartItem.deleteMany({ where: { cart: { userId } } });
    return this.get(userId);
  }

  /** Gộp giỏ khách vãng lai vào giỏ tài khoản sau đăng nhập; dòng không hợp lệ được bỏ qua và báo lại. */
  async merge(userId: string, input: MergeCartDto): Promise<MergeResult> {
    const skipped: MergeResult['skipped'] = [];
    for (const line of input.items) {
      try {
        await this.addLine(userId, line);
      } catch (error) {
        if (!(error instanceof HttpException) || error.getStatus() >= 500) throw error;
        skipped.push({ productId: line.productId, reason: error.message });
      }
    }
    return { ...(await this.get(userId)), skipped };
  }

  private async addLine(userId: string, line: CartLineDto) {
    const product = await this.prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id: line.productId }, select: productDetailSelect });
    if (!product) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy sản phẩm');
    const toppingIds = normalizeToppingIds(line.toppingIds);
    assertSelection(product, { size: line.size, toppingIds });
    const note = (line.note ?? '').trim();
    const configKey = cartConfigKey({ ...line, toppingIds, note });
    await this.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const cart = await tx.cart.upsert({ where: { userId }, create: { userId }, update: {}, select: { id: true } });
      const rows = await this.sameProductRows(tx, cart.id, product.id);
      const existing = rows.find((row) => row.configKey === configKey);
      const quantity = Math.min(MAX_LINE_QUANTITY, (existing?.quantity ?? 0) + line.quantity);
      assertStock(product, sum(rows), sum(rows) - (existing?.quantity ?? 0) + quantity);
      if (existing) await tx.cartItem.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data: { quantity } });
      else
        await tx.cartItem.create({
          data: { cartId: cart.id, productId: product.id, size: line.size, toppingIds, ice: line.ice, sugar: line.sugar, note, configKey, quantity },
        });
    });
  }

  private sameProductRows(tx: Tx, cartId: string, productId: string): Promise<QuantityRow[]> {
    return tx.cartItem.findMany({ where: { cartId, productId }, select: { id: true, configKey: true, quantity: true } });
  }

  private async transaction(work: (tx: Tx) => Promise<void>) {
    try {
      await this.prisma.$transaction(work);
    } catch (error) {
      // Hai yêu cầu đồng thời cùng tạo một cấu hình: báo client tải lại thay vì lỗi 500.
      if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2002')
        throw new ConflictException('Giỏ hàng vừa thay đổi, vui lòng thử lại');
      throw error;
    }
  }
}

import { ProductSizeCode } from '@prisma/client';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import {
  ArrayMaxSize,
  IsArray,
  IsEnum,
  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  Max,
  MaxLength,
  Min,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';
import { ICE_LEVELS, MAX_LINE_QUANTITY, NOTE_MAX_LENGTH, SUGAR_LEVELS } from '../cart-pricing';

export class CartLineDto {
  @IsUUID('all')
  productId!: string;

  @IsEnum(ProductSizeCode)
  size!: ProductSizeCode;

  @IsArray()
  @ArrayMaxSize(10)
  @IsUUID('all', { each: true })
  toppingIds!: string[];

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(MAX_LINE_QUANTITY)
  quantity!: number;

  @IsIn(ICE_LEVELS)
  ice!: string;

  @IsIn(SUGAR_LEVELS)
  sugar!: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(NOTE_MAX_LENGTH)
  note?: string;
}

export class UpdateCartItemDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  @Max(MAX_LINE_QUANTITY)
  quantity?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(ProductSizeCode)
  size?: ProductSizeCode;
}

export class MergeCartDto {
  @IsArray()
  @ArrayMaxSize(50)
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => CartLineDto)
  items!: CartLineDto[];
}

import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { BadRequestException, ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { InventoryService } from './inventory.service';

describe('Inventory optimistic locking', () => {
  const inventory = new InventoryService();

  it('aggregates configurations of one product before checking available stock', async () => {
    const updateMany = jest.fn();
    const tx = {
      product: { updateMany },
    } as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient;
    await expect(
      inventory.reserve(
        tx,
        [
          { productId: 'a', qty: 2 },
          { productId: 'a', qty: 2 },
        ],
        [{ id: 'a', stock: 3, version: 1 }],
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow(ConflictException);
    expect(updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('only one concurrent request can reserve the last unit from the same snapshot', async () => {
    let stock = 1,
      version = 1;
    const updateMany = jest.fn(async (input: Prisma.ProductUpdateManyArgs) => {
      // Emulates the atomic WHERE evaluation done by PostgreSQL, not a real DB test.
      if (input.where?.version !== version || stock < 1) return { count: 0 };
      stock--;
      version++;
      return { count: 1 };
    });
    const tx = {
      product: { updateMany },
    } as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient;
    const snapshot = [{ id: 'a', stock: 1, version: 1 }];
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      inventory.reserve(tx, [{ productId: 'a', qty: 1 }], snapshot),
      inventory.reserve(tx, [{ productId: 'a', qty: 1 }], snapshot),
    ]);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.status === 'rejected')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stock).toBe(0);
    expect(version).toBe(2);
  });

  it('uses a consistent product order and combines quantities for restore', async () => {
    const update = jest.fn(async () => ({}));
    const tx = { product: { update } } as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient;
    await inventory.restore(tx, [
      { productId: 'b', qty: 1 },
      { productId: 'a', qty: 2 },
      { productId: 'b', qty: 3 },
    ]);
    expect(update.mock.calls).toEqual([
      [
        {
          where: { id: 'a' },
          data: { stock: { increment: 2 }, version: { increment: 1 } },
        },
      ],
      [
        {
          where: { id: 'b' },
          data: { stock: { increment: 4 }, version: { increment: 1 } },
        },
      ],
    ]);
  });

  it.each([0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity])(
    'rejects invalid quantity %s before stock mutation',
    async (qty) => {
      await expect(
        inventory.reserve(
          {} as Prisma.TransactionClient,
          [{ productId: 'a', qty }],
          [],
        ),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    },
  );
});

import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export type StockItem = { productId: string; qty: number };
export type StockSnapshot = { id: string; stock: number; version: number };

function quantities(items: StockItem[]) {
  const totals = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const item of items) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(item.qty) || item.qty <= 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Số lượng không hợp lệ');
    }
    const total = (totals.get(item.productId) ?? 0) + item.qty;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total > 2147483647) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Số lượng vượt giới hạn');
    }
    totals.set(item.productId, total);
  }
  // All writers acquire product locks in the same order to avoid multi-item deadlocks.
  return [...totals].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
}

@Injectable()
export class InventoryService {
  // Always use the caller's transaction; never commit inventory independently of the order.
  async reserve(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    items: StockItem[],
    snapshots?: StockSnapshot[],
  ) {
    const totals = quantities(items);
    const products =
      snapshots ??
      (await tx.product.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: totals.map(([id]) => id) } },
        select: { id: true, stock: true, version: true },
      }));
    for (const [id, qty] of totals) {
      const product = products.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (!product || product.stock < qty) {
        throw new ConflictException(`Sản phẩm ${id} không đủ tồn kho`);
      }
      const result = await tx.product.updateMany({
        where: { id, version: product.version, stock: { gte: qty } },
        data: { stock: { decrement: qty }, version: { increment: 1 } },
      });
      if (result.count !== 1) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'Tồn kho vừa thay đổi. Vui lòng kiểm tra giỏ và thử lại',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // Caller must first win the order version CAS, preventing double release.
  async restore(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, items: StockItem[]) {
    for (const [id, qty] of quantities(items)) {
      await tx.product.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { stock: { increment: qty }, version: { increment: 1 } },
      });
    }
  }
}

import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { config } from 'dotenv';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';
import { cookieOriginGuard } from './auth/csrf.middleware';
import { allowedFrontendOrigins } from './configuration';

config({ path: resolve(process.cwd(), '../.env') });

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
  app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
  app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
  app.enableCors({
    origin: allowedFrontendOrigins(),
    credentials: true,
  });

      whitelist: true,

}
bootstrap();

import { Transform, Type } from 'class-transformer';
import {
  ArrayMaxSize,
  ArrayMinSize,
  ArrayUnique,
  IsArray,
  IsEnum,
  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  IsUUID,
  Max,
  MaxLength,
  Min,
  MinLength,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';
import { ProductSizeCode } from '@prisma/client';
import { ICE_LEVELS, SUGAR_LEVELS } from '../../cart/cart-pricing';

export class CreateOrderItemDto {
  @Transform(({ value }) => typeof value === 'string' ? value.toLowerCase() : value)
  @IsUUID() productId: string;
  @IsEnum(ProductSizeCode) size: ProductSizeCode;
  @IsArray()
  @ArrayMaxSize(30)
  @ArrayUnique()
  @IsUUID('all', { each: true })
  @Transform(({ value }) => Array.isArray(value)
    ? value.map((id: unknown) => typeof id === 'string' ? id.toLowerCase() : id)
    : value)
  toppingIds: string[];
  @IsInt() @Min(1) @Max(99) quantity: number;
  @IsIn(ICE_LEVELS) ice: string;
  @IsIn(SUGAR_LEVELS) sugar: string;
  @IsOptional() @IsString() @MaxLength(120) note?: string;
}

export class CreateOrderDto {
  @IsArray()
  @ArrayMinSize(1)
  @ArrayMaxSize(100)
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => CreateOrderItemDto)
  items: CreateOrderItemDto[];

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MinLength(1)
  @MaxLength(64)
  promotionCode?: string;
}
