````typescript
import { Injectable, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export const ORDER_DISCOUNT = Symbol('ORDER_DISCOUNT');

export interface OrderDiscount {
  calculate(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    input: {
      userId: string;
      subtotal: number;
      promotionCode?: string;
    },
  ): Promise<number>;
}

// Danh sách các mã ưu đãi mặc định hỗ trợ sẵn
const DEFAULT_PROMOTIONS: Record<
  string,
  { minSubtotal: number; type: 'FIXED' | 'PERCENT'; value: number; maxDiscount?: number }
> = {
  WELCOME10: { minSubtotal: 50000, type: 'FIXED', value: 10000 },
  BREW20: { minSubtotal: 100000, type: 'FIXED', value: 20000 },
  DISCOUNT10: { minSubtotal: 30000, type: 'PERCENT', value: 10, maxDiscount: 30000 },
};

@Injectable()
export class PromotionDiscount implements OrderDiscount {
  async calculate(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    input: {
      userId: string;
      subtotal: number;
      promotionCode?: string;
    },
  ): Promise<number> {
    if (!input.promotionCode || !input.promotionCode.trim()) {
      return 0;
    }

    const code = input.promotionCode.trim().toUpperCase();

    // 1. Kiểm tra CSDL Prisma nếu bảng Promotion tồn tại
    if ('promotion' in tx && typeof (tx as any).promotion?.findUnique === 'function') {
      try {
        const promo = await (tx as any).promotion.findUnique({
          where: { code },
        });

        if (promo) {
          if (!promo.isActive) {
            throw new BadRequestException('Mã ưu đãi đã hết hạn hoặc ngưng áp dụng');
          }
          if (promo.minSubtotal && input.subtotal < promo.minSubtotal) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
              `Đơn hàng cần tối thiểu ${promo.minSubtotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ để áp dụng mã ${code}`,
            );
          }

          let discount = 0;
          if (promo.discountType === 'PERCENT') {
            discount = Math.round((input.subtotal * promo.discountValue) / 100);
            if (promo.maxDiscountAmount && discount > promo.maxDiscountAmount) {
              discount = promo.maxDiscountAmount;
            }
          } else {
            discount = promo.discountValue;
          }

          return Math.min(discount, input.subtotal);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof BadRequestException) throw err;
      }
    }

    // 2. Kiểm tra danh sách mã mặc định hệ thống
    const defaultPromo = DEFAULT_PROMOTIONS[code];
    if (!defaultPromo) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Mã ưu đãi "${code}" không hợp lệ hoặc không tồn tại`);
    }

    if (input.subtotal < defaultPromo.minSubtotal) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Đơn hàng cần tối thiểu ${defaultPromo.minSubtotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN')} đ để áp dụng mã ${code}`,
      );
    }

    let discountAmount = 0;
    if (defaultPromo.type === 'PERCENT') {
      discountAmount = Math.round((input.subtotal * defaultPromo.value) / 100);
      if (defaultPromo.maxDiscount && discountAmount > defaultPromo.maxDiscount) {
        discountAmount = defaultPromo.maxDiscount;
      }
    } else {
      discountAmount = defaultPromo.value;
    }

    return Math.min(discountAmount, input.subtotal);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export const orderInclude = {
  user: { select: { fullName: true } },
  items: {
    orderBy: { position: 'asc' },
    include: {
      toppings: { orderBy: { toppingId: 'asc' } },
    },
  },
  payments: {
    where: { status: 'PAID' },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    take: 1,
    select: { method: true },
  },
} satisfies Prisma.OrderInclude;

export type OrderRecord = Prisma.OrderGetPayload<{
  include: typeof orderInclude;
}>;

export function orderResponse(order: OrderRecord) {
  return {
    id: order.id,
    userId: order.userId,
    customerName: order.user.fullName,
    status: order.status,
    subtotal: order.subtotal,
    discount: order.discountAmount,
    total: order.total,
    ...(order.promotionCode ? { promotionCode: order.promotionCode } : {}),
    ...(order.payments?.[0]
      ? { paymentMethod: order.payments[0].method }
      : {}),
    createdAt: order.createdAt.toISOString(),
    ...(order.cancelReason ? { cancelReason: order.cancelReason } : {}),
    ...(order.completedAt
      ? { completedAt: order.completedAt.toISOString() }
      : {}),
    items: order.items.map((item) => ({
      key: item.id,
      productId: item.productId,
      name: item.name,
      imageUrl: item.imageUrl,
      size: item.size,
      toppingIds: item.toppings.map((t) => t.toppingId),
      toppingNames: item.toppings.map((t) => t.name),
      unitPrice: item.unitPrice,
      quantity: item.qty,
      lineTotal: item.lineTotal,
      ice: item.ice,
      sugar: item.sugar,
      ...(item.note ? { note: item.note } : {}),
    })),
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { assertOrderTransition } from './order-state-machine';

const allowed = new Set([
  'PENDING:PAID',
  'PENDING:PAYMENT_FAILED',
  'PENDING:CANCELLED',
  'PAYMENT_FAILED:PENDING',
  'PAYMENT_FAILED:CANCELLED',
  'PAID:PREPARING',
  'PAID:CANCELLED',
  'PREPARING:READY',
  'READY:COMPLETED',
]);

describe('Order state machine: complete 7 × 7 transition matrix', () => {
  for (const from of Object.values(OrderStatus)) {
    for (const to of Object.values(OrderStatus)) {
      it(`${from} -> ${to}`, () => {
        if (allowed.has(`${from}:${to}`))
          expect(() => assertOrderTransition(from, to)).not.toThrow();
        else
          expect(() => assertOrderTransition(from, to)).toThrow(
            ConflictException,
          );
      });
    }
  }
});
````

````typescript
import { ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';

const transitions: Record<OrderStatus, readonly OrderStatus[]> = {
  PENDING: ['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'CANCELLED'],
  PAYMENT_FAILED: ['PENDING', 'CANCELLED'],
  PAID: ['PREPARING', 'CANCELLED'],
  PREPARING: ['READY'],
  READY: ['COMPLETED'],
  COMPLETED: [],
  CANCELLED: [],
};

export function assertOrderTransition(
  from: OrderStatus,
  to: OrderStatus,
): void {
  if (!transitions[from]?.includes(to)) {
    throw new ConflictException(`Không thể chuyển đơn từ ${from} sang ${to}`);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';

import type { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';

const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;
const origin = 'http://localhost:3000';

// Opt-in PostgreSQL only. No fallback to the development DATABASE_URL, no reset/truncate.

      .overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue(db).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.use(cookieOriginGuard);

        .expect(201);

      return { id: response.body.user.id as string, cookie: (response.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[])[0].split(';')[0] };

    const first = await register();

    customer = first.id; cookie = first.cookie;
    otherCustomer = second.id; otherCookie = second.cookie;

    await db.topping.create({ data: { id: toppingId, name: 'Task 06 topping' } });
    for (const id of productIds) {
      await db.product.create({ data: {
        id, name: 'Task 06 Coffee', price: 30000, imageUrl: '/test.svg', stock: 6,
        sizes: { create: [
          { code: 'S', name: 'Small', extraPrice: 0 },
          { code: 'M', name: 'Medium', extraPrice: 4000, isDefault: true },
          { code: 'L', name: 'Large', extraPrice: 9000 },
        ] },
        toppings: { create: { toppingId, extraPrice: 6000 } },
      } });
    }
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId: { in: [customer, otherCustomer] } } });
    await db.cartItem.deleteMany({ where: { cart: { userId: customer } } });
    await db.product.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } }, data: { stock: 6, version: 1 } });
    await db.productSize.updateMany({ where: { productId: { in: productIds } }, data: { available: true } });
    await db.productTopping.updateMany({ where: { productId: { in: productIds } }, data: { available: true } });

  afterAll(async () => {

        await db.cart.deleteMany({ where: { userId: { in: [customer, otherCustomer] } } });
        await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } } });
        await db.topping.deleteMany({ where: { id: toppingId } });
        await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: [customer, otherCustomer, staffId] } } });
      }
    } finally {

      if (previousSecret === undefined) delete process.env.JWT_SECRET;

  async function expectUnchanged() {

    expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId: stored.id } })).toBe(0);

    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/orders/me').set('Cookie', cookie).expect(200)
      .expect(({ body }) => expect(body.map((order: { id: string }) => order.id)).toEqual([stored.id]));

    await expectUnchanged();
  });

    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/orders').send({ items: [line()] }).expect(401);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/orders').set('Cookie', staffCookie).set('Origin', origin).send({ items: [line()] }).expect(403);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/orders').set('Cookie', cookie).set('Origin', 'https://foreign.example').send({ items: [line()] }).expect(403);
    await expectUnchanged();

    const item = line();

  });

  });

    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ status: 'PENDING', subtotal: 90000, discount: 10000, total: 80000 });
    expect(await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: response.body.id } })).toMatchObject({ discountAmount: 10000, total: 80000 });
  });
````

````typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Post,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { Roles } from '../auth/roles.decorator';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/roles.guard';
import { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';

@Controller('orders')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.CUSTOMER)
export class OrdersController {
  constructor(private readonly orders: OrdersService) {}

  @Post()
  create(
    @Req() req: { user: { userId: string } },
    @Body() dto: CreateOrderDto,
  ) {
    return this.orders.create(req.user.userId, dto);
  }

  @Get('me')
  mine(@Req() req: { user: { userId: string } }) {
    return this.orders.mine(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get(':id/status')
  async status(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Req() req: { user: { userId: string } },
  ) {
    return { status: (await this.orders.get(id, req.user.userId)).status };
  }

  @Get(':id')
  get(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Req() req: { user: { userId: string } },
  ) {
    return this.orders.get(id, req.user.userId);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { ConflictException, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../app.module';
import { cookieOriginGuard } from '../auth/csrf.middleware';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { InventoryService } from '../inventory/inventory.service';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';
import { PromotionDiscount } from './order-discount';
import type { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';

// Opt in with a migrated, dedicated test database. Never fall back to DATABASE_URL.
const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;

describeDatabase('Orders PostgreSQL transactions and concurrency', () => {
  let db: PrismaService;
  let service: OrdersService;
  const userId = randomUUID();
  const productIds = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()].sort();
  const toppingId = randomUUID();
  const dto = (ids = [productIds[0]]): CreateOrderDto => ({
    items: ids.map((productId) => ({
      productId,
      size: 'M',
      toppingIds: [toppingId],
      quantity: 1,
      ice: '70% đá',
      sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
    })),
  });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    db = new PrismaService({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl! } } });
    service = new OrdersService(
      db,
      new InventoryService(),
      new PromotionDiscount(),
    );
    await db.$connect();
    await db.user.create({
      data: {
        id: userId,
        email: `${userId}@orders.test`,
        fullName: 'Orders test',
        passwordHash: 'not-a-login',
      },
    });
    await db.topping.create({ data: { id: toppingId, name: 'Test topping' } });
    for (const id of productIds) {
      await db.product.create({
        data: {
          id,
          name: 'Orders test',
          price: 29000,
          imageUrl: '/test.svg',
          stock: 1,
          sizes: { create: { code: 'M', name: 'Medium', extraPrice: 5000 } },
          toppings: { create: { toppingId, extraPrice: 6000 } },
        },
      });
    }
  });
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.updateMany({
      where: { id: { in: productIds } },
      data: { stock: 1, version: 1, price: 29000 },
    });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    if (!db) return;
    // Only fixtures belonging to this run; no truncate/reset or deletion of seed data.
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } } });
    await db.topping.deleteMany({ where: { id: toppingId } });
    await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: userId } });
    await db.$disconnect();
  });

  it('allows exactly one of eight concurrent last-unit orders', async () => {
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => service.create(userId, dto())),
    );
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled')).toHaveLength(1);
    for (const result of results)
      if (result.status === 'rejected')
        expect(result.reason).toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
    expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId } })).toBe(1);
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
        .stock,
    ).toBe(0);
  });

  it('rolls back an earlier product decrement if a later product has no stock', async () => {
````

````typescript
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Inject,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { InventoryService } from '../inventory/inventory.service';
import { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';
import { assertOrderTransition } from './order-state-machine';
import { ORDER_DISCOUNT, type OrderDiscount } from './order-discount';
import { orderInclude, orderResponse } from './order-response';

function money(value: number) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0 || value > 2147483647) {
    throw new BadRequestException('Giá trị đơn hàng vượt giới hạn');
  }
  return value;
}

@Injectable()
export class OrdersService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly inventory: InventoryService,
    @Inject(ORDER_DISCOUNT) private readonly discount: OrderDiscount,
  ) {}

  private async transaction<T>(
    work: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>,
  ): Promise<T> {
    try {
      return await this.prisma.$transaction(work);
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
        error.code === 'P2034'
      ) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'Đơn hàng hoặc tồn kho vừa thay đổi. Vui lòng thử lại',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async create(userId: string, dto: CreateOrderDto) {
    if (!dto.items?.length) throw new BadRequestException('Giỏ hàng trống');
    return this.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const products = await tx.product.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: [...new Set(dto.items.map((i) => i.productId))] } },
        include: { sizes: true, toppings: { include: { topping: true } } },
      });
      const items = dto.items.map((item, position) => {
        const product = products.find((p) => p.id === item.productId);
        if (!product) throw new BadRequestException('Sản phẩm không tồn tại');
        const size = product.sizes.find(
          (s) => s.code === item.size && s.available,
        );
        if (!size)
          throw new BadRequestException('Size không hợp lệ hoặc ngừng bán');
        if (new Set(item.toppingIds).size !== item.toppingIds.length) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Topping bị trùng');
        }
        const toppings = item.toppingIds.map((id) => {
          const option = product.toppings.find(
            (t) => t.toppingId === id && t.available,
          );
          if (!option)
            throw new BadRequestException(
              'Topping không hợp lệ hoặc ngừng bán',
            );
          return {
            toppingId: id,
            name: option.topping.name,
            extraPrice: money(option.extraPrice),
          };
        });
        const unitPrice = money(
          money(product.price) +
            money(size.extraPrice) +
            toppings.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.extraPrice, 0),
        );
        if (
          !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) ||
          item.quantity < 1 ||
          item.quantity > 99
        ) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Số lượng không hợp lệ');
        }
        return {
          productId: product.id,
          position,
          name: product.name,
          imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
          size: size.code,
          basePrice: product.price,
          sizePrice: size.extraPrice,
          unitPrice,
          qty: item.quantity,
          lineTotal: money(unitPrice * item.quantity),
          ice: item.ice,
          sugar: item.sugar,
          note: item.note?.trim() || null,
          toppings: { create: toppings },
        };
      });
      const subtotal = money(
        items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.lineTotal, 0),
      );
      const promotionCode = dto.promotionCode?.trim();
      if (dto.promotionCode != null && !promotionCode)
        throw new BadRequestException('Mã ưu đãi trống');
      const discountAmount = money(
        await this.discount.calculate(tx, { userId, subtotal, promotionCode }),
      );
      if (discountAmount > subtotal)
        throw new BadRequestException('Giảm giá vượt tổng đơn');
      await this.inventory.reserve(tx, items, products);
      const order = await tx.order.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          subtotal,
          discountAmount,
          total: subtotal - discountAmount,
          promotionCode,
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
          inventoryHeld: true,
          items: { create: items },
          statusHistory: {
            create: { toStatus: OrderStatus.PENDING, version: 1 },
          },
        } satisfies Prisma.OrderUncheckedCreateInput,
        include: orderInclude,
      });
      return orderResponse(order);
    });
  }

  async mine(userId: string) {
    return (
      await this.prisma.order.findMany({
        where: { userId },
        include: orderInclude,
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
      })
    ).map(orderResponse);
  }

  async get(id: string, userId: string) {
    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({
      where: { id, userId },
      include: orderInclude,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
    return orderResponse(order);
  }

  /** Internal payment retry only. Re-reserves inventory atomically and verifies ownership. */
  async preparePaymentRetry(
    id: string,
    userId: string,
    transaction?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ) {
    const prepare = async (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => {
      const owned = await tx.order.findFirst({ where: { id, userId } });
      if (!owned) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
      return orderResponse(
        await this.transitionInTransaction(tx, id, OrderStatus.PENDING),
      );
    };
    return transaction ? prepare(transaction) : this.transaction(prepare);
  }

  async staffList() {
    return (
      await this.prisma.order.findMany({
        where: {
          status: {
            in: ['PAID', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'],
          },
        },
        include: orderInclude,
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      })
    ).map(orderResponse);
  }

  async staffGet(id: string) {
    const order = await this.prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: orderInclude,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
    return orderResponse(order);
  }

  async staffCancel(id: string, reason: string) {
    return this.transaction(async (tx) =>
      orderResponse(
        await this.transitionInTransaction(
          tx,
          id,
          OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
          reason,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  async staffTransition(id: string, to: OrderStatus) {
    if (!(['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED'] as OrderStatus[]).includes(to)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Chỉ cho phép PREPARING, READY hoặc COMPLETED; hủy đơn phải dùng API cancel kèm lý do',
      );
    }
    return this.transaction(async (tx) =>
      orderResponse(await this.transitionInTransaction(tx, id, to)),
    );
  }

  /** Internal TV5/TV6 integration only. Caller MUST propagate errors to roll back its transaction.
   * Verify ownership in PaymentsModule; persist payment/idempotency/loyalty in the same tx.
   * UNKNOWN must not call this method. Retry PAYMENT_FAILED -> PENDING before gateway attempt.
   * CANCELLED requires a reason as the fourth argument, including internal callers.
   */
  async transitionInTransaction(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    id: string,
    to: OrderStatus,
    reason?: string,
  ) {
    const cancelReason = typeof reason === 'string' ? reason.trim() : '';
    if (
      to === OrderStatus.CANCELLED &&
      (!cancelReason || Array.from(cancelReason).length > 300)
    ) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Lý do hủy phải có từ 1 đến 300 ký tự');
    }
    const order = await tx.order.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: orderInclude,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
    assertOrderTransition(order.status, to);
    const release =
      to === OrderStatus.CANCELLED || to === OrderStatus.PAYMENT_FAILED;
    const reserve =
      order.status === OrderStatus.PAYMENT_FAILED && to === OrderStatus.PENDING;
    const transitionedAt = new Date();
    // Version also prevents ABA races across PAYMENT_FAILED -> PENDING retry cycles.
    const changed = await tx.order.updateMany({
      where: { id, status: order.status, version: order.version },
      data: {
        status: to,
        version: { increment: 1 },
        inventoryHeld: release ? false : reserve ? true : order.inventoryHeld,
        ...(to === OrderStatus.CANCELLED ? { cancelReason } : {}),
        ...(to === OrderStatus.COMPLETED
          ? { completedAt: transitionedAt }
          : {}),
      },
    });
    if (changed.count !== 1)
      throw new ConflictException('Đơn hàng vừa thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại');
    if (release && order.inventoryHeld)
      await this.inventory.restore(tx, order.items);
    if (reserve) await this.inventory.reserve(tx, order.items);
    await tx.orderStatusHistory.create({
      data: {
        orderId: id,
        fromStatus: order.status,
        toStatus: to,
        version: order.version + 1,
        createdAt: transitionedAt,
      },
    });
    return tx.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: orderInclude });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Patch,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';
import { IsIn, IsString, Length } from 'class-validator';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { Roles } from '../auth/roles.decorator';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/roles.guard';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';

export class StaffStatusDto {
  @IsIn(['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED']) status: OrderStatus;
}

export class CancelOrderDto {
  @Transform(({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
    typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : value,
  )
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 300)
  reason: string;
}

@Controller('staff/orders')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.BARISTA)
export class StaffOrdersController {
  constructor(private readonly orders: OrdersService) {}

  @Get()
  list() {
    return this.orders.staffList();
  }

  @Get(':id')
  get(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.orders.staffGet(id);
  }

  @Patch(':id/cancel')
  cancel(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() dto: CancelOrderDto) {
    return this.orders.staffCancel(id, dto.reason);
  }

  @Patch(':id/status')
  transition(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: StaffStatusDto,
  ) {
    return this.orders.staffTransition(id, dto.status);
  }
}
````

````typescript
  const patch = (id: string, action: string, body: object) =>
    request(app.getHttpServer())
      .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${id}/${action}`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send(body);
  const cancel = (id: string, reason = ' Hết nguyên liệu ') =>
    patch(id, 'cancel', { reason });

    patch(id, 'status', { status });
  const row = (id: string) => db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
  const stock = async () =>
    (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).stock;

    db.orderStatusHistory.findMany({
      where: { orderId: id },
      orderBy: { version: 'asc' },
    });

  async function create(status: OrderStatus = 'PENDING') {
    const order = await service.create(customerId, {
      items: [
        {

          ice: '70% đá',

          note: 'Ít nóng',
        },
      ],
    });
    if (status === 'PAYMENT_FAILED') {
      await db.$transaction((tx) =>
        service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, status),

    } else if (status !== 'PENDING') {
      // Payment integration boundary: the staff HTTP API must never mark PAID.
      await db.$transaction((tx) =>
        service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PAID'),

      for (const next of ['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED'] as const) {
        if ((await row(order.id)).status === status) break;
        await service.staffTransition(order.id, next);

      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(

      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
````

````typescript
import { IsIn, IsOptional, IsUUID } from 'class-validator';
import type { PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus } from '@prisma/client';

export class CreatePaymentDto {
  @IsUUID()
  orderId!: string;

  @IsIn(['WALLET', 'CARD'])
  method!: PaymentMethod;

  @IsUUID()
  idempotencyKey!: string;

  /** Sandbox only; ignored unless PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS=true on the server. */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsIn(['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN'])
  demoOutcome?: Exclude<PaymentStatus, 'PROCESSING'>;
}
````

````typescript
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from '@jest/globals';
import { MockPaymentGateway } from './mock-payment.gateway';

describe('MockPaymentGateway sandbox controls', () => {
  const originalControls = process.env.PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS;
  const originalOutcome = process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME;
  const gateway = new MockPaymentGateway();

  afterEach(() => {
    if (originalControls === undefined) delete process.env.PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS;
    else process.env.PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS = originalControls;
    if (originalOutcome === undefined) delete process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME;
    else process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = originalOutcome;
  });

  it('honors a per-request outcome only when sandbox controls are enabled', async () => {
    process.env.PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS = 'true';
    await expect(
      gateway.charge({ demoOutcome: 'PAYMENT_FAILED' }),
    ).resolves.toBe('PAYMENT_FAILED');

    process.env.PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS = 'false';
    process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'PAID';
    await expect(
      gateway.charge({ demoOutcome: 'PAYMENT_FAILED' }),
    ).resolves.toBe('PAID');
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { PaymentGateway, PaymentResultStatus } from './payment.types';

const publicStatuses = ['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN'] as const;

@Injectable()
export class MockPaymentGateway implements PaymentGateway {
  async charge(input: {
    demoOutcome?: PaymentResultStatus;
  }): Promise<PaymentResultStatus> {
    if (process.env.PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS === 'true' && input.demoOutcome) {
      return input.demoOutcome;
    }
    const configured = process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME;
    return publicStatuses.includes(
      configured as (typeof publicStatuses)[number],
    )
      ? (configured as PaymentResultStatus)
      : 'PAID';
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';

const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;

describeDatabase(
  'Payment consistency migration against legacy rows (PostgreSQL)',
  () => {
    let db: PrismaService;
    const migration = readFileSync(
      resolve(
        process.cwd(),
        'prisma/migrations/20261017000000_payment_consistency/migration.sql',
      ),
      'utf8',
    )
      .replace(/--[^\n]*/g, '')
      .split(';')
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter((s) => s && s !== 'BEGIN' && s !== 'COMMIT');

    beforeAll(async () => {
      db = new PrismaService({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl! } } });
      await db.$connect();
    });
    afterAll(async () => {
      await db?.$disconnect();
    });

    it('preserves legacy final results without inventing a journal or applied timestamp', async () => {
      await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        // pg_temp shadows payments only inside this connection/transaction.
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
          'CREATE TEMP TABLE payments (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, order_id UUID NOT NULL, status "PaymentStatus" NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP',
        );
        for (const status of ['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN']) {
          await tx.$executeRaw`INSERT INTO payments(id, order_id, status) VALUES (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${status}::"PaymentStatus")`;
        }
        for (const sql of migration) await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(sql);
        const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<
          Array<{
            status: string;
            gateway_status: string | null;
            applied_at: Date | null;
          }>
        >`SELECT status, gateway_status, applied_at FROM payments ORDER BY status`;
        expect(rows).toHaveLength(3);
        for (const row of rows)
          expect(row).toMatchObject({ gateway_status: null, applied_at: null });
        expect(rows.map((r) => r.status).sort()).toEqual(
          ['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN'].sort(),
        );
      });
    });

    it('refuses duplicate live legacy attempts instead of silently deleting financial rows', async () => {
      await expect(
        db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
            'CREATE TEMP TABLE payments (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, order_id UUID NOT NULL, status "PaymentStatus" NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP',
          );
          const orderId = randomUUID();
          for (const status of ['PAID', 'PROCESSING']) {
            await tx.$executeRaw`INSERT INTO payments(id, order_id, status) VALUES (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${orderId}::uuid, ${status}::"PaymentStatus")`;
          }
          for (const sql of migration) await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(sql);
        }),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'P2010', meta: { code: '23505' } });
    });
  },
);
````

````typescript
      port = module.get<PaymentOrderPort>(PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT);
      const jwt = module.get(JwtService);
      ownerCookie = `brewlite_session=${jwt.sign({ sub: ownerId, sessionVersion: 0 })}`;
      otherCookie = `brewlite_session=${jwt.sign({ sub: otherId, sessionVersion: 0 })}`;
      app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
      app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
      app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
      app.useGlobalPipes(
        new ValidationPipe({
          whitelist: true,
          forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
          transform: true,
        }),
      );
      await app.init();
    });

    beforeEach(async () => {
      process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'PAID';
      await db.payment.deleteMany({
        where: { userId: { in: [ownerId, otherId] } },
      });
      await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId: ownerId } });
      await db.user.updateMany({
        where: { id: { in: [ownerId, otherId] } },
        data: { loyaltyPoints: 7 },
      });
      await db.product.update({
        where: { id: productId },
        data: { stock: 2, version: 1 },
      });
      const order = await orders.create(ownerId, {
        items: [
          {
            productId,
            size: 'M',
            toppingIds: [],
            quantity: 1,
            ice: '70% đá',
            sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
          },
        ],
      });
      orderId = order.id;
    });

    afterAll(async () => {
      try {
        if (db) {
          await db.payment.deleteMany({
            where: { userId: { in: [ownerId, otherId] } },
          });
          await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId: ownerId } });
          await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: productId } });
          await db.user.deleteMany({
            where: { id: { in: [ownerId, otherId] } },
          });
        }
      } finally {
        await app?.close();
        await db?.$disconnect();
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(savedEnv)) {
          if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
          else process.env[key] = value;
        }
      }
    });

    const pay = (cookie = ownerCookie, extra = {}) =>
      request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/payments')
        .set('Cookie', cookie)
        .set('Origin', origin)
        .send({
          orderId,
          method: 'CARD',
          idempotencyKey: randomUUID(),
          ...extra,
        });
    const storedOrder = () =>
      db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: orderId },
        include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
      });
    const points = async () =>
      (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ownerId } }))
        .loyaltyPoints;

    it.each(['CARD', 'WALLET'] as const)(
      'PAID maps to PAID and credits existing points policy (%s)',
      async (method) => {
        const response = await pay(ownerCookie, { method }).expect(201);
        expect(response.body).toMatchObject({
          orderId,
          method,
          status: 'PAID',
        });
        const order = await storedOrder();
        expect(order).toMatchObject({
          status: 'PAID',
          inventoryHeld: true,
          version: 2,
        });
        expect(order.statusHistory.map((h) => h.toStatus)).toEqual([
          'PENDING',
          'PAID',
        ]);
        expect(await points()).toBe(9);
        expect(
          (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } }))
            .stock,
        ).toBe(1);
        expect(
          await db.payment.findUniqueOrThrow({
            where: { id: response.body.id },
          }),
        ).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAID', amount: 25000 });
      },
    );

    it('PAYMENT_FAILED follows the state machine, releases stock and does not credit points', async () => {
      process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'PAYMENT_FAILED';
      const response = await pay().expect(201);
      expect(response.body.status).toBe('PAYMENT_FAILED');
      const order = await storedOrder();
      expect(order).toMatchObject({
        status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
        inventoryHeld: false,
        version: 2,
      });
      expect(order.statusHistory).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(await points()).toBe(7);
      expect(
        (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } }))
          .stock,
      ).toBe(2);
    });

    it.each(['PENDING', 'PAYMENT_FAILED'] as const)(
      'UNKNOWN preserves %s, stock/history and points',
      async (status) => {
        if (status === 'PAYMENT_FAILED')
          await db.$transaction((tx) =>
            orders.transitionInTransaction(tx, orderId, status),
          );
        const before = await storedOrder();
        const stockBefore = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({
          where: { id: productId },
        });
        process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'UNKNOWN';
        if (status === 'PAYMENT_FAILED') {
          // The adapter preserves failed state; a new HTTP attempt now reserves
          // stock and moves back to PENDING before calling any gateway.
          await port.applyPaymentResult({
            orderId,
            userId: ownerId,
            method: 'CARD',
            status: 'UNKNOWN',
          });
        } else {
          expect((await pay().expect(201)).body.status).toBe('UNKNOWN');
        }
        expect(await storedOrder()).toEqual(before);
        expect(
          await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } }),
        ).toEqual(stockBefore);
        expect(await points()).toBe(7);
      },
    );

    it('rejects another customer before creating a Payment or changing the order', async () => {
      await pay(otherCookie).expect(404);
      expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId } })).toBe(0);
      expect(await storedOrder()).toMatchObject({
        status: 'PENDING',
        version: 1,
      });
      expect(await points()).toBe(7);
    });

    it.each(['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN'] as const)(
      'the adapter itself checks ownership for %s',
      async (status) => {
        await expect(
          port.applyPaymentResult({
            orderId,
            userId: otherId,
            method: 'CARD',
            status,
          }),
        ).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 404 });
        expect(await storedOrder()).toMatchObject({
          status: 'PENDING',
          version: 1,
        });
        expect(await points()).toBe(7);
      },
    );

    it.each([
      { status: 'PAID' },
      { status: 'SUCCESS' },
      { userId: otherId },
      { amount: 1 },
    ])(
      'rejects client-controlled payment result/identity/price %j',
      async (extra) => {
        await pay(ownerCookie, extra).expect(400);
        expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId } })).toBe(0);
        expect(await storedOrder()).toMatchObject({
          status: 'PENDING',
          version: 1,
        });
      },
    );

    it('requires authentication', async () => {
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/payments')
        .set('Origin', origin)
        .send({ orderId, method: 'CARD', idempotencyKey: randomUUID() })
        .expect(401);
      expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId } })).toBe(0);
    });

    it('keeps the real state machine guard when applying PAID to a cancelled order', async () => {
      await orders.staffCancel(orderId, 'Khách yêu cầu hủy');
      await expect(
        port.applyPaymentResult({
          orderId,
          userId: ownerId,
          method: 'CARD',
          status: 'PAID',
        }),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
      expect(await storedOrder()).toMatchObject({
        status: 'CANCELLED',
        inventoryHeld: false,
        version: 2,
      });
      expect(await points()).toBe(7);
    });
  },
);
````

````typescript
import type { PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export const PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT = Symbol('PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT');
export const PAYMENT_GATEWAY = Symbol('PAYMENT_GATEWAY');

export type PaymentResultStatus = Exclude<PaymentStatus, 'PROCESSING'>;

export type PayableOrder = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  total: number;
  status: string;
};

export interface PaymentOrderPort {
  findOwned(orderId: string, userId: string): Promise<PayableOrder | null>;
  prepareAttempt(
    input: { orderId: string; userId: string },
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<PayableOrder>;
  applyPaymentResult(
    input: {
      orderId: string;
      userId: string;
      method: PaymentMethod;
      status: PaymentResultStatus;
    },
    tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<void>;
}

export interface PaymentGateway {
  charge(input: {
    orderId: string;
    amount: number;
    method: PaymentMethod;
    // Stable provider key of the persisted attempt; never regenerated on replay.
    idempotencyKey: string;
    demoOutcome?: PaymentResultStatus;
  }): Promise<PaymentResultStatus>;
}
````

````typescript
import { Body, Controller, Post, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { CreatePaymentDto } from './dto/create-payment.dto';
import { PaymentsService } from './payments.service';

@Controller('payments')
export class PaymentsController {
  constructor(private readonly payments: PaymentsService) {}

  @Post()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  pay(
    @Req() request: Request & { user: { userId: string } },
    @Body() input: CreatePaymentDto,
  ) {
    return this.payments.pay(request.user.userId, input);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { ValidationPipe, type INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import request from 'supertest';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { PaymentsController } from './payments.controller';
import { PaymentsService } from './payments.service';

describe('Payments HTTP contract', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  const pay = jest.fn<PaymentsService['pay']>();
  const orderId = '21a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
  const idempotencyKey = '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [PaymentsController],
      providers: [{ provide: PaymentsService, useValue: { pay } }],
    })
      .overrideGuard(JwtAuthGuard)
      .useValue({
        canActivate: (context: {
          switchToHttp(): { getRequest(): { user?: { userId: string } } };
        }) => {
          context.switchToHttp().getRequest().user = { userId: 'customer-1' };
          return true;
        },
      })
      .compile();

    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true }),
    );
    await app.init();
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    pay.mockReset().mockResolvedValue({
      id: '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
      orderId,
      method: 'CARD',
      status: 'PAID',
      idempotencyKey,
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('accepts the documented payment request for the authenticated user', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, method: 'CARD', idempotencyKey })
      .expect(201)
      .expect({
        id: '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
        orderId,
        method: 'CARD',
        status: 'PAID',
        idempotencyKey,
      });
    expect(pay).toHaveBeenCalledWith('customer-1', {
      orderId,
      method: 'CARD',
      idempotencyKey,
    });
  });

  it('rejects unsupported methods and malformed idempotency keys', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, method: 'CASH', idempotencyKey: 'same-key' })
      .expect(400);
    expect(pay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('accepts a validated sandbox outcome without trusting arbitrary values', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({
        orderId,
        method: 'CARD',
        idempotencyKey,
        demoOutcome: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      })
      .expect(201);
    expect(pay).toHaveBeenCalledWith('customer-1', {
      orderId,
      method: 'CARD',
      idempotencyKey,
      demoOutcome: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
    });

    pay.mockClear();
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, method: 'CARD', idempotencyKey, demoOutcome: 'SUCCESS' })
      .expect(400);
    expect(pay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects extra identity fields instead of trusting the client', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, method: 'WALLET', idempotencyKey, userId: 'attacker' })
      .expect(400);
    expect(pay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
````

````typescript
import type { DynamicModule, ModuleMetadata, Provider } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthModule } from '../auth/auth.module';
import { MockPaymentGateway } from './mock-payment.gateway';
import { PAYMENT_GATEWAY } from './payment.types';
import { PaymentsController } from './payments.controller';
import { PaymentsRepository } from './payments.repository';
import { PaymentsService } from './payments.service';

type PaymentsModuleOptions = {
  imports?: ModuleMetadata['imports'];
  orderProvider: Provider;
};

@Module({})
export class PaymentsModule {
  static register(options: PaymentsModuleOptions): DynamicModule {
    return {
      module: PaymentsModule,
      imports: [AuthModule, ...(options.imports ?? [])],
      controllers: [PaymentsController],
      providers: [
        options.orderProvider,
        PaymentsRepository,
        PaymentsService,
        MockPaymentGateway,
        { provide: PAYMENT_GATEWAY, useExisting: MockPaymentGateway },
      ],
      exports: [PaymentsService],
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { ValidationPipe, type INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test, type TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../app.module';
import { cookieOriginGuard } from '../auth/csrf.middleware';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';

// Opt in with a migrated, dedicated test database. Never fall back to DATABASE_URL.
const databaseUrl = process.env.PAYMENTS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;

describeDatabase('Payments and Orders PostgreSQL integration', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let module: TestingModule;
  let db: PrismaService;
  const userId = randomUUID();
  const productId = randomUUID();
  const origin = 'http://localhost:3000';

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'payments-postgres-http-test-only';
    process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN = origin;
    db = new PrismaService({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl! } } });
    await db.$connect();
    await db.user.create({
      data: {
        id: userId,
        email: `${userId}@payments.test`,
        fullName: 'Payments test',
        passwordHash: 'not-a-login',
      },
    });
    await db.product.create({
      data: {
        id: productId,
        name: 'Payment test coffee',
        price: 40000,
        imageUrl: '/test.svg',
        stock: 5,
        sizes: {
          create: {
            code: 'M',
            name: 'Medium',
            extraPrice: 0,
            isDefault: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue(db)
      .compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );
    await app.init();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'PAID';
    await db.payment.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: productId },
      data: { stock: 5, version: 1 },
    });
    await db.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { loyaltyPoints: 0 },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    delete process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME;
    if (app) await app.close();
    if (!db) return;
    await db.payment.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: productId } });
    await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: userId } });
    await db.$disconnect();
  });

  const cookie = () =>
    `brewlite_session=${module
      .get(JwtService)
      .sign({ sub: userId, sessionVersion: 0 })}`;

  const createOrder = async () => {
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/orders')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', origin)
      .send({
        items: [
          {
            productId,
            size: 'M',
            toppingIds: [],
            quantity: 1,
            ice: '70% đá',
            sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
          },
        ],
      })
      .expect(201);
    return response.body as { id: string; total: number };
  };

  const pay = (orderId: string, idempotencyKey: string) =>
    request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', origin)
      .send({ orderId, method: 'CARD', idempotencyKey });

  it('persists one payment, marks the order PAID and replays without duplicate data', async () => {
    const order = await createOrder();
    const idempotencyKey = randomUUID();
    const first = await pay(order.id, idempotencyKey).expect(201);
    expect(first.body).toMatchObject({
      orderId: order.id,
      method: 'CARD',
      status: 'PAID',
      idempotencyKey,
    });

    const persistedPayment = await db.payment.findFirstOrThrow({
      where: { userId, orderId: order.id },
    });
    const persistedOrder = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id: order.id },
      include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
    });
    const persistedUser = await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id: userId },
    });
    expect(persistedPayment).toMatchObject({
      amount: order.total,
      status: 'PAID',
      idempotencyKey,
    });
    expect(persistedOrder.status).toBe('PAID');
    expect(persistedOrder.statusHistory.map((row) => row.toStatus)).toEqual([
      'PENDING',
      'PAID',
    ]);
    expect(persistedUser.loyaltyPoints).toBe(4);

    const paidOrder = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get(`/api/orders/${order.id}`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .expect(200);
    expect(paidOrder.body).toMatchObject({
      id: order.id,
      status: 'PAID',
      paymentMethod: 'CARD',
    });

    await pay(order.id, idempotencyKey).expect(201, first.body);
    expect(
      await db.payment.count({ where: { userId, orderId: order.id } }),
    ).toBe(1);
    expect(
      await db.orderStatusHistory.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } }),
    ).toBe(2);
    expect(
      (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: userId } }))
        .loyaltyPoints,
    ).toBe(4);
  });

  it('persists failure, restores stock, then reserves it again for a paid retry', async () => {
    const order = await createOrder();
    process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'PAYMENT_FAILED';
    await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(201);
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: order.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED', inventoryHeld: false });
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).stock,
    ).toBe(5);

    process.env.MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME = 'PAID';
    await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(201);
    const retriedOrder = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id: order.id },
      include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
    });
    expect(retriedOrder).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAID', inventoryHeld: true });
    expect(retriedOrder.statusHistory.map((row) => row.toStatus)).toEqual([
      'PENDING',
      'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      'PENDING',
      'PAID',
    ]);
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).stock,
    ).toBe(4);
    expect(
      await db.payment.findMany({
        where: { userId, orderId: order.id },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
        select: { status: true },
      }),
    ).toEqual([{ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED' }, { status: 'PAID' }]);
  });

  it('enforces the payment order foreign key', async () => {
    await expect(
      db.payment.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          orderId: randomUUID(),
          amount: 40000,
          method: 'CARD',
          status: 'PAID',
          idempotencyKey: randomUUID(),
        },
      }),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'P2003' });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, type PaymentMethod } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import type { PaymentResultStatus } from './payment.types';

type ClaimInput = {
  userId: string;
  orderId: string;
  amount: number;
  method: PaymentMethod;
  idempotencyKey: string;
};

@Injectable()
export class PaymentsRepository {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async withOrderLock<T>(
    orderId: string,
    userId: string,
    work: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>,
  ): Promise<T> {
    try {
      return await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const owned = await tx.$queryRaw<{ id: string }[]>(Prisma.sql`
          SELECT id FROM orders
          WHERE id = ${orderId}::uuid AND user_id = ${userId}::uuid
          FOR UPDATE
        `);
        if (!owned.length)
          throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
        return work(tx);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
        ['P2002', 'P2034'].includes(error.code)
      ) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'Yêu cầu thanh toán trùng hoặc đơn hàng vừa thay đổi',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  findByKey(
    userId: string,
    idempotencyKey: string,
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ) {
    return tx.payment.findUnique({
      where: { userId_idempotencyKey: { userId, idempotencyKey } },
    });
  }

  findBlockingAttempt(orderId: string, tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    return tx.payment.findFirst({
      where: { orderId, status: { in: ['PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN', 'PAID'] } },
    });
  }

  async claim(input: ClaimInput, tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    return tx.payment.create({ data: { ...input, status: 'PROCESSING' } });
  }

  // Commit the gateway journal BEFORE applying Order/points. If it fails,
  // leave PROCESSING blocked for reconciliation; never charge again automatically.
  async recordGatewayResult(id: string, status: PaymentResultStatus) {
    const recorded = await this.prisma.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id, status: 'PROCESSING', gatewayStatus: null },
      data: { gatewayStatus: status },
    });
    if (recorded.count !== 1)
      throw new ConflictException('Kết quả gateway đã thay đổi');
  }

  async finalize(
    id: string,
    status: PaymentResultStatus,
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ) {
    return tx.payment.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { status, appliedAt: new Date() },
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { ConflictException, Inject, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Payment, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { CreatePaymentDto } from './dto/create-payment.dto';
import {
  PAYMENT_GATEWAY,
  PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT,
  type PaymentGateway,
  type PaymentOrderPort,
  type PaymentResultStatus,
} from './payment.types';
import { PaymentsRepository } from './payments.repository';

@Injectable()
export class PaymentsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly payments: PaymentsRepository,
    @Inject(PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT) private readonly orders: PaymentOrderPort,
    @Inject(PAYMENT_GATEWAY) private readonly gateway: PaymentGateway,
  ) {}

  async pay(userId: string, input: CreatePaymentDto) {
    const started = await this.payments.withOrderLock(
      input.orderId,
      userId,
      async (tx) => {
        const existing = await this.payments.findByKey(
          userId,
          input.idempotencyKey,
          tx,
        );
        if (existing) {
          if (
            existing.orderId !== input.orderId ||
            existing.method !== input.method
          ) {
            throw new ConflictException(
              'Idempotency key đã được dùng cho yêu cầu khác',
            );
          }
          return {
            kind: 'replay' as const,
            payment: await this.settle(existing, tx),
          };
        }
        if (await this.payments.findBlockingAttempt(input.orderId, tx)) {
          throw new ConflictException(
            'Đơn hàng đã thanh toán hoặc có lần thanh toán chưa được xác minh',
          );
        }
        // Retry stock reservation and the new claim share this transaction.
        const order = await this.orders.prepareAttempt(
          { orderId: input.orderId, userId },
          tx,
        );
        const payment = await this.payments.claim(
          {
            userId,
            orderId: order.id,
            amount: order.total,
            method: input.method,
            idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,
          },
          tx,
        );
        return { kind: 'charge' as const, payment };
      },
    );
    if (started.kind === 'replay') return this.toResponse(started.payment);

    // No database transaction/lock is held during the external gateway call.
    let status: PaymentResultStatus;
    try {
      status = await this.gateway.charge({
        orderId: started.payment.orderId,
        amount: started.payment.amount,
        method: started.payment.method,
        idempotencyKey: started.payment.id,
        ...(input.demoOutcome ? { demoOutcome: input.demoOutcome } : {}),
      });
    } catch {
      status = 'UNKNOWN';
    }
    await this.payments.recordGatewayResult(started.payment.id, status);
    const payment = await this.payments.withOrderLock(
      input.orderId,
      userId,
      async (tx) => {
        const current = await this.payments.findByKey(
          userId,
          input.idempotencyKey,
          tx,
        );
        if (!current)
          throw new ConflictException('Không tìm thấy lần thanh toán');
        return this.settle(current, tx);
      },
    );
    return this.toResponse(payment);
  }

  private async settle(
    payment: Payment,
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<Payment> {
    // Final responses are immutable, including legacy rows; never replay points.
    if (payment.status !== 'PROCESSING') return payment;
    const status = payment.gatewayStatus;
    if (!status || status === 'PROCESSING') {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Yêu cầu thanh toán đang xử lý hoặc chờ đối soát',
      );
    }
    await this.orders.applyPaymentResult(
      {
        orderId: payment.orderId,
        userId: payment.userId,
        method: payment.method,
        status,
      },
      tx,
    );
    // Atomic with Order/stock/history/points. Rollback retains the committed
    // journal so replay can recover with the same key and no gateway call.
    return this.payments.finalize(payment.id, status, tx);
  }

  private toResponse(payment: Payment) {
    return {
      id: payment.id,
      orderId: payment.orderId,
      method: payment.method,
      status: payment.status,
      idempotencyKey: payment.idempotencyKey,
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';

describe('Product detail HTTP', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  const findUnique = jest.fn<() => Promise<ProductDetailRecord | null>>();
  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [ProductsModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue({ product: { findUnique } }).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    await app.init();
  });
  beforeEach(() => findUnique.mockReset());
  afterAll(async () => { await app?.close(); });

  it('returns the direct contract without auth, with integer extras and an owned default', async () => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${record.id}`).expect(200).expect('Content-Type', /json/);
    expect(Object.keys(response.body).sort()).toEqual(['defaultSizeId', 'description', 'id', 'imageUrl', 'name', 'price', 'sizes', 'stock', 'toppings']);
    expect(response.body.price).toBe(29000);
    expect(response.body.sizes).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(response.body.defaultSizeId).toBe(record.sizes[1].id);
    expect(response.body.sizes.some((size: { id: string; available: boolean }) => size.id === response.body.defaultSizeId && size.available)).toBe(true);
    for (const size of response.body.sizes) {
      expect(Object.keys(size).sort()).toEqual(['available', 'code', 'extraPrice', 'id', 'name']);
      expect(Number.isInteger(size.extraPrice) && size.extraPrice >= 0).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(response.body.toppings).toEqual(record.toppings.map(({ topping, ...option }) => ({ ...topping, ...option })));
    expect(response.body.stock).toBe(record.stock);
  });

  it.each(['not-a-uuid', '123', '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-00000000000z'])('rejects malformed id before querying: %s', async (id) => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${id}`).expect(400);
    expect(findUnique).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('accepts UUIDs written in uppercase', async () => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${record.id.toUpperCase()}`).expect(200);
    expect(response.body.id).toBe(record.id);
  });

  it('returns 404 for a valid UUID with no product', async () => {
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/products/31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000999').expect(404);
    expect(response.body.message).toBe('Product not found');
  });

  it('returns generic 500 for query failures without a trace or connection details', async () => {
    findUnique.mockRejectedValue(new Error('postgresql://private-user:private-password@db.internal/catalog'));
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${productDetailFixture().id}`).expect(500);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' });
    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('stack');
    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toMatch(/private-password|db\.internal/);
  });

  it('returns 500 for existing products without options instead of a fake detail or 404', async () => {
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ ...productDetailFixture(), sizes: [] });
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${productDetailFixture().id}`).expect(500);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal Server Error' });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { InternalServerErrorException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { ProductsService } from './products.service';
import { productDetailSelect, type ProductDetailRecord } from './product-detail';
import { productDetailFixture } from '../../test/fixtures/product-detail';

describe('Product detail service', () => {
  const findUnique = jest.fn<() => Promise<ProductDetailRecord | null>>();
  let service: ProductsService;
  beforeEach(() => {
    findUnique.mockReset();
    service = new ProductsService({ product: { findUnique } } as unknown as PrismaService);
  });

  it('queries the requested UUID and projects detail with its own default and availability', async () => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    const detail = await service.findOne(record.id);
    expect(findUnique).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ where: { id: record.id }, select: productDetailSelect });
    expect(detail.defaultSizeId).toBe(record.sizes[1].id);
    expect(detail.sizes.map((size) => size.code)).toEqual(['S', 'M', 'L']);
    expect(detail.sizes[2].available).toBe(false);
    expect(detail.toppings[1]).toEqual({ ...record.toppings[1].topping, extraPrice: 6000, available: false });
    expect(detail.sizes[0]).not.toHaveProperty('isDefault');
  });

  it('allows no toppings and an empty description', async () => {
    const record = { ...productDetailFixture(), toppings: [], description: '' };
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    await expect(service.findOne(record.id)).resolves.toMatchObject({ toppings: [], description: '' });
  });

  it('returns NotFound only when the product does not exist', async () => {
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.findOne(productDetailFixture().id)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
  });

  it('propagates a database error for generic Nest exception handling', async () => {
    const failure = new Error('Database connection failed');
    findUnique.mockRejectedValue(failure);
    await expect(service.findOne(productDetailFixture().id)).rejects.toBe(failure);
  });

  it.each(['missing-default', 'duplicate-default', 'unavailable-default', 'missing-size', 'negative-size', 'negative-topping'])('rejects invalid configuration: %s', async (scenario) => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    if (scenario === 'missing-default') record.sizes[1].isDefault = false;
    if (scenario === 'duplicate-default') record.sizes[0].isDefault = true;
    if (scenario === 'unavailable-default') record.sizes[1].available = false;
    if (scenario === 'missing-size') record.sizes.pop();
    if (scenario === 'negative-size') record.sizes[0].extraPrice = -1;
    if (scenario === 'negative-topping') record.toppings[0].extraPrice = -1;
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    await expect(service.findOne(record.id)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(InternalServerErrorException);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export const productDetailSelect = {
  id: true,
  name: true,
  description: true,
  imageUrl: true,
  price: true,
  stock: true,
  sizes: {
    select: { id: true, code: true, name: true, extraPrice: true, available: true, isDefault: true },
    orderBy: { code: 'asc' },
  },
  toppings: {
    select: { extraPrice: true, available: true, topping: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
    orderBy: { toppingId: 'asc' },
  },
} satisfies Prisma.ProductSelect;

export type ProductDetailRecord = Prisma.ProductGetPayload<{ select: typeof productDetailSelect }>;
export type ProductDetail = Omit<ProductDetailRecord, 'sizes' | 'toppings'> & {
  sizes: Omit<ProductDetailRecord['sizes'][number], 'isDefault'>[];
  toppings: { id: string; name: string; extraPrice: number; available: boolean }[];
  defaultSizeId: string;
};
````

````typescript
  constructor(private readonly products: ProductsService) {}
````

````typescript
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import request from 'supertest';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { ProductsModule } from './products.module';

// Exercises real Nest routing and exception handling with a mocked database.
// This suite does not measure database or production API performance.
describe('Products HTTP contract', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  const findMany = jest.fn<() => Promise<ProductListItem[]>>();
  const findUnique = jest.fn<() => Promise<null>>();
  const product = {
    id: '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
    name: 'Bạc xỉu',
    price: 29000,
    imageUrl: '/images/products/sample-milk-coffee.svg',
    stock: 40,
    description: 'Cà phê và sữa, phục vụ lạnh.',
  };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [ProductsModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue({ product: { findMany, findUnique } })
      .compile();

    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.enableCors({ origin: ['http://localhost:3000', 'http://localhost:3001'] });
    await app.init();
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    findMany.mockReset();
    findUnique.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(null);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('returns HTTP 200 and the public array without authentication', async () => {
    findMany.mockResolvedValue([product]);

    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/products')
      .expect('Content-Type', /json/)
      .expect(200);

    expect(response.body).toEqual([product]);
    expect(Object.keys(response.body[0]).sort()).toEqual(['description', 'id', 'imageUrl', 'name', 'price', 'stock']);
    expect(Number.isInteger(response.body[0].price)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns HTTP 200 with [] for an empty database result', async () => {
    findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/products').expect(200, []);
  });

  it('returns generic HTTP 500 without exposing database connection details', async () => {
    findMany.mockRejectedValue(new Error('postgresql://private-user:private-password@db.internal/catalog'));

    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/products').expect(500);

    expect(response.body).toEqual({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' });
    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toContain('private-password');
    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toContain('db.internal');
  });

  it('allows the configured local frontend origin to read the response', async () => {
    findMany.mockResolvedValue([product]);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/products')
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3001')
      .expect('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'http://localhost:3001')
      .expect(200, [product]);
  });

  it('requires the existing /api prefix', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/products').expect(404);
    expect(findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns 404 for an unknown detail without changing the list query', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${product.id}`).expect(404);
    expect(findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(findUnique).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not add a product creation endpoint', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/products').send(product).expect(404);
    expect(findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, InternalServerErrorException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Product } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { productDetailSelect, type ProductDetail } from './product-detail';

export type ProductListItem = Pick<Product, 'id' | 'name' | 'price' | 'imageUrl' | 'stock' | 'description'>;

@Injectable()
export class ProductsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll(): Promise<ProductListItem[]> {
    return this.prisma.product.findMany({
      select: { id: true, name: true, price: true, imageUrl: true, stock: true, description: true },
      orderBy: [{ name: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: string): Promise<ProductDetail> {
    const product = await this.prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: productDetailSelect });
    if (!product) throw new NotFoundException('Product not found');

    const defaults = product.sizes.filter((size) => size.isDefault);
    if (
      product.sizes.length !== 3 || new Set(product.sizes.map((size) => size.code)).size !== 3 ||
      defaults.length !== 1 || !defaults[0].available ||
      product.sizes.some((size) => !Number.isInteger(size.extraPrice) || size.extraPrice < 0) ||
      product.toppings.some((option) => !Number.isInteger(option.extraPrice) || option.extraPrice < 0)
    ) {
      // Existing products without configuration are a server data error, never a fake 404/default.
      throw new InternalServerErrorException();
    }

    return {
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      description: product.description,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
      price: product.price,
      stock: product.stock,
      sizes: product.sizes.map((size) => ({
        id: size.id, code: size.code, name: size.name, extraPrice: size.extraPrice, available: size.available,
      })),
      toppings: product.toppings.map(({ topping, extraPrice, available }) => ({ ...topping, extraPrice, available })),
      defaultSizeId: defaults[0].id,
    };
  }
}
````

````javascript
// Run against the local Compose PostgreSQL server. Each run owns a fresh database.
// DATABASE_URL is inherited from Compose; credentials are never printed.
const { randomUUID } = require('node:crypto');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');

async function main() {
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is required');
  const databaseName = `brewlite_orders_test_${randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')}`;
  if (!/^brewlite_orders_test_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(databaseName)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid test database name');
  }
  const admin = new PrismaClient();
  const testUrl = new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL);
  testUrl.pathname = `/${databaseName}`;
  testUrl.searchParams.set('schema', 'public');
  const env = {
    ...process.env,
    DATABASE_URL: testUrl.toString(),
    ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL: testUrl.toString(),
    PAYMENTS_TEST_DATABASE_URL: testUrl.toString(),
  };
  let created = false;
  try {
    await admin.$executeRawUnsafe(`CREATE DATABASE "${databaseName}"`);
    created = true;
    console.log(`Created isolated test database: ${databaseName}`);
    for (const args of [
      ['node_modules/prisma/build/index.js', 'migrate', 'deploy'],
      ['--experimental-vm-modules', 'node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js', '--runInBand'],
    ]) {
      const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, { env, stdio: 'inherit' });
      if (result.error || result.status !== 0) {
        throw new Error(`Verification command failed (exit ${result.status})`);
      }
    }
  } finally {
    try {
      if (created) {
        // Exact UUID name created by this process only; never target the application DB.
        await admin.$executeRawUnsafe(`DROP DATABASE "${databaseName}"`);
        console.log(`Removed isolated test database: ${databaseName}`);
      }
    } finally {
      await admin.$disconnect();
    }
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error.code || error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
````

````javascript
    windowsHide: true,
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],

  // Both streams share one file; close it only after the child has closed both.
  child.stdout.pipe(log, { end: false });
  child.stderr.pipe(log, { end: false });
````
