````javascript
    const ticket = staffPage
      .locator('.barista-ticket')
      .filter({ hasText: `#${order.id}` });
    await expect(ticket).toBeVisible();
    await expect(ticket).toContainText('Size L');
    await expect(ticket).toContainText(topping.name);
    await expect(
      staffPage
        .locator('.barista-ticket')
        .filter({ hasText: `#${pending.id}` }),
    ).toHaveCount(0);
    await staffPage.screenshot({
      path: path.join(evidence, `staff-paid-${width}.png`),
      fullPage: true,
    });
    await customerPage.goto(`${web}/orders/${order.id}`, {
      waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',
    });
    await expect(customerPage.locator('.status.PAID')).toBeVisible();

    for (const [status, label] of [
      ['PREPARING', 'Bắt đầu pha chế'],
      ['READY', 'Đã pha chế xong'],
      ['COMPLETED', 'Xác nhận đã giao'],
    ]) {
      await ticket.getByRole('button', { name: label, exact: true }).click();
      const dialog = staffPage.getByRole('dialog', {
        name: 'Xác nhận cập nhật đơn',
      });
      await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
      const updated = staffPage.waitForResponse(
        (r) =>
          r.url() === `${api}/staff/orders/${order.id}/status` &&
          r.request().method() === 'PATCH',
      );
      await dialog
        .getByRole('button', { name: 'Xác nhận', exact: true })
        .click();
      expect(await responseJson(await updated, 200)).toMatchObject({ status });
      await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);
      await customerPage
        .getByRole('button', { name: 'Cập nhật trạng thái' })
        .click();
      await expect(customerPage.locator(`.status.${status}`)).toBeVisible();
    }
    const stored = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id: order.id },
      include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
    });
    assert(stored.completedAt instanceof Date);
    expect(stored.statusHistory.map((h) => h.toStatus)).toEqual([
      'PENDING',
      'PAID',
      'PREPARING',
      'READY',
      'COMPLETED',
    ]);
    expect(stored.completedAt.toISOString()).toBe(
      stored.statusHistory[4].createdAt.toISOString(),
    );
    await customerPage.screenshot({
      path: path.join(evidence, `customer-completed-${width}.png`),
      fullPage: true,
    });

    // Cancellation/history UI remains TV1's integration task; exercise the real backend contract here.
    const cancel = (data) =>
      staffContext.request.patch(`${api}/staff/orders/${pending.id}/cancel`, {
        headers: { Origin: web },
        data,
      });
    expect((await cancel({ reason: '   ' })).status()).toBe(400);
    const reason = 'Khách yêu cầu hủy trước khi pha';
    expect(await responseJson(await cancel({ reason }), 200)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'CANCELLED',
      cancelReason: reason,
    });
    expect((await cancel({ reason })).status()).toBe(409);
    expect(
      (
        await staffContext.request.patch(
          `${api}/staff/orders/${order.id}/cancel`,
          { headers: { Origin: web }, data: { reason } },
        )
      ).status(),
    ).toBe(409);
    const detail = await responseJson(
      await staffContext.request.get(`${api}/staff/orders/${order.id}`),
      200,
    );
    expect(detail).toMatchObject({
      status: 'COMPLETED',
      completedAt: stored.completedAt.toISOString(),
    });
    const list = await responseJson(
      await staffContext.request.get(`${api}/staff/orders`),
      200,
    );
    expect(list.find((row) => row.id === order.id)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'COMPLETED',
    });
    expect(list.find((row) => row.id === pending.id)).toMatchObject({
      status: 'CANCELLED',
      cancelReason: reason,
    });
    expect(
      await responseJson(
        await customerContext.request.get(`${api}/orders/${pending.id}`),
        200,
      ),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'CANCELLED', cancelReason: reason });
    expect(
      await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: product.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ stock: 9 });
    results.push({
      width,
      passed: true,
      orderId: order.id,
      cancelledOrderId: pending.id,
      checks: [
        'Two real logins with distinct HttpOnly sessions; CUSTOMER staff-list 403',
        'UI checkout -> PENDING -> real Payment API PAID (mock gateway)',
        'PAID queue/configuration; unpaid order excluded',
        'UI-confirmed PAID -> PREPARING -> READY -> COMPLETED; customer refresh each step',
        'Single persisted completedAt matches final history event',
        'API: empty cancel reason 400; reason persisted; repeated/terminal cancel 409',
        'API: terminal history and staff detail; customer sees same cancelReason',
        'Cancelled reservation restored once; completed stock remains consumed',
      ],
    });
    saveSummary();
  } catch (error) {
    for (const [name, page] of [
      ['customer', customerPage],
      ['staff', staffPage],
    ]) {
      await page
        .screenshot({
          path: path.join(evidence, `failure-${name}-${width}.png`),
          fullPage: true,
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
    throw error;
  } finally {
    await customerContext.close();
    await staffContext.close();
  }
}

async function main() {
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL)
    throw new Error('Set DATABASE_URL for the local PostgreSQL server');
  await freePort(33220);
  await freePort(33221);
  fs.mkdirSync(evidence, { recursive: true });
  saveSummary();
  const name = `brewlite_tv4_browser_test_${randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')}`;
  assert(/^brewlite_tv4_browser_test_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(name));
  const url = new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL);
  url.pathname = `/${name}`;
  const env = {
    ...process.env,
    DATABASE_URL: url.toString(),
    FRONTEND_ORIGIN: web,
    JWT_SECRET: randomUUID(),
    PORT: '33221',
    NODE_ENV: 'test',
    MOCK_PAYMENT_OUTCOME: 'PAID',
    PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS: 'false',
    NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_MODE: 'api',
    NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: api,
    NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS: 'false',
    NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1',
  };
  const admin = new PrismaClient();
  const db = new PrismaClient({ datasources: { db: { url: url.toString() } } });
  let created = false;
  let browser;
  try {
    await admin.$executeRawUnsafe(`CREATE DATABASE "${name}"`);
    created = true;
    await run(
      'migrations',
      backend,
      ['node_modules/prisma/build/index.js', 'migrate', 'deploy'],
      env,
    );
    await run(
      'backend-build',
      backend,
      ['node_modules/@nestjs/cli/bin/nest.js', 'build'],
      env,
    );
    await run(
      'frontend-build',
      frontend,
      ['node_modules/next/dist/bin/next', 'build', '--webpack'],
      { ...env, NODE_ENV: 'production' },
    );
    const apiServer = start('backend-server', backend, ['dist/main.js'], env);
    const webServer = start(
      'frontend-server',
      frontend,
      ['node_modules/next/dist/bin/next', 'start', '--port', '33220'],
      { ...env, NODE_ENV: 'production' },
    );
    await ready(apiServer, `${api}/auth/me`, 401);
    await ready(webServer, `${web}/login`, 200);
    browser = await chromium.launch({
      channel: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL || 'msedge',
      headless: true,
    });
    summary.browser = await browser.version();
    for (const width of [1440, 768, 390])
      await verifyViewport(browser, db, width);
    summary.passed = true;
    console.log('PASS: TV4 real-API acceptance at 1440/768/390');
  } finally {
    if (browser) await browser.close();
    await stopChildren();
    await db.$disconnect();
    try {
      if (created) {
        await admin.$executeRawUnsafe(`DROP DATABASE "${name}" WITH (FORCE)`);
        summary.isolatedDatabaseRemoved = true;
      }
    } finally {
      await admin.$disconnect();
      summary.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      saveSummary();
    }
  }
}
main().catch((error) => {
  summary.passed = false;
  // Never write database credentials, passwords or cookies to evidence.
  summary.failure = String(error.message).replaceAll(
    process.env.DATABASE_URL || 'no-database-url',
    '[DATABASE_URL]',
  );
  if (fs.existsSync(evidence)) saveSummary();
  console.error(summary.failure);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
````

````javascript
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { platform } from 'node:os';

// Read-only measurement against a running API backed by the sample database.
// No mock, artificial delay, seed, or database mutation is performed here.
const endpoint = process.argv[2] ?? 'http://localhost:3002/api/products';
const count = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 30);
const warmupCount = 3;

async function measureRequest() {
  const start = performance.now();
  const response = await fetch(endpoint, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) });
  if (response.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Expected HTTP 200, received ${response.status}`);
  const products = await response.json();
  const elapsed = performance.now() - start;

  if (!Array.isArray(products) || products.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('A nonempty sample catalog is required for this measurement');
  }
  for (const product of products) {
    if (
      !product || typeof product !== 'object' ||
      Object.keys(product).sort().join(',') !== 'id,imageUrl,name,price' ||
      typeof product.id !== 'string' || !product.id.trim() ||
      typeof product.name !== 'string' || !product.name.trim() ||
      !Number.isInteger(product.price) || product.price < 0 ||
      typeof product.imageUrl !== 'string' || !product.imageUrl.trim()
    ) {
      throw new Error('Response does not match the public Product contract');
    }
  }
  return { elapsed, productCount: products.length };
}

async function main() {
  if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 1 || count > 1000) {
    throw new Error('Request count must be an integer between 1 and 1000');
  }
  const url = new URL(endpoint);
  if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol) || url.username || url.password || url.search) {
    throw new Error('Use an HTTP(S) products endpoint without credentials or query parameters');
  }

  for (let index = 0; index < warmupCount; index++) await measureRequest();
  const samples = [];
  const productCounts = new Set();
  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
    const result = await measureRequest();
    samples.push(result.elapsed);
    productCounts.add(result.productCount);
  }
  if (productCounts.size !== 1) throw new Error('Catalog count changed during measurement');
  const sorted = [...samples].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const round = (value) => Number(value.toFixed(2));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    measuredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    endpoint: url.href,
    node: process.version,
    platform: platform(),
    warmupCount,
    requestCount: count,
    productCount: [...productCounts][0],
    method: 'Sequential HTTP requests; includes response body transfer and JSON parsing',
    milliseconds: {
      min: round(sorted[0]),
      mean: round(samples.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / count),
      p50: round(sorted[Math.ceil(count * 0.5) - 1]),
      p95: round(sorted[Math.ceil(count * 0.95) - 1]),
      max: round(sorted[count - 1]),
    },
    allResponsesUnder500ms: sorted[count - 1] < 500,
  }, null, 2));
}

main().catch((error) => {
  const code = error.cause?.code;
  console.error(`Measurement blocked: ${error.message}${code ? ` (${code})` : ''}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
````

````tsx
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { BaristaBoard } from "@/components/barista-board";

const views = ["orders", "preparing", "ready", "history"] as const;

export default async function BaristaView({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ view: string }>;
}) {
  const { view } = await params;
  if (!views.includes(view as (typeof views)[number])) notFound();
  return <BaristaBoard view={view as (typeof views)[number]} />;
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

const sizeLabel = (s: ProductSize) =>
  `Size: ${s.code} (${s.extraPrice > 0 ? `+${money(s.extraPrice)}` : "Tiêu chuẩn"})`;
function SizeControl({
  item,
  sizes,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  item: CartItem;
  sizes: ProductSize[];
  disabled: boolean;
  onChange: (size: ProductSize["code"], unitPrice: number) => void;
}) {
  const current = sizes.find((s) => s.code === item.size);
  if (!current) return <span className="ct-chip">Size: {item.size}</span>;
  return (
    <label className="ct-select">
      <span className="sr-only">Chọn size cho {item.name}</span>
      <select
        value={item.size}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(e) => {
          const next = sizes.find((s) => s.code === e.target.value);
          if (next)
            onChange(next.code, item.unitPrice - current.extraPrice + next.extraPrice);
        }}
      >
        {sizes.map((s) => (
          <option key={s.code} value={s.code} disabled={!s.available}>
            {sizeLabel(s)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      <Icon name="down" size={16} />
    </label>
  );
}

  const {

    [promoBusy, setPromoBusy] = useState(false);
  const count = items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0),

    discount = Math.min(promotion?.discount || 0, subtotal),
    hasIssue = items.some((i) => i.issue);
  useEffect(() => {
    services.products
      .list()
      .then(setProducts)
      .catch(() => setProducts([]));
  }, []);
  // Mã đã lưu được kiểm tra lại mỗi khi tạm tính thay đổi để ưu đãi luôn khớp giỏ.

      setPromotion(null);

                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="ct-options">
                      <SizeControl
                        item={i}

                  <button

                  >
                    ×

              <div>
                <span>

            <div className="ct-grand">
              <span>

                <small>Giá cuối cùng được xác nhận khi đặt đơn</small>

            <div className="ct-voucher">
              <label htmlFor="voucher-input">Mã ưu đãi / Voucher</label>
              <div>
                <input
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { Suspense, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useCart } from "@/stores/cart";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { OrderSummary } from "@/components/order-summary";
import { Empty, Loading, ProductImage } from "@/components/ui";
import { cartTotal, money } from "@/types/domain";
import type { Order, PaymentMethod, Promotion } from "@/types/domain";
import { paymentDemoControls, services } from "@/services";
import { readPaymentIntent, savePaymentIntent } from "@/services/payment-intent";

function CheckoutContent() {
  const router = useRouter(),
    searchParams = useSearchParams(),
    retryOrderId = searchParams.get("retryOrder"),
    items = useCart((s) => s.items),
    cartPromoCode = useCart((s) => s.promoCode),
    { user, loading } = useAuth(),
    [code, setCode] = useState(cartPromoCode),
    [promotion, setPromotion] = useState<Promotion | null>(null),
    [promoBusy, setPromoBusy] = useState(false),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [retryLoading, setRetryLoading] = useState(Boolean(retryOrderId)),
    [retryOrder, setRetryOrder] = useState<Order | null>(null),
    [method, setMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod>("WALLET"),
    [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<"PAID" | "PAYMENT_FAILED" | "UNKNOWN">(
      "PAID",
    ),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const submitting = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && !user) router.replace("/login?next=%2Fcheckout");
  }, [loading, user, router]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!retryOrderId || !user) {
      setRetryLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    let active = true;
    setRetryLoading(true);
    setRetryOrder(null);
    setError("");
    services.orders
      .get(retryOrderId)
      .then((order) => {
        if (!active) return;
        if (!order || order.userId !== user.id)
          throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng cần thanh toán lại.");
        if (order.status !== "PAYMENT_FAILED")
          throw new Error("Chỉ có thể thanh toán lại đơn đã thất bại.");
        setRetryOrder(order);
        const previousIntent = readPaymentIntent(order.id);
        setMethod(previousIntent?.method || order.paymentMethod || "WALLET");
        setOutcome("PAID");
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (active)
          setError(
            e instanceof Error
              ? e.message
              : "Không tải được đơn hàng cần thanh toán lại.",
          );
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setRetryLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [retryOrderId, user]);
  const displayItems = retryOrder?.items || items;
  const displayDiscount = retryOrder
    ? retryOrder.discount
    : promotion?.discount || 0;
  const displayTotal =
    retryOrder?.total ?? Math.max(0, cartTotal(items) - displayDiscount);
  // Mã đã áp dụng ở giỏ hàng được kiểm tra lại và áp dụng sẵn.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cartPromoCode || !items.length) return;
    services.promotions
      .validate(cartPromoCode, cartTotal(items))
      .then(setPromotion)
      .catch(() => setPromotion(null));
  }, [cartPromoCode, items]);
  const apply = async () => {
    setPromoBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      setPromotion(await services.promotions.validate(code, cartTotal(items)));
    } catch (e) {
      setPromotion(null);
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Mã không hợp lệ");
    } finally {
      setPromoBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const submit = async () => {
    if (!user || !displayItems.length || submitting.current) return;
    if (retryOrderId && !retryOrder) {
      setError("Không thể thanh toán lại khi chưa tải được đơn hàng cũ.");
      return;
    }
    submitting.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const order =
        retryOrder ||
        (await services.orders.create(
          user.id,
          items,
          promotion || undefined,
        ));
      savePaymentIntent(order.id, {
        method,
        key: crypto.randomUUID(),
        ...(paymentDemoControls ? { outcome } : {}),
      });
      router.push(`/payment/${encodeURIComponent(order.id)}/processing`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không thể tạo đơn");
      submitting.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  if (loading || retryLoading)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <Loading />
      </main>
    );
  if (!user)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <Loading label="Chuyển đến đăng nhập..." />
      </main>
    );
  return (
    <main className="container main">
      <h1 className="section-title">Thanh toán đơn hàng</h1>
      {displayItems.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          message="Giỏ hàng trống."
          action={
            <Link className="btn btn-primary" href="/">
              Xem thực đơn
            </Link>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="two-col">
          <div className="stack">
            {retryOrder && (
              <section className="notice" role="status">
                <strong>Thanh toán lại đơn #{retryOrder.id}</strong>
                <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                  Bạn đang dùng lại đơn hàng cũ; hệ thống sẽ không tạo thêm đơn mới.
                </p>
              </section>
            )}
            <section className="card panel">
              <h2>Hình thức nhận món & Người nhận</h2>
              <p>Nhận tại quầy BrewLite</p>
              <p className="muted">
                {user.name} · {user.email}
              </p>
            </section>
            <section className="card panel">
              <h2>
                Xem lại món đã chọn ({displayItems.reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0)}{" "}
                món)
              </h2>
              {displayItems.map((i) => (
                <div className="cart-row" key={i.key}>
                  <ProductImage src={i.imageUrl} alt={i.name} />
                  <div className="cart-row-main">
                    <strong>{i.name}</strong>
                    <p className="muted">
                      {i.size} · {i.ice} · {i.sugar} ·{" "}
                      {i.toppingNames.join(", ") || "Không topping"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <strong>{money(i.unitPrice * i.quantity)}</strong>
                </div>
              ))}
            </section>
            {!retryOrder && <section className="card panel">
              <h2>Ưu đãi & Khuyến mãi</h2>
              <div className="row">
                <input
                  className="field"
                  aria-label="Mã ưu đãi"
                  placeholder="Nhập mã giảm giá"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setCode(e.target.value);
                    setPromotion(null);
                  }}
                />
                <button
                  className="btn btn-secondary"
                  disabled={promoBusy || !code.trim()}
                  onClick={apply}
                >
                  {promoBusy ? "Đang kiểm tra..." : "Áp dụng"}
                </button>
              </div>
              {promotion && (
                <p className="success">
                  Đã áp dụng {promotion.code}: giảm {money(promotion.discount)}
                </p>
              )}
            </section>}
            <section className="card panel">
              <h2>Phương thức thanh toán trực tuyến</h2>
              <div className="options">
                <button
                  className={`option ${method === "WALLET" ? "selected" : ""}`}
                  aria-pressed={method === "WALLET"}
                  onClick={() => setMethod("WALLET")}
                >
                  Ví điện tử
                </button>
                <button
                  className={`option ${method === "CARD" ? "selected" : ""}`}
                  aria-pressed={method === "CARD"}
                  onClick={() => setMethod("CARD")}
                >
                  Thẻ ngân hàng
                </button>
              </div>
              {paymentDemoControls && (
                <div className="notice">
                  <strong>Kịch bản demo</strong>
                  <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                    Chỉ mô phỏng phản hồi gateway; Order và Payment vẫn được lưu
                    vào PostgreSQL.
                  </p>
                  <select
                    className="field"
                    aria-label="Kết quả thanh toán demo"
                    value={outcome}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setOutcome(e.target.value as typeof outcome)
                    }
                  >
                    <option value="PAID">Thành công</option>
                    <option value="PAYMENT_FAILED">Thất bại</option>
                    <option value="UNKNOWN">Chưa xác định</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </div>
          <aside className="card panel">
            <OrderSummary items={displayItems} discount={displayDiscount} />
            {error && (
              <p role="alert" className="error">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}
            <button
              className="btn btn-primary"
              style={{ width: "100%", marginTop: 20 }}
              disabled={busy || Boolean(retryOrderId && !retryOrder)}
              onClick={submit}
            >
              {busy
                ? retryOrder
                  ? "Đang xử lý lại..."
                  : "Đang tạo đơn..."
                : `Xác nhận thanh toán ${money(displayTotal)}`}
            </button>
            <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
              Số tiền cuối cùng được xác nhận khi tạo đơn hàng.
            </p>
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

export default function Checkout() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <main className="container main">
          <Loading />
        </main>
      }
    >
      <CheckoutContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
````

````css
/* Stitch-inspired editorial layout for the shared storefront. */
:root { --espresso: #331917; --paper: #f6f3ee; }
body { color: #27211e; }
.container { max-width: 1280px; padding-inline: 28px; }
.header { background: rgba(252,249,244,.97); border-color: #eee7dd; }
.header-inner { min-height: 80px; gap: 30px; }
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 25px; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.brand-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--coffee); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; }
.brand-mark svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
.nav { gap: 32px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.nav-tools { gap: 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.cart-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.cart-link svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.badge { min-width: 18px; height: 18px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0 4px; font-size: 10px; }
.demo { background: #f4eee5; color: #765a48; padding: 6px 16px; }
.main { padding-top: 36px; padding-bottom: 72px; }
.btn { border-radius: 8px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--espresso); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--coffee); }
.btn-quiet { background: rgba(255,255,255,.48); color: var(--coffee); border-color: #e7ddd1; }
.btn-quiet:hover { background: #fff; }
.section-title { font-size: clamp(28px,3vw,38px); line-height: 1.2; }
.eyebrow { color: #a8744d; }

.hero { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; align-items: center; gap: 30px; min-height: 470px; margin: 12px 0 46px; padding: 54px 60px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 35%,#fffdf8 0,#f6f1e9 58%,#f1ebe2 100%); color: var(--espresso); border: 1px solid #eee8de; border-radius: 22px; }
.hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 300px; height: 300px; right: -100px; bottom: -160px; border-radius: 50%; background: #eadbc9; filter: blur(60px); opacity: .6; }
.hero-copy { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.hero-eyebrow { color: #79573f !important; font-size: 11px; }
.hero h1 { max-width: 590px; font-size: clamp(38px,4.2vw,58px); line-height: 1.18; letter-spacing: -.045em; margin: 18px 0 18px; }
.hero h1 em { display: block; color: #79573f; font-weight: 600; }
.hero p { max-width: 515px; color: #504443; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 27px; }
.hero .btn { margin: 0; min-height: 48px; }
.hero .btn-primary { background: var(--espresso); color: #fff; }
.hero .btn-quiet { background: #fffaf4; color: var(--coffee); }
.hero-proof { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 22px; margin-top: 30px; color: #6e6054; font-size: 11px; }
.hero-visual { position: relative; min-height: 350px; height: 100%; }
.hero-photo { position: absolute; overflow: hidden; border: 6px solid #fff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(51,25,23,.16); background: #e4d7c7; }
.hero-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.hero-photo-main { width: 56%; height: 70%; left: 4%; bottom: 1%; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
.hero-photo-accent { width: 55%; height: 64%; right: 2%; top: 0; transform: rotate(3deg); }
.hero-photo-main::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 55% 0 0; background: linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(23,12,8,.55)); pointer-events: none; }
.hero-photo-main span { position: absolute; z-index: 1; bottom: 12px; left: 14px; right: 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
.hero-photo-main small { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; }
.hero-photo-accent span { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 12px; background: var(--espresso); color: white; border-radius: 99px; padding: 5px 9px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.hero-stamp { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 47%; top: 48%; padding: 11px 15px; background: #fff; border-radius: 99px; box-shadow: 0 5px 20px #33191725; color: var(--coffee); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
.menu-section { scroll-margin-top: 120px; }
.menu-heading { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.menu-heading .section-title { margin: 7px 0 0; }
.menu-heading p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 7px; font-size: 14px; }
.menu-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; padding: 4px 15px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px #33191708; }
.menu-search > span:first-child { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; color: var(--roast); }
.menu-search .field { border: 0; box-shadow: none; padding: 12px 0; }
.menu-count { border-left: 1px solid var(--border); padding-left: 16px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--roast); font-size: 12px; }
.filters { margin: 18px 0 24px; }
.pill { padding: 10px 17px; background: transparent; }
.pill:hover { border-color: var(--coffee); }
.grid { gap: 18px; }
.product-card { border-radius: 13px; border-color: #eee9e0; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px #3319170a; transition: transform .18s, box-shadow .18s; }
.product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px #33191718; }
.product-photo { display: block; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.product-photo img { width: 100%; height: 210px; object-fit: cover; transition: transform .25s; }
.product-card:hover .product-photo img { transform: scale(1.03); }
.product-stock { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 99px; background: #f7fff8eb; color: #216745; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
.product-stock.is-out { background: #fff2f0ed; color: #a93636; }
.product-body { gap: 10px; padding: 17px; }
.product-body .eyebrow { font-size: 10px; }
.product-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 8px; }
.product-heading h3 { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; }
.product-heading .price { font-size: 14px; white-space: nowrap; color: #2f211d; }
.product-body p { min-height: 42px; line-height: 1.5; }
.product-action { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; margin-top: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #f2eee9; font-size: 12px; }
.product-action:hover { background: #e8ddd1; }
.product-action.unavailable { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #f2eee9; color: #8a817a; font-weight: 600; }
.member-promo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin-top: 42px; padding: 22px 27px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--coffee); color: #fff; }
.promo-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff22; color: #f2d0a9; font-size: 28px; }
.member-promo h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-family: 'Noto Serif',serif; font-size: 21px; }
.member-promo p { margin: 0; color: #e8d7cc; font-size: 12px; }
.btn-promo { margin-left: auto; flex: none; background: #a3714d; color: white; font-size: 12px; }
.btn-promo:hover { background: #b78359; }

.auth-main { padding-top: 42px; }
.auth-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: 34px; max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto; align-items: stretch; }
.auth-feature { position: relative; min-height: 650px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px; background: #3e261e; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px #33191720; }
.auth-feature > img { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: blur(2px); transform: scale(1.03); opacity: .72; }
.auth-feature::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#2b160d70,#2d1717c7 65%,#291714ee); }
.auth-feature-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; padding: 52px 45px 38px; }
.auth-feature .eyebrow { color: #f0d1b1; }
.auth-feature h2 { max-width: 410px; margin: 22px 0 16px; font-size: clamp(28px,3vw,42px); line-height: 1.23; }
.auth-feature p { max-width: 395px; color: #f0e6dc; line-height: 1.7; }
.auth-benefits { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 13px; margin-top: auto; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #ffffff30; border-radius: 13px; background: #ffffff1f; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); font-size: 13px; }
.auth-benefits strong { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.auth-wrap { max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: 48px; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px #3319170c; }
.auth-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 42px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 9px; background: #f5f1eb; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.auth-tabs > * { padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; }
.auth-tabs .active { background: var(--espresso); color: #fff; }
.auth-tabs a:hover { background: #ebe2d8; }
.auth-wrap .section-title { margin: 7px 0 8px; }
.auth-intro { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; margin: 0 0 28px; }
.auth-wrap .form { gap: 20px; }
.auth-wrap .field { margin-top: 4px; background: #f9f7f3; border-color: #ede5dc; }
.auth-wrap .form .btn { min-height: 52px; margin-top: 4px; }
.auth-wrap > p:last-child { text-align: center; margin: 28px 0 0; font-size: 14px; }
.auth-wrap > p:last-child a { color: var(--coffee); font-weight: 700; }

.breadcrumb { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; margin: 0 0 24px; color: #665650; font-size: 13px; }
.breadcrumb span { color: #af9d8c; }
.breadcrumb a:hover { color: #a3714d; }
.detail { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr); gap: 45px; }
.detail-media { min-width: 0; }
.detail-photo { position: relative; height: 590px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: #d8c3ae; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px #33191714; }
.detail-image { width: 100%; height: 100%; aspect-ratio: auto; border-radius: 0; }
.detail-photo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 65% 0 0; background: linear-gradient(transparent,#24140ecc); }
.detail-photo-tag { position: absolute; top: 18px; left: 18px; z-index: 1; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--coffee); color: #fff; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.detail-photo-caption { position: absolute; left: 26px; bottom: 24px; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: #fff; }
.detail-photo-caption small { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.detail-photo-caption strong { font-family: 'Noto Serif',serif; font-size: 24px; }
.detail-story { margin-top: 16px; padding: 23px; border-radius: 13px; background: #f4f0e9; }
.detail-story p { margin: 7px 0 0; line-height: 1.6; color: #60544e; }
.detail-config { min-width: 0; }
.detail-category { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 99px; background: #f1e4d7; color: var(--coffee); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.detail-config .section-title { margin: 14px 0 10px; font-size: clamp(32px,3.5vw,45px); }
.detail-config > .price { font-size: 26px; }
.detail-description { color: #665b53; line-height: 1.65; margin: 16px 0 28px; }
.detail-section { border-top: 1px solid #e6ddd2; padding: 23px 0 6px; }
.detail-section h2 { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: 18px; }
.detail-section h2 small { color: #8d7b6c; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; }
.detail-section p { margin: 17px 0 5px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
.detail-section .options { margin: 0 0 12px; }
.detail-section .option { min-height: 48px; background: #f8f5f0; border-color: transparent; font-size: 13px; }
.detail-section .option.selected { border-color: var(--coffee); background: #f1eae2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--coffee); }
.size-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); }
.size-options .option { text-align: left; }
.taste-section { margin: 8px 0; padding: 23px; border: 0; border-radius: 13px; background: #f3efe9; }
.taste-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 5px; }
.taste-options .option { padding: 10px 6px; text-align: center; }
.taste-section .option.selected { background: var(--espresso); color: #fff; }
.topping-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
.topping-options .option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.topping-options input { accent-color: var(--coffee); }
.detail-summary { margin-top: 18px; padding: 19px; border-radius: 13px; background: #efede8; }
.detail-summary hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #d9cec4; margin: 18px 0; }
.detail-summary .price { font-size: 24px; }
.detail-config > .btn { min-height: 54px; }

.footer { margin-top: 16px; padding: 48px 0 0; background: #f1ede6; }
.footer-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 55px; }
.footer-about { max-width: 350px; }
.footer-about p { margin: 13px 0; color: #6c5f55; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; }
.footer-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; color: #6c5f55; font-size: 13px; }
.footer-links strong { color: #2d211d; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.footer-links a:hover { color: var(--coffee); }
.footer-bottom { margin-top: 45px; padding: 16px; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #e3dad0; color: #897c71; font-size: 11px; }

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .header-inner { gap: 18px; }
  .nav { gap: 14px; }
  .hero { padding: 44px; }
  .hero-photo-main { left: 0; }
  .auth-layout { gap: 18px; }
  .auth-wrap { padding: 34px; }
  .detail { gap: 25px; }
  .taste-options { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .container { padding-inline: 18px; }
  .header-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; min-height: 0; gap: 10px; padding-block: 12px; }
  .brand { font-size: 21px; }
  .brand-mark { width: 29px; height: 29px; }
  .brand-mark svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; }
  .nav { grid-column: 1/-1; grid-row: 2; order: initial; width: 100%; gap: 26px; overflow-x: auto; padding-top: 5px; font-size: 12px; }
  .nav-tools { gap: 11px; font-size: 12px; }
  .cart-label { display: none; }
  .cart-link { gap: 3px; }
  .demo { font-size: 10px; }
  .main { padding-top: 20px; padding-bottom: 52px; }
  .hero { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px; min-height: 0; padding: 28px 25px 20px; margin: 4px 0 34px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(31px,8vw,42px); line-height: 1.2; margin: 12px 0; }
  .hero p { font-size: 13px; }
  .hero-actions { margin-top: 20px; }
  .hero .btn { min-height: 43px; padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
  .hero-proof { gap: 8px 13px; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 10px; }
  .hero-visual { height: 240px; min-height: 240px; }
  .hero-photo-main { width: 52%; height: 78%; left: 7%; bottom: 0; }
  .hero-photo-accent { width: 53%; height: 75%; right: 5%; top: 2%; }
  .hero-stamp { top: 46%; left: 43%; font-size: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; }
  .menu-heading { display: block; }
  .menu-heading p { margin-top: 9px; }
  .menu-count { display: none; }
  .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .product-photo img { height: 170px; }
  .product-heading { flex-direction: column; }
  .product-body p { min-height: 60px; }
  .member-promo { flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 20px; }
  .btn-promo { margin-left: 0; width: 100%; }
  .auth-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .auth-feature { min-height: 290px; }
  .auth-feature-content { padding: 26px; }
  .auth-feature h2 { font-size: 27px; margin: 12px 0 8px; }
  .auth-feature p { font-size: 12px; }
  .auth-benefits { display: none; }
  .auth-wrap { padding: 26px; }
  .auth-tabs { margin-bottom: 25px; }
  .detail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .detail-photo { height: 420px; }
  .detail-story { display: none; }
  .detail-config .section-title { font-size: 32px; }
  .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 25px; }
  .footer-about { grid-column: 1/-1; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .product-photo img { height: 230px; }
  .product-heading { flex-direction: row; }
  .product-body p { min-height: 0; }
  .product-action { min-height: 44px; }
  .hero-visual { height: 220px; min-height: 220px; }
  .hero-photo-main span { font-size: 10px; }
  .size-options { gap: 5px; }
  .size-options .option { padding: 9px 7px; font-size: 11px; }
  .taste-section { padding: 16px; }
  .topping-options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .detail-photo { height: 350px; }
}

/* Keep authenticated navigation inside tablet viewports. */
@media (min-width: 701px) and (max-width: 900px) {
  .header-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 10px 18px; padding-block: 12px; }
  .nav { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; }
  .nav-tools { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
}

.cart-heading { align-items: start; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.cart-heading .section-title { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.cart-heading p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }
.cart-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.cart-row { align-items: stretch; gap: 20px; padding: 18px; border-bottom: 0; }
.cart-row img { width: 145px; height: 145px; border-radius: 9px; }
.cart-row-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.cart-item-heading { align-items: start; gap: 15px; }
.cart-item-heading strong:first-child { font-size: 17px; }
.cart-item-heading strong:last-child { white-space: nowrap; color: var(--coffee); }
.cart-tags { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 11px 0; }
.cart-tags span { border-radius: 5px; background: #f2eee9; padding: 5px 7px; font-size: 11px; }
.cart-item-bottom { margin-top: auto; }
.cart-remove { padding: 6px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #a63d37; font-size: 12px; }
.cart-remove:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.cart-summary { align-self: start; padding: 27px; }
.cart-summary h2 { margin: 8px 0 16px; font-size: 23px; color: var(--coffee); }
.cart-summary-note { margin-top: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f5f1ea; padding: 12px; color: #68594f; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .cart-row { gap: 13px; padding: 12px; }
  .cart-row img { width: 95px; height: 110px; }
  .cart-item-heading { display: block; }
  .cart-item-heading strong { display: block; font-size: 13px !important; }
  .cart-item-heading strong:last-child { margin-top: 5px; }
  .cart-tags { margin: 8px 0; }
  .cart-tags span { font-size: 10px; }
  .cart-heading .btn { font-size: 11px; padding-inline: 9px; }
}

/* Stitch: chi tiết sản phẩm (pd-) và giỏ hàng (ct-). */
:root { --s-low: #f6f3ed; --s-mid: #f0eee8; --s-high: #ebe8e2; --s-ink: #2b1810; --s-sec: #8e4d2a; --s-sec-soft: #ffdbcb; --s-peach: #feaa7f; --s-variant: #4f4440; --s-outline: #817470; }
.pd-page { padding: 24px 0 0; }
.pd-breadcrumb, .ct-breadcrumb { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 13px; }
.pd-breadcrumb a:hover, .ct-breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-breadcrumb span { color: #b9aaa3; }
.pd-breadcrumb strong, .ct-breadcrumb strong { color: #1c1c18; }
.pd-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.98fr); gap: 32px; align-items: start; }
.pd-media { position: sticky; top: 100px; }
.pd-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1/.98; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: #d8c3ae; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px #2b18101a; }
.pd-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.pd-photo-tags { position: absolute; top: 18px; left: 18px; display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.pd-photo-tags span { padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-tag-dark { background: var(--s-sec); color: #fff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.pd-tag-light { background: #fffffff0; color: var(--s-ink); }
.pd-like { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 16px; width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffffe6; color: var(--s-ink); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px #2b181022; transition: transform .15s; }
.pd-like:hover { transform: scale(1.06); }
.pd-like.is-liked { color: #c0392b; }
.pd-like.is-liked svg { fill: currentColor; }
.pd-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; }
.pd-chips span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.pd-chips svg { color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px #2b18100f; }
.pd-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.pd-eyebrow { color: var(--s-sec); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.pd-fresh { padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-sec-soft); color: #713714; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-title { margin: 8px 0 6px; color: #1c1c18; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: clamp(30px,3.2vw,40px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1.2; }
.pd-price-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; margin: 14px 0 12px; }
.pd-price { color: #1c1c18; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.pd-price-note { padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--s-sec-soft); color: #713714; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.pd-description { margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s-high); color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }
.pd-group { margin-bottom: 20px; }
.pd-group-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.pd-group-head h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #1c1c18; }
.pd-group-head small { color: var(--s-sec); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
.pd-group-head > span { color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; }
.pd-sizes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.pd-size { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 22px 8px 14px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--s-mid); color: #1c1c18; transition: .15s; }
.pd-size:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--s-high); }
.pd-size svg { color: var(--s-variant); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.pd-size strong { font-size: 14px; }
.pd-size small { color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; }
.pd-size > span { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.pd-size em { position: absolute; top: -11px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-sec); color: #fff; font-size: 9px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
.pd-size.selected { border-color: var(--s-peach); background: #fff1ea; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px #8e4d2a1f; }
.pd-size.selected svg, .pd-size.selected > span { color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-toppings { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.pd-topping { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--s-mid); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: .15s; }
.pd-topping:hover { background: var(--s-high); }
.pd-topping input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--s-ink); }
.pd-topping span { flex: 1; }
.pd-topping small { color: var(--s-sec); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-topping.selected { border-color: #e2bfb2; background: #fff; }
.pd-topping.is-disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.pd-segments { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); }
.pd-segments button { padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: transparent; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.pd-segments button.selected { background: var(--s-ink); color: #fff; }
.pd-note { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.pd-note span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-note svg { color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-note input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); outline: none; font-size: 13px; }
.pd-note input:focus { border-color: #e2bfb2; background: #fff; }
.pd-total { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--s-low); }
.pd-qty { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.pd-total-price { text-align: right; }
.pd-total-price small { display: block; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 11px; }
.pd-total-price strong { color: var(--s-sec); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.pd-page .quantity, .ct-page .quantity { gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px #2b181012; }
.pd-page .quantity button, .ct-page .quantity button { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #2b18101a; font-size: 16px; }
.pd-page .quantity span, .ct-page .quantity span { min-width: 30px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-card .error { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13px; }
.pd-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-top: 18px; }
.pd-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px #2b181024; transition: .15s; }
.pd-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.pd-btn-dark { background: var(--s-ink); }
.pd-btn-caramel { background: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-assure { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 20px; margin-top: 14px; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 11px; }
.pd-assure span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.pd-assure svg { color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-details { margin-top: 56px; padding: 48px 0; background: var(--s-mid); }
.pd-section-title { margin: 6px 0 8px; color: #1c1c18; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: clamp(24px,2.6vw,30px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
.pd-section-lead { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 0 24px; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }
.pd-info-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.pd-info { padding: 22px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px #2b18100a; }
.pd-info h3 { margin: 14px 0 8px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: 17px; color: #1c1c18; }
.pd-info p { margin: 0; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
.pd-info-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; }
.pd-info-icon.tone-0, .pd-info-icon.tone-1 { background: var(--s-sec-soft); color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-info-icon.tone-2 { background: var(--s-peach); color: #fff; }
.pd-info-icon.tone-3 { background: var(--s-high); color: var(--s-variant); }
.pd-scores { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); align-items: center; gap: 24px; margin-top: 18px; padding: 22px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; }
.pd-scores h3 { margin: 4px 0 6px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: 17px; color: #1c1c18; }
.pd-scores p { margin: 0; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.pd-scores-eyebrow { color: var(--s-sec); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-score > div:first-child { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-score > div:first-child span:last-child { color: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-bar { height: 8px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); }
.pd-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; }
.pd-bar .tone-0 { background: var(--s-sec); }
.pd-bar .tone-1 { background: #f7a77c; }
.pd-bar .tone-2 { background: var(--s-ink); }
.pd-related { padding-top: 48px; padding-bottom: 64px; }
.pd-related-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.pd-related-head a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--s-sec); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.pd-related-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px #2b18100d; transition: transform .18s; }
.pd-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
.pd-related-photo { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #e8d6bf; }
.pd-related-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.pd-related-photo span { position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 99px; background: #fffffff0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
.pd-related-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; }
.pd-related-body h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #1c1c18; }
.pd-related-body p { flex: 1; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.pd-related-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }
.pd-related-bottom strong { font-size: 17px; }
.pd-related-bottom button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); color: var(--s-ink); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.pd-related-bottom button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--s-high); }

.ct-page { padding-top: 28px; padding-bottom: 80px; min-height: calc(100vh - 200px); }
.ct-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.ct-title-row { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
.ct-header h1 { margin: 0; color: #1c1c18; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; font-size: clamp(32px,4vw,44px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.ct-count { padding: 3px 11px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-peach); color: #341100; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.ct-header p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 15px; }
.ct-clear { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-mid); color: var(--s-variant); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #2b181014; transition: .15s; }
.ct-clear:hover { background: #ffdad6; color: #ba1a1a; }
.ct-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,2fr) minmax(320px,1fr); gap: 32px; align-items: start; }
.ct-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.cart-row.ct-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 24px 32px 24px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px #2b18100a; }
.ct-thumb { position: relative; flex: none; width: 140px; height: 140px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--s-mid); }
.ct-thumb img, .cart-row .ct-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 0; }
.ct-thumb span { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; max-width: calc(100% - 16px); padding: 2px 9px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--s-ink); color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ct-item-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-width: 0; gap: 8px; }
.ct-item-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 8px; }
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { Suspense, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { authService } from "@/services/auth";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { AuthFeature } from "@/components/auth-feature";
function Form() {
  const router = useRouter(),
    params = useSearchParams(),
    { refresh } = useAuth(),
    [email, setEmail] = useState(""),
    [password, setPassword] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const next = params.get("next");
  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const { user } = await authService.login(email, password);
      await refresh();
      router.replace(
        user.role === "BARISTA"
          ? "/barista/dashboard"
          : next?.startsWith("/") && !next.startsWith("//")
            ? next
            : "/",
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Đăng nhập thất bại");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <main className="container main auth-main">
      <div className="auth-layout">
        <AuthFeature />
        <div className="auth-wrap card panel">
        <nav className="auth-tabs" aria-label="Tài khoản">
          <span className="active">Đăng nhập</span>
          <Link href={`/register${next ? `?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}` : ""}`}>Đăng ký</Link>
        </nav>
        <span className="eyebrow">Chào mừng trở lại</span>
        <h1 className="section-title">Đăng nhập</h1>
        <p className="auth-intro">Đăng nhập tài khoản để tiếp tục hành trình cà phê của bạn.</p>
        <form className="form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <label>
            Email
            <input
              className="field"
              type="email"
              required
              placeholder="ban@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="email"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Mật khẩu
            <input
              className="field"
              type="password"
              required
              placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="current-password"
            />
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="error">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Đang đăng nhập..." : "Đăng nhập"}
          </button>
        </form>
        <p>
          Chưa có tài khoản?{" "}
          <Link
            className="link"
            href={`/register${next ? `?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}` : ""}`}
          >
            Đăng ký ngay
          </Link>
        </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
export default function Login() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <Form />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { use, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { services } from "@/services";
import type { Order } from "@/types/domain";
import { money } from "@/types/domain";
import { ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge, Timeline } from "@/components/ui";
export default function OrderDetail({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = use(params),
    { user, loading: authLoading } = useAuth(),
    router = useRouter(),
    [order, setOrder] = useState<Order | null>(null),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const userId = user?.id;
  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    services.orders
      .get(id)
      .then(setOrder)
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !userId)
      router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/orders/${id}`)}`);
    else if (userId) load();
  }, [authLoading, userId, id, router, load]);
  return (
    <main className="container main">
      <Link href="/orders">← Đơn hàng của tôi</Link>
      {loading || authLoading ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : error ? (
        <ErrorState message={error} retry={load} />
      ) : !order || order.userId !== user?.id ? (
        <ErrorState message="Không tìm thấy đơn hàng của bạn" />
      ) : (
        <div className="card panel" style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
          <div className="row">
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">Chi tiết đơn hàng</span>
              <h1 className="section-title">Mã đơn #{order.id}</h1>
              <p className="muted">
                Tạo lúc {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
              </p>
            </div>
            <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
          </div>
          <Timeline status={order.status} />
          <h2>Các món đã chọn</h2>
          {order.items.map((i) => (
            <div className="summary-line" key={i.key}>
              <span>
                {i.quantity} × {i.name} · {i.size} ·{" "}
                {i.toppingNames.join(", ") || "Không topping"}
              </span>
              <strong>{money(i.unitPrice * i.quantity)}</strong>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="summary-line">
            <span>Tạm tính</span>
            <span>{money(order.subtotal)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="summary-line">
            <span>Giảm giá</span>
            <span>−{money(order.discount)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="summary-line total">
            <span>Tổng cộng</span>
            <span>{money(order.total)}</span>
          </div>
          <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={load}>
            Cập nhật trạng thái
          </button>
          {order.status === "PAYMENT_FAILED" && (
            <Link className="btn btn-primary" href={`/payment/${id}/failure`}>
              Thử thanh toán lại
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { services } from "@/services";
import type { Order } from "@/types/domain";
import { money } from "@/types/domain";
import { Empty, ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge } from "@/components/ui";
export default function Orders() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useAuth(),
    router = useRouter(),
    [orders, setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const userId = user?.id;
  const load = useCallback(() => {
    if (!userId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    services.orders
      .mine(userId)
      .then(setOrders)
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [userId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !userId) router.replace("/login?next=%2Forders");
    else if (userId) load();
  }, [authLoading, userId, router, load]);
  return (
    <main className="container main">
      <div className="row">
        <h1 className="section-title">Đơn hàng của tôi</h1>
        <button
          className="btn btn-secondary"
          onClick={load}
          disabled={!user || loading}
        >
          Làm mới
        </button>
      </div>
      {authLoading || loading ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : error ? (
        <ErrorState message={error} retry={load} />
      ) : orders.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty
          message="Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào."
          action={
            <Link className="btn btn-primary" href="/">
              Đặt món ngay
            </Link>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="stack">
          {orders.map((o) => (
            <Link className="card panel" key={o.id} href={`/orders/${o.id}`}>
              <div className="row">
                <div>
                  <h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Mã đơn #{o.id}</h2>
                  <p className="muted">
                    {new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ·{" "}
                    {o.items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0)} món
                  </p>
                </div>
                <StatusBadge status={o.status} />
              </div>
              <div className="row">
                <span>{o.items.map((i) => i.name).join(", ")}</span>
                <strong>{money(o.total)}</strong>
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { use, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { services, paymentDemoControls } from "@/services";
import { useCart } from "@/stores/cart";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import type { Order, PaymentMethod } from "@/types/domain";
import { money } from "@/types/domain";
import { ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge } from "@/components/ui";
import {
  readPaymentIntent,
  removePaymentIntent,
} from "@/services/payment-intent";
export default function PaymentPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string; stage: string }>;
}) {
  const { id, stage } = use(params),
    router = useRouter(),
    { user, loading: authLoading } = useAuth(),
    clear = useCart((s) => s.clear),
    [order, setOrder] = useState<Order | null>(null),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [verifyBusy, setVerifyBusy] = useState(false),
    [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState<PaymentMethod | null>(null),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const started = useRef(false);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setOrder(await services.orders.get(id));
      setError("");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không tải được đơn");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !user)
      router.replace(
        `/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/payment/${id}/${stage}`)}`,
      );
    else if (user) void load();
  }, [authLoading, user, load, router, id, stage]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      stage !== "processing" ||
      !order ||
      !user ||
      order.userId !== user.id ||
      started.current
    )
      return;
    const intent = readPaymentIntent(id);
    if (!intent) {
      router.replace(`/payment/${id}/unknown`);
      return;
    }
    setPaymentMethod(intent.method);
    started.current = true;
    let timedOut = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timedOut = true;
      router.replace(`/payment/${id}/unknown`);
    }, 15000);
    services.payments
      .pay(id, intent.method, intent.key, intent.outcome)
      .then(async (p) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (timedOut) return;
        if (p.status === "PAID") {
          removePaymentIntent(id);
          clear();
          router.replace(`/payment/${id}/success`);
        } else
          router.replace(
            `/payment/${id}/${p.status === "PAYMENT_FAILED" ? "failure" : "unknown"}`,
          );
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (timedOut) return;
        setError(
          e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không xác minh được thanh toán",
        );
        router.replace(`/payment/${id}/unknown`);
      });
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [stage, id, order, user, router, clear]);
  const verify = async () => {
    if (verifyBusy) return;
    setVerifyBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const current = await services.orders.get(id);
      setOrder(current);
      if (
        current &&
        ["PAID", "PREPARING", "READY", "COMPLETED"].includes(current.status)
      ) {
        removePaymentIntent(id);
        clear();
        router.replace(`/payment/${id}/success`);
      } else if (current?.status === "PAYMENT_FAILED")
        router.replace(`/payment/${id}/failure`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không kiểm tra được trạng thái đơn",
      );
    } finally {
      setVerifyBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const retry = () => {
    if (!order) return;
    router.push(`/checkout?retryOrder=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  };
  if (loading || authLoading)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <Loading />
      </main>
    );
  if (error && stage !== "unknown")
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <ErrorState message={error} retry={load} />
      </main>
    );
  if (!order || order.userId !== user?.id)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <ErrorState message="Không tìm thấy đơn hàng" />
      </main>
    );
  return (
    <main className="container main">
      <div
        className="card panel"
        style={{ maxWidth: 680, margin: "auto", textAlign: "center" }}
      >
        {stage === "processing" ? (
          <>
            <div className="spinner" />
            <h1>Đang xử lý thanh toán...</h1>
            <p>Vui lòng chờ kết quả từ cổng thanh toán.</p>
            <p className="muted">Mã đơn #{order.id}</p>
            <strong>{money(order.total)}</strong>
          </>
        ) : stage === "success" &&
          ["PAID", "PREPARING", "READY", "COMPLETED"].includes(order.status) ? (
          <>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 50 }}>✓</div>
            <h1>Đặt hàng thành công!</h1>
            <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
            <p>
              Mã đơn <strong>#{order.id}</strong>
            </p>
            <div style={{ textAlign: "left" }}>
              {order.items.map((i) => (
                <div className="summary-line" key={i.key}>
                  <span>
                    {i.quantity} × {i.name} ({i.size})
                  </span>
                  <span>{money(i.quantity * i.unitPrice)}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div className="summary-line total">
                <span>Tổng cộng</span>
                <span>{money(order.total)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p>
              Phương thức:{" "}
              {(order.paymentMethod || paymentMethod) === "CARD"
                ? "Thẻ ngân hàng"
                : (order.paymentMethod || paymentMethod) === "WALLET"
                  ? "Ví điện tử"
                  : "Chưa xác định"}
            </p>
            <Link className="btn btn-primary" href="/orders">
              Xem đơn hàng
            </Link>
          </>
        ) : stage === "failure" && order.status === "PAYMENT_FAILED" ? (
          <>
            <h1 className="error">Thanh toán chưa thành công</h1>
            <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
            <p>{order.error || "Giao dịch demo bị từ chối."}</p>
            <p>Giỏ hàng vẫn được giữ nguyên.</p>
            <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={retry}>
              Thử thanh toán lại
            </button>{" "}
            <Link className="btn btn-secondary" href="/cart">
              Về giỏ hàng
            </Link>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <h1>Đang xác minh kết quả thanh toán</h1>
            <p>
              Chưa thể kết luận giao dịch. Kiểm tra trạng thái đơn trước khi thử
              lại.
            </p>
            {error && <p className="error">{error}</p>}
            <p>Mã đơn #{order.id}</p>
            <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
            <div style={{ marginTop: 22 }}>
              <button
                className="btn btn-secondary"
                disabled={verifyBusy}
                onClick={verify}
              >
                {verifyBusy ? "Đang kiểm tra..." : "Kiểm tra trạng thái đơn"}
              </button>{" "}
              <Link className="btn btn-outline" href={`/orders/${id}`}>
                Xem chi tiết đơn
              </Link>
            </div>
            {paymentDemoControls && (
              <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
                Demo không tự chuyển trạng thái khi kết quả chưa rõ.
              </p>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
````

````tsx
                  >
````
