````tsx
                    <Icon name="cup" size={s.code === "S" ? 16 : s.code === "M" ? 19 : 22} />
                    <strong>Size {s.code}</strong>
                    <small>
                      {s.name} · {VOLUME[s.code]}
                    </small>
                    <span>
                      {s.extraPrice > 0
                        ? `+${money(s.extraPrice)}`
                        : money(product.price)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-group">
              <div className="pd-group-head">
                <h2>2. Thêm Topping & Nâng cấp</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="pd-toppings">
                {product.toppings.map((t) => (
                  <label
                    key={t.id}
                    className={`pd-topping ${selected.includes(t.id) ? "selected" : ""} ${t.available ? "" : "is-disabled"}`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      disabled={!t.available}
                      checked={selected.includes(t.id)}
                      onChange={() =>
                        setSelected((v) =>
                          v.includes(t.id)
                            ? v.filter((x) => x !== t.id)
                            : [...v, t.id],
                        )
                      }
                    />
                    <span>{t.name}</span>
                    <small>+{money(t.extraPrice)}</small>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-group">
              <div className="pd-group-head">
                <h2>3. Mức đá & độ ngọt</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="pd-segments" role="group" aria-label="Mức đá">
                {ICE.map((x) => (
                  <button
                    key={x}
                    aria-pressed={ice === x}
                    className={ice === x ? "selected" : ""}
                    onClick={() => setIce(x)}
                  >
                    {x}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="pd-segments" role="group" aria-label="Mức đường">
                {SUGAR.map((x) => (
                  <button
                    key={x}
                    aria-pressed={sugar === x}
                    className={sugar === x ? "selected" : ""}
                    onClick={() => setSugar(x)}
                  >
                    {x}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <label className="pd-note">
              <span>
                <Icon name="note" size={16} /> Ghi chú cho Barista
              </span>
              <input
                value={note}
                maxLength={120}
                onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ví dụ: ít đá, nhiều sữa đặc, mang đi..."
              />
            </label>
            <div className="pd-total">
              <div className="pd-qty">
                <span>Số lượng:</span>
                <Quantity value={quantity} onChange={setQuantity} />
              </div>
              <div className="pd-total-price">
                <small>Tổng thanh toán:</small>
                <strong>{money(unit * quantity)}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
            {product.stock === 0 && (
              <p className="error">Món này đang hết hàng.</p>
            )}
            {product.stock > 0 && quantity > product.stock && (
              <p className="error">Chỉ còn {product.stock} phần.</p>
            )}
            {invalid && <p className="error">Tùy chọn không hợp lệ.</p>}
            {cartError && (
              <p className="error" role="alert">
                {cartError}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="pd-actions">
              <button
                className="pd-btn pd-btn-dark"
                disabled={blocked || adding}
                onClick={() => submit("/cart")}
              >
                <Icon name="bag" size={18} />
                Thêm vào giỏ hàng
              </button>
              <button
                className="pd-btn pd-btn-caramel"
                disabled={blocked || adding}
                onClick={() => submit("/checkout")}
              >
                <Icon name="bolt" size={18} />
                Mua ngay
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-assure">
              <span>
                <Icon name="clock" size={14} /> Pha chế trong khoảng 20 phút
              </span>
              <span>
                <Icon name="snow" size={14} /> Đá viên bảo quản riêng
              </span>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
      <section className="pd-details">
        <div className="container">
          <span className="pd-eyebrow">Artisanal details</span>
          <h2 className="pd-section-title">Mô tả sản phẩm & Nguồn gốc</h2>
          <p className="pd-section-lead">{product.description}</p>
          <div className="pd-info-grid">
            {story.cards.map(([icon, title, text], i) => (
              <article key={title} className="pd-info">
                <span className={`pd-info-icon tone-${i}`}>
                  <Icon name={icon} size={18} />
                </span>
                <h3>{title}</h3>
                <p>{text}</p>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="pd-scores">
            <div>
              <span className="pd-scores-eyebrow">Cân bằng hương vị</span>
              <h3>Chỉ số hương vị Barista</h3>
              <p>Thước đo độ đậm và các tầng hương vị đặc trưng của dòng {product.category}.</p>
            </div>
            {story.scores.map(([label, score], i) => (
              <div key={label} className="pd-score">
                <div>
                  <span>{label}</span>
                  <span>{score} / 10</span>
                </div>
                <div className="pd-bar">
                  <span className={`tone-${i}`} style={{ width: `${score * 10}%` }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      {related.length > 0 && (
        <section className="container pd-related">
          <div className="pd-related-head">
            <div>
              <span className="pd-eyebrow">Thực đơn chọn lọc</span>
              <h2 className="pd-section-title">Có thể bạn sẽ thích</h2>
            </div>
            <Link href="/#menu">
              Xem tất cả <Icon name="arrowRight" size={14} />
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="pd-related-grid">
            {related.map((p) => (
              <article key={p.id} className="pd-related-card">
                <Link href={`/products/${p.id}`} className="pd-related-photo">
                  <ProductImage src={p.imageUrl} alt={p.name} />
                  <span>{p.category}</span>
                </Link>
                <div className="pd-related-body">
                  <Link href={`/products/${p.id}`}>
                    <h3>{p.name}</h3>
                  </Link>
                  <p>{p.description}</p>
                  <div className="pd-related-bottom">
                    <strong>{money(p.price)}</strong>
                    <button
                      disabled={p.stock < 1}
                      aria-label={`Thêm nhanh ${p.name}`}
                      onClick={() => quickAdd(p)}
                    >
                      {p.stock < 1 ? (
                        "Tạm hết"
                      ) : quickAdded === p.id ? (
                        "Đã thêm"
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Icon name="plus" size={14} /> Thêm nhanh
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { services } from "@/services";
import type { Order } from "@/types/domain";
import { money } from "@/types/domain";
import { ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge } from "@/components/ui";
import "./profile.css";

export default function Profile() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading, refresh, logout } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [points, setPoints] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const userId = user?.id;

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!userId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const [loyalty, mine] = await Promise.all([
        services.loyalty.get(userId).catch(() => ({ points: user?.loyaltyPoints ?? 0 })),
        services.orders.mine(userId),
      ]);
      setPoints(loyalty.points ?? user?.loyaltyPoints ?? 0);
      setOrders([...mine].sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.createdAt) - Date.parse(a.createdAt)));
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không tải được hồ sơ");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [userId, refresh, user?.loyaltyPoints]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !userId) router.replace("/login?next=%2Fprofile");
    else if (userId) void load();
  }, [authLoading, userId, router, load]);

  return (
    <main className="container main member-page">
      <div className="breadcrumb"><Link href="/">Trang chủ</Link><span>›</span> Hồ sơ &amp; thẻ thành viên</div>
      <div className="member-heading">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">Tài khoản cá nhân</span>
          <h1 className="section-title">Trung tâm Thành viên</h1>
          <p>Quản lý tài khoản, điểm BrewLite Rewards và các đơn hàng của bạn.</p>
        </div>
        <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={load} disabled={loading || !userId}>↻ Làm mới</button>
      </div>
      {authLoading || loading ? <Loading /> : error ? <ErrorState message={error} retry={load} /> : user ? (
        <div className="member-grid">
          <section className="member-main">
            <div className="member-identity card">
              <div className="member-avatar" aria-hidden="true">{user.name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div className="member-identity-copy">
                <span className="eyebrow">Thành viên BrewLite</span>
                <h2>{user.name}</h2>
                <p>{user.email}</p>
                <small>{user.role === "BARISTA" ? "Nhân viên Barista" : "Khách hàng"}</small>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="member-card">
              <div className="member-card-top"><div><span className="eyebrow">BrewLite Rewards</span><h2>Thẻ thành viên</h2></div><span className="member-card-symbol" aria-hidden="true">✦</span></div>
              <p className="member-card-points"><strong>{points ?? user.loyaltyPoints ?? 0}</strong> điểm</p>
              <p className="member-card-id">BL · {user.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}</p>
              <p className="member-card-note">Điểm hiển thị từ dữ liệu tài khoản. Chính sách đổi điểm và voucher đang chờ tích hợp từ nhóm backend.</p>
            </div>
            <section className="member-history card panel">
              <div className="member-section-head"><div><span className="eyebrow">Hoạt động gần đây</span><h2>Đơn hàng của tôi</h2></div><Link href="/orders">Xem tất cả →</Link></div>
              {orders.length === 0 ? <p className="muted">Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào. <Link href="/#menu">Khám phá thực đơn</Link></p> : orders.slice(0, 3).map((order) => (
                <Link className="member-order" href={`/orders/${order.id}`} key={order.id}>
                  <div><strong>Đơn #{order.id}</strong><small>{new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} · {order.items.length} món</small></div>
                  <div><StatusBadge status={order.status} /><strong>{money(order.total)}</strong></div>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </section>
          </section>
          <aside className="member-side">
            <section className="card panel member-benefits">
              <span className="eyebrow">Ưu đãi thành viên</span>
              <h2>Kho voucher của tôi</h2>
              <p>Voucher cá nhân sẽ xuất hiện ở đây khi dịch vụ ưu đãi được kết nối. Bạn vẫn có thể nhập mã khuyến mãi hợp lệ ở bước thanh toán.</p>
              <Link className="btn btn-secondary" href="/cart">Đi tới giỏ hàng</Link>
            </section>
            <section className="card panel member-shortcuts">
              <h2>Thao tác nhanh</h2>
              <Link href="/orders">Lịch sử đơn hàng <span>→</span></Link>
              <Link href="/#menu">Tiếp tục khám phá món <span>→</span></Link>
              {user.role === "BARISTA" && <Link href="/barista/dashboard">Trạm Barista <span>→</span></Link>}
              <button onClick={async () => { await logout(); router.push("/"); }}>Đăng xuất tài khoản <span>→</span></button>
            </section>
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </main>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { Suspense, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { authService } from "@/services/auth";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { AuthFeature } from "@/components/auth-feature";
function Form() {
  const router = useRouter(),
    params = useSearchParams(),
    { refresh } = useAuth(),
    [name, setName] = useState(""),
    [email, setEmail] = useState(""),
    [password, setPassword] = useState(""),
    [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const next = params.get("next");
  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp");
      return;
    }
    if (
      password.length < 8 ||
      !/[A-Z]/.test(password) ||
      !/[0-9]/.test(password)
    ) {
      setError("Mật khẩu cần ít nhất 8 ký tự, 1 chữ hoa và 1 chữ số");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await authService.register(name, email, password);
      await refresh();
      router.replace(
        next?.startsWith("/") && !next.startsWith("//") ? next : "/",
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Đăng ký thất bại");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <main className="container main auth-main">
      <div className="auth-layout">
        <AuthFeature />
        <div className="auth-wrap card panel">
        <nav className="auth-tabs" aria-label="Tài khoản">
          <Link href="/login">Đăng nhập</Link>
          <span className="active">Đăng ký</span>
        </nav>
        <span className="eyebrow">Gia nhập BrewLite</span>
        <h1 className="section-title">Tạo tài khoản mới</h1>
        <p className="auth-intro">Tạo tài khoản để đặt món nhanh hơn và theo dõi đơn hàng của bạn.</p>
        <form className="form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <label>
            Họ tên
            <input
              className="field"
              minLength={2}
              required
              placeholder="Tên của bạn"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="name"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Email
            <input
              className="field"
              type="email"
              required
              placeholder="ban@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="email"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Mật khẩu
            <input
              className="field"
              type="password"
              required
              placeholder="Ít nhất 8 ký tự, có chữ hoa và số"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="new-password"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Xác nhận mật khẩu
            <input
              className="field"
              type="password"
              required
              placeholder="Nhập lại mật khẩu"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="new-password"
            />
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="error">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Đang tạo tài khoản..." : "Đăng ký"}
          </button>
        </form>
        <p>
          Đã có tài khoản? <Link href="/login">Đăng nhập ngay</Link>
        </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
export default function Register() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <Form />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
````

````tsx
        <div className="auth-benefits">
          <strong>Đặc quyền BrewLite Club</strong>
          <span>✦ &nbsp; Theo dõi đơn hàng dễ dàng</span>
          <span>✦ &nbsp; Lưu lịch sử đặt món</span>
          <span>✦ &nbsp; Tích điểm sau khi thanh toán</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { authService } from "@/services/auth";
import { ApiError } from "@/services/http";
import type { User } from "@/types/domain";
type AuthContextType = {
  user: User | null;
  loading: boolean;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
};
const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({
  user: null,
  loading: true,
  refresh: async () => {},
  logout: async () => {},
});
export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setUser((await authService.me()).user);
    } catch {
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const expired = () => setUser(null);
    window.addEventListener("brewlite:session-expired", expired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("brewlite:session-expired", expired);
  }, []);
  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      await authService.logout();
      setUser(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 401) {
        setUser(null);
        return;
      }
      throw error;
    }
  };
  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, refresh, logout }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}
export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { dataMode, services } from "@/services";
import type { Order, OrderStatus } from "@/types/domain";
import { money } from "@/types/domain";
import { ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge } from "@/components/ui";
import "./barista-board.css";

export type BaristaView = "dashboard" | "orders" | "preparing" | "ready" | "history";
type Action = { order: Order; next: OrderStatus };

const navigation: { view: BaristaView; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { view: "dashboard", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "▦" },
  { view: "orders", label: "Đơn chờ pha", icon: "◷" },
  { view: "preparing", label: "Đang pha chế", icon: "☕" },
  { view: "ready", label: "Chờ giao", icon: "✓" },
  { view: "history", label: "Lịch sử xử lý", icon: "↺" },
];
const columns: { status: OrderStatus; label: string; next: OrderStatus; action: string }[] = [
  { status: "PAID", label: "Chờ pha chế", next: "PREPARING", action: "Bắt đầu pha chế" },
  { status: "PREPARING", label: "Đang pha chế", next: "READY", action: "Đã pha chế xong" },
  { status: "READY", label: "Sẵn sàng giao", next: "COMPLETED", action: "Xác nhận đã giao" },
];
const viewStatus: Partial<Record<BaristaView, OrderStatus>> = {
  orders: "PAID",
  preparing: "PREPARING",
  ready: "READY",
};
const statusLabel: Record<OrderStatus, string> = {
  PENDING: "Chờ thanh toán",
  PAID: "Đã thanh toán",
  PAYMENT_FAILED: "Thanh toán thất bại",
  PREPARING: "Đang pha chế",
  READY: "Sẵn sàng giao",
  COMPLETED: "Đã giao khách",
  CANCELLED: "Đã hủy",
};
const minutesWaiting = (iso: string) =>
  Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 60000));
const canCancel = (status: OrderStatus) =>
  ["PENDING", "PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED"].includes(status);

export function BaristaBoard({ view }: { view: BaristaView }) {
  const { user, loading: authLoading, logout } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [action, setAction] = useState<Action | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [signingOut, setSigningOut] = useState(false);
  const inFlight = useRef(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const rows = await services.barista.list();
      setOrders(rows.sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt)));
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Không tải được đơn hàng");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || signingOut) return;
    if (!user) router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/barista/${view}`)}`);
    else if (user.role !== "BARISTA") router.replace("/forbidden");
    else void load();
  }, [authLoading, signingOut, user, view, router, load]);

  const openAction = (order: Order, next: OrderStatus) => {
    if (inFlight.current) return;
    setReason("");
    setAction({ order, next });
  };
  const submitAction = async () => {
    if (!action || inFlight.current) return;
    if (action.next === "CANCELLED" && !reason.trim()) {
      setError("Vui lòng nhập lý do hủy đơn");
      return;
    }
    inFlight.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const updated = action.next === "CANCELLED"
        ? await services.barista.cancel(action.order.id, reason.trim())
        : await services.barista.transition(action.order.id, action.next);
      setDetail((current) => current?.id === updated.id ? updated : current);
      setAction(null);
      setNotice(`Đơn #${updated.id}: ${statusLabel[updated.status]}`);
      await load();
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Không thể cập nhật đơn");
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (authLoading || !user || user.role !== "BARISTA")
    return <main className="barista-gate"><Loading label="Đang kiểm tra quyền Barista..." /></main>;

  const counts = {
    PAID: orders.filter((order) => order.status === "PAID").length,
    PREPARING: orders.filter((order) => order.status === "PREPARING").length,
    READY: orders.filter((order) => order.status === "READY").length,
    COMPLETED: orders.filter((order) =>
      order.status === "COMPLETED" &&
      order.completedAt &&
      new Date(order.completedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),
    ).length,
  };
  const visibleColumns = view === "dashboard"
    ? columns
    : columns.filter((column) => column.status === viewStatus[view]);
  const history = orders.filter((order) =>
    ["COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(order.status) &&
    `${order.id} ${order.customerName ?? ""} ${order.items.map((item) => item.name).join(" ")}`
      .toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN").includes(search.toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN")),
  ).reverse();

  const ticket = (order: Order, next?: OrderStatus, label?: string) => (
    <article className={`barista-ticket barista-ticket-${order.status.toLowerCase()}`} key={order.id}>
      <div className="barista-ticket-top">
        <strong>#{order.id}</strong>
        <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
      </div>
      <p className="barista-meta">
        {order.customerName || `Khách #${order.userId.slice(0, 8)}`} · {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
      </p>
      {order.status !== "COMPLETED" && order.status !== "CANCELLED" && (
        <p className="barista-wait">◷ Chờ {minutesWaiting(order.createdAt)} phút</p>
      )}
      <div className="barista-recipes">
        {order.items.map((item) => (
          <div className="barista-recipe" key={item.key}>
            <div><strong>{item.quantity}× {item.name}</strong><span>Size {item.size}</span></div>
            <small>{[item.ice, item.sugar, ...item.toppingNames].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</small>
            {item.note && <p className="barista-note">Ghi chú: {item.note}</p>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {order.cancelReason && <p className="barista-note">Lý do hủy: {order.cancelReason}</p>}
      <div className="barista-ticket-total"><span>Tổng đơn</span><strong>{money(order.total)}</strong></div>
      <div className="barista-ticket-actions">
        {next && <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => openAction(order, next)}>{label}</button>}
        <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => setDetail(order)}>Chi tiết</button>
        {dataMode !== "api" && canCancel(order.status) && <button className="btn btn-danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => openAction(order, "CANCELLED")}>Báo sự cố</button>}
      </div>
    </article>
  );

  return (
    <div className="barista-workspace">
      <header className="barista-header">
        <Link href="/barista/dashboard" className="barista-brand">☕ <span>BrewLite KDS</span></Link>
        <span className="barista-label">Trạm Barista</span>
        <div className="barista-identity"><strong>{user.name}</strong><small>Nhân viên pha chế</small></div>
      </header>
      <aside className="barista-sidebar" aria-label="Điều hành pha chế">
        <div className="barista-sidebar-title">Điều hành pha chế</div>
        <nav>{navigation.map((item) => (
          <Link key={item.view} href={`/barista/${item.view}`} aria-current={view === item.view ? "page" : undefined}>
            <span aria-hidden="true">{item.icon}</span>{item.label}
          </Link>
        ))}</nav>
        <button className="barista-signout" disabled={signingOut} onClick={async () => {
          setSigningOut(true);
          try { await logout(); router.replace("/login"); }
          catch (cause) { setSigningOut(false); setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Không thể đăng xuất"); }
        }}>Đăng xuất ca trực</button>
      </aside>
      <main className="barista-content">
        <section className="barista-ribbon">
          <div><span className="eyebrow">BrewLite · Trạm pha chế</span><h1>Trạm Barista KDS</h1><p>Đơn hàng và tiến độ pha chế được cập nhật từ cùng nguồn dữ liệu.</p></div>
          <div className="barista-ribbon-actions"><span className="barista-online">● {dataMode === "api" ? "API trực tuyến" : "Chế độ demo"}</span><button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => void load()} disabled={loading}>↻ Làm mới</button></div>
        </section>
        {notice && <div className="barista-toast" role="status">✓ {notice}<button aria-label="Đóng thông báo" onClick={() => setNotice("")}>×</button></div>}
        {error && !action && <ErrorState message={error} retry={() => void load()} />}
        <section className="barista-kpis" aria-label="Tổng quan đơn hàng">
          <div><small>Đơn mới chờ pha</small><strong>{counts.PAID}</strong></div>
          <div><small>Đang pha chế</small><strong>{counts.PREPARING}</strong></div>
          <div><small>Chờ giao tại quầy</small><strong>{counts.READY}</strong></div>
          <div><small>Đã giao hôm nay</small><strong>{dataMode === "api" ? "—" : counts.COMPLETED}</strong></div>
        </section>
        {loading ? <Loading label="Đang tải đơn hàng..." /> : view === "history" ? (
          <section className="barista-history">
            <div className="barista-section-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">Lịch sử xử lý</span><h2>Đơn đã hoàn tất và đã hủy</h2></div><label>Tìm đơn<input className="field" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Mã đơn, khách, món..." /></label></div>
            {dataMode === "api" ? <div className="barista-empty">Lịch sử xử lý đang chờ API Staff Orders của TV4.</div> : history.length ? <div className="barista-history-grid">{history.map((order) => ticket(order))}</div> : <div className="barista-empty">Không có đơn phù hợp trong lịch sử.</div>}
          </section>
        ) : (
          <section className={`barista-board ${view !== "dashboard" ? "barista-board-focused" : ""}`} aria-label="Hàng đợi pha chế">
            {visibleColumns.map((column, index) => {
              const queue = orders.filter((order) => order.status === column.status);
              return <div className="barista-column" key={column.status}>
                <div className="barista-column-heading"><h2><span className={`barista-dot barista-dot-${column.status.toLowerCase()}`} />{view === "dashboard" ? `${index + 1}. ` : ""}{column.label}</h2><span>{queue.length} đơn</span></div>
                {queue.length ? queue.map((order) => ticket(order, column.next, column.action)) : <div className="barista-empty">Chưa có đơn {column.label.toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN")}.</div>}
              </div>;
            })}
          </section>
        )}
        <p className="barista-demo-note">{dataMode === "api" ? "Staff API hiện hỗ trợ hàng đợi và chuyển trạng thái; hủy có lý do, lịch sử và KPI hoàn tất còn chờ TV4." : "Đơn demo được chia sẻ với trang Đơn hàng của tôi trên cùng trình duyệt."}</p>
      </main>
      {detail && <div className="barista-overlay" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setDetail(null); }}>
        <section className="barista-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`Chi tiết đơn ${detail.id}`}>
          <div className="row"><span className="eyebrow">Chi tiết đơn hàng</span><button className="barista-close" onClick={() => setDetail(null)} aria-label="Đóng chi tiết">×</button></div>
          <h2>#{detail.id}</h2><StatusBadge status={detail.status} />
          <p>{detail.customerName || `Khách #${detail.userId.slice(0, 8)}`} · {new Date(detail.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</p>
          {detail.items.map((item) => <div className="barista-recipe" key={item.key}><strong>{item.quantity}× {item.name} · Size {item.size}</strong><small>{[item.ice, item.sugar, ...item.toppingNames].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</small>{item.note && <p className="barista-note">Ghi chú: {item.note}</p>}</div>)}
          {detail.cancelReason && <p className="barista-note">Lý do hủy: {detail.cancelReason}</p>}
          <div className="barista-ticket-total"><span>Tổng đơn</span><strong>{money(detail.total)}</strong></div>
          <p className="barista-meta">Tiến trình: {statusLabel[detail.status]}</p>
          <div className="barista-ticket-actions">{columns.filter((column) => column.status === detail.status).map((column) => <button className="btn btn-primary" key={column.status} onClick={() => openAction(detail, column.next)}>{column.action}</button>)}{dataMode !== "api" && canCancel(detail.status) && <button className="btn btn-danger" onClick={() => openAction(detail, "CANCELLED")}>Hủy đơn sự cố</button>}</div>
        </section>
      </div>}
      {action && <div className="barista-overlay" role="presentation">
        <section className="barista-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Xác nhận cập nhật đơn">
          <span className="eyebrow">Xác nhận thao tác</span>
          <h2>{action.next === "CANCELLED" ? "Hủy đơn hàng sự cố" : statusLabel[action.next]}</h2>
          <p>Đơn #{action.order.id} · {money(action.order.total)}</p>
          {action.next === "CANCELLED" && <label className="barista-reason">Lý do hủy đơn<textarea className="field" value={reason} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} maxLength={300} placeholder="Ví dụ: Hết nguyên liệu..." required /></label>}
          {error && <p className="error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
          <div className="barista-ticket-actions"><button className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setAction(null); setError(""); }}>Quay lại</button><button className={action.next === "CANCELLED" ? "btn btn-danger" : "btn btn-primary"} disabled={busy || (action.next === "CANCELLED" && !reason.trim())} onClick={() => void submitAction()}>{busy ? "Đang cập nhật..." : "Xác nhận"}</button></div>
        </section>
      </div>}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "./auth-provider";
import { useCart } from "@/stores/cart";
/** Đăng nhập: gộp giỏ khách lên server/tải giỏ tài khoản. Đăng xuất: xóa bản sao giỏ trên máy. */
export function CartSync() {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth(),
    userId = user?.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading) return;
    const cart = useCart.getState();
    if (userId) void cart.attach(userId);
    else if (cart.owner) cart.detach();
  }, [loading, userId]);
  return null;
}
````

````tsx
import type { CartItem } from "@/types/domain";
import { cartTotal, money } from "@/types/domain";
export function OrderSummary({
  items,
  discount = 0,
}: {
  items: CartItem[];
  discount?: number;
}) {
  const subtotal = cartTotal(items);
  return (
    <div>
      <h2 className="section-title" style={{ fontSize: 23 }}>
        Tóm tắt đơn hàng
      </h2>
      <div className="summary-line">
        <span>Tạm tính</span>
        <strong>{money(subtotal)}</strong>
      </div>
      {discount > 0 && (
        <div className="summary-line success">
          <span>Ưu đãi</span>
          <strong>−{money(discount)}</strong>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="summary-line total">
        <span>Tổng cộng</span>
        <span>{money(Math.max(0, subtotal - discount))}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import type { OrderStatus } from "@/types/domain";
export function Loading({ label = "Đang tải..." }: { label?: string }) {
  return (
    <div role="status" className="panel card" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
      <div className="spinner" />
      {label}
    </div>
  );
}
export function Empty({
  message,
  action,
}: {
  message: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="panel card" style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 42 }}>
      <h2>Chưa có nội dung</h2>
      <p className="muted">{message}</p>
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}
export function ErrorState({
  message,
  retry,
}: {
  message: string;
  retry?: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div role="alert" className="panel card">
      <p className="error">{message}</p>
      {retry && (
        <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={retry}>
          Thử lại
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function Quantity({
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: number;
  onChange: (n: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="quantity">
      <button
        aria-label="Giảm số lượng"
        disabled={value <= 1}
        onClick={() => onChange(value - 1)}
      >
        −
      </button>
      <span>{value}</span>
      <button
        aria-label="Tăng số lượng"
        disabled={value >= 99}
        onClick={() => onChange(value + 1)}
      >
        +
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
const labels: Record<OrderStatus, string> = {
  PENDING: "Chờ thanh toán",
  PAID: "Đã thanh toán",
  PAYMENT_FAILED: "Thanh toán thất bại",
  PREPARING: "Đang pha chế",
  READY: "Sẵn sàng nhận",
  COMPLETED: "Đã hoàn tất",
  CANCELLED: "Đã hủy",
};
export function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: OrderStatus }) {
  return <span className={`status ${status}`}>{labels[status]}</span>;
}
export function Timeline({ status }: { status: OrderStatus }) {
  if (status === "PAYMENT_FAILED" || status === "CANCELLED")
    return <StatusBadge status={status} />;
  const states: OrderStatus[] = [
    "PENDING",
    "PAID",
    "PREPARING",
    "READY",
    "COMPLETED",
  ];
  return (
    <div className="timeline">
      {states.map((s, i) => (
        <span key={s} className={i <= states.indexOf(status) ? "done" : ""}>
          {labels[s]}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
export function ProductImage({
  src,
  alt,
  className,
}: {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const fallback = /matcha/i.test(alt)
    ? "/images/products/sample-matcha.svg"
    : /trà|đào/i.test(alt)
      ? "/images/products/sample-iced-tea.svg"
      : /cappuccino|americano|macchiato/i.test(alt)
        ? "/images/products/sample-latte.svg"
        : "/images/products/sample-milk-coffee.svg";
  return (
    // Original Stitch photos are remote; keep a local fallback for offline demos.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img
      className={className}
      src={src}
      alt={alt}
      onError={(e) => {
        if (e.currentTarget.src.endsWith(fallback)) {
          e.currentTarget.style.visibility = "hidden";
          e.currentTarget.parentElement?.classList.add("image-fallback");
        } else e.currentTarget.src = fallback;
      }}
    />
  );
}
````

````typescript
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { afterEach, test } from 'node:test';
import { apiOrders, apiPayments, apiBarista } from './api';
import { ApiError } from './http';
import type { CartItem } from '../types/domain';

const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
afterEach(() => { globalThis.fetch = originalFetch; });
const item: CartItem = {
  key: 'local-key', productId: 'product', name: 'Untrusted name', imageUrl: '/local.svg',
  size: 'M', toppingIds: ['topping'], toppingNames: ['Untrusted topping'], unitPrice: 1,
  quantity: 2, ice: '70% đá', sugar: '50% ít ngọt', note: 'Ít nóng',
};

test('orders adapter posts options and cookie credentials, never client price/owner/discount', async () => {
  let call: { url: string; init?: RequestInit } | undefined;
  const order = { id: 'server-order', status: 'PENDING', total: 80000 };
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => {
    call = { url: String(url), init };
    return Response.json(order, { status: 201 });
  };
  assert.deepEqual(await apiOrders.create('untrusted-owner', [item], { code: 'SERVER_CODE', discount: 999999 }), order);
  assert.ok(call);
  assert.ok(call.url.endsWith('/orders'));
  assert.equal(call.init?.credentials, 'include');
  assert.equal(call.init?.method, 'POST');
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(String(call.init?.body)), {
    items: [{ productId: 'product', size: 'M', toppingIds: ['topping'], quantity: 2, ice: '70% đá', sugar: '50% ít ngọt', note: 'Ít nóng' }],
    promotionCode: 'SERVER_CODE',
  });
});

test('stock conflict remains an API error with a clear message and leaves the cart input intact', async () => {
  const items = [structuredClone(item)];
  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ message: 'Không đủ tồn kho' }, { status: 409 });
  await assert.rejects(apiOrders.create('user', items), (error: unknown) => {
    assert.ok(error instanceof ApiError);
    assert.equal(error.status, 409);
    assert.equal(error.message, 'Không đủ tồn kho');
    return true;
  });
  assert.deepEqual(items, [item]);
});

test('validation messages are shown together; network errors do not fall back to demo orders', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ message: ['quantity must be positive', 'size is invalid'] }, { status: 400 });
  await assert.rejects(apiOrders.create('user', [item]), /quantity must be positive, size is invalid/);
  globalThis.fetch = async () => { throw new Error('Network unavailable'); };
  await assert.rejects(apiOrders.create('user', [item]), /Network unavailable/);
});

test('history, detail, status and staff requests retain authentication and expected routes', async () => {
  const calls: { url: string; init?: RequestInit }[] = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => { calls.push({ url: String(url), init }); return Response.json([]); };
  await apiOrders.mine('ignored');
  await apiOrders.get('order/id');
  await apiOrders.status('order/id');
  await apiBarista.list();
  await apiBarista.transition('order/id', 'PREPARING');
  const paths = ['/orders/me', '/orders/order%2Fid', '/orders/order%2Fid/status', '/staff/orders', '/staff/orders/order%2Fid/status'];
  calls.forEach((call, index) => {
    assert.ok(call.url.endsWith(paths[index]));
    assert.equal(call.init?.credentials, 'include');
  });
  assert.equal(calls[4].init?.method, 'PATCH');
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(String(calls[4].init?.body)), { status: 'PREPARING' });
});

test('status adapter unwraps the JSON status response', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ status: 'PENDING' });
  assert.equal(await apiOrders.status('order'), 'PENDING');
});

test('payments adapter forwards the selected sandbox outcome to the API', async () => {
  let body: unknown;
  globalThis.fetch = async (_url, init) => {
    body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body));
    return Response.json({ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED' }, { status: 201 });
  };
  await apiPayments.pay(
    'order-id',
    'CARD',
    '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
    'PAYMENT_FAILED',
  );
  assert.deepEqual(body, {
    orderId: 'order-id',
    method: 'CARD',
    idempotencyKey: '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
    demoOutcome: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { request } from "./http";
import type {
  CartService,
  ProductService,
  OrderService,
  PaymentService,
  PromotionService,
  LoyaltyService,
  BaristaOrderService,
} from "./contracts";
import type {
  CartItem,
  CartLineInput,
  CartView,
  Order,
  Payment,
  Product,
  Promotion,
  LoyaltyPoints,
  OrderStatus,
} from "@/types/domain";
type ApiListProduct = Pick<
  Product,
  "id" | "name" | "price" | "imageUrl" | "stock" | "description"
>;
type ApiDetailProduct = Omit<Product, "category" | "sizes"> & {
  defaultSizeId?: string;
  sizes: (Product["sizes"][number] & { id?: string })[];
};
const normalize = (p: ApiDetailProduct): Product => ({
  ...p,
  category: "Thực đơn",
  sizes: p.sizes.map((s) => ({ ...s, isDefault: s.id === p.defaultSizeId })),
});
export const apiProducts: ProductService = {
  list: async () => {
    const rows = await request<ApiListProduct[]>("/products");
    return rows.map((p) => ({
      ...p,
      category: "Thực đơn",
      sizes: [],
      toppings: [],
    }));
  },
  get: async (id) => {
    try {
      return normalize(
        await request<ApiDetailProduct>(`/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as { status?: number }).status === 404) return null;
      throw e;
    }
  },
};
type ApiCartItem = Omit<CartItem, "key" | "note"> & {
  id: string;
  note: string;
  lineTotal: number;
  available: boolean;
};
type ApiCartView = Omit<CartView, "items"> & { items: ApiCartItem[] };
const toCartView = <T extends ApiCartView>(view: T) => ({
  ...view,
  items: view.items.map(
    (i): CartItem => ({
      key: i.id,
      productId: i.productId,
      name: i.name,
      imageUrl: i.imageUrl,
      size: i.size,
      sizeOptions: i.sizeOptions,
      toppingIds: i.toppingIds,
      toppingNames: i.toppingNames,
      unitPrice: i.unitPrice,
      quantity: i.quantity,
      ice: i.ice,
      sugar: i.sugar,
      note: i.note || undefined,
      issue: i.issue,
    }),
  ),
});
const line = (l: CartLineInput) => ({
  productId: l.productId,
  size: l.size,
  toppingIds: l.toppingIds,
  quantity: l.quantity,
  ice: l.ice,
  sugar: l.sugar,
  note: l.note || undefined,
});
// userId không cần gửi: server lấy từ cookie phiên đăng nhập.
export const apiCart: CartService = {
  get: async () => toCartView(await request<ApiCartView>("/cart")),
  add: async (_userId, l) =>
    toCartView(
      await request<ApiCartView>("/cart/items", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(line(l)),
      }),
    ),
  update: async (_userId, itemId, patch) =>
    toCartView(
      await request<ApiCartView>(`/cart/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(patch),
      }),
    ),
  remove: async (_userId, itemId) =>
    toCartView(
      await request<ApiCartView>(`/cart/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      }),
    ),
  clear: async () =>
    toCartView(await request<ApiCartView>("/cart", { method: "DELETE" })),
  merge: async (_userId, lines) =>
    toCartView(
      await request<
        ApiCartView & { skipped: { productId: string; reason: string }[] }
      >("/cart/merge", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ items: lines.map(line) }),
      }),
    ),
};
export const apiOrders: OrderService = {
  create: (_userId, items, promotion) =>
    request<Order>("/orders", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        items: items.map((i) => ({
          productId: i.productId,
          size: i.size,
          toppingIds: i.toppingIds,
          quantity: i.quantity,
          ice: i.ice,
          sugar: i.sugar,
          note: i.note,
        })),
        promotionCode: promotion?.code,
      }),
    }),
  mine: () => request<Order[]>("/orders/me"),
  get: (id) => request<Order>(`/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
  status: (id) =>
    request<{ status: OrderStatus }>(`/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/status`)
      .then((result) => result.status),
};
export const apiPayments: PaymentService = {
  pay: (orderId, method, idempotencyKey, demoOutcome) =>
    request<Payment>("/payments", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        orderId,
        method,
        idempotencyKey,
        ...(demoOutcome ? { demoOutcome } : {}),
      }),
    }),
};
export const apiPromotions: PromotionService = {
  validate: (code, subtotal) =>
    request<Promotion>("/promotions/validate", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ code, subtotal }),
    }),
};
export const apiLoyalty: LoyaltyService = {
  get: () => request<LoyaltyPoints>("/loyalty/me"),
};
export const apiBarista: BaristaOrderService = {
  list: () => request<Order[]>("/staff/orders"),
  get: async (id) => {
    try {
      return await request<Order>(`/staff/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as { status?: number }).status === 404) return null;
      throw e;
    }
  },
  transition: (id, status) =>
    request<Order>(`/staff/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/status`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
    }),
  cancel: (id, reason) =>
    request<Order>(`/staff/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/cancel`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
    }),
};
````

````typescript
import type {
  CartItem,
  CartLineInput,

  ProductSize,
  LoyaltyPoints,
  Order,
  OrderStatus,
  Payment,
  PaymentMethod,
  Product,
  Promotion,
} from "@/types/domain";
export interface ProductService {
  list(): Promise<Product[]>;
  get(id: string): Promise<Product | null>;
}
/** Giỏ hàng của tài khoản đang đăng nhập; `itemId` là `CartItem.key` do server cấp. */
export interface CartService {
  get(userId: string): Promise<CartView>;
  add(userId: string, line: CartLineInput): Promise<CartView>;
  update(
    userId: string,
    itemId: string,
    patch: { quantity?: number; size?: ProductSize["code"] },
  ): Promise<CartView>;
  remove(userId: string, itemId: string): Promise<CartView>;
  clear(userId: string): Promise<CartView>;
  /** Gộp giỏ khách vãng lai sau khi đăng nhập; dòng không hợp lệ bị bỏ qua. */
  merge(
    userId: string,
    lines: CartLineInput[],
  ): Promise<CartView & { skipped: { productId: string; reason: string }[] }>;
}
export interface OrderService {
  create(
    userId: string,
    items: CartItem[],
    promotion?: Promotion,
  ): Promise<Order>;
  mine(userId: string): Promise<Order[]>;
  get(id: string): Promise<Order | null>;
  status(id: string): Promise<OrderStatus | null>;
}
export interface PaymentService {
  pay(
    orderId: string,
    method: PaymentMethod,
    idempotencyKey: string,
    demoOutcome?: "PAID" | "PAYMENT_FAILED" | "UNKNOWN",
  ): Promise<Payment>;
}
export interface PromotionService {
  validate(code: string, subtotal: number): Promise<Promotion>;
}
export interface LoyaltyService {
  get(userId: string): Promise<LoyaltyPoints>;
}
export interface BaristaOrderService {
  list(): Promise<Order[]>;
  get(id: string): Promise<Order | null>;
  transition(id: string, status: OrderStatus): Promise<Order>;
  cancel(id: string, reason: string): Promise<Order>;
}
````

````typescript
export const API_BASE =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:3001/api";
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}
export async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    credentials: "include",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...init?.headers },
    ...init,
  });
  const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined" && path !== "/auth/login")
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("brewlite:session-expired"));
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new ApiError(
      response.status,
      Array.isArray(body?.message)
        ? body.message.join(", ")
        : body?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`,
    );
  return body as T;
}
````

````typescript
import {
  apiProducts,
  apiCart,
  apiOrders,
  apiPayments,
  apiPromotions,
  apiLoyalty,
  apiBarista,
} from "./api";
import {
  mockProducts,
  mockCart,
  mockOrders,
  mockPayments,
  mockPromotions,
  mockLoyalty,
  mockBarista,
} from "./mock";
/**
 * mock: mọi module giả lập (trừ auth).
 * hybrid: sản phẩm + giỏ hàng gọi backend thật (đã có); đơn/thanh toán/ưu đãi/điểm/Barista vẫn giả lập.
 * api: mọi module gọi REST; lỗi không tự chuyển sang mock.
 */
export type DataMode = "mock" | "hybrid" | "api";
const mode = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_MODE;
export const dataMode: DataMode =
  mode === "api" || mode === "hybrid" ? mode : "mock";
const catalogApi = dataMode !== "mock",
  allApi = dataMode === "api";
/** Thanh toán/đơn hàng còn giả lập: hiện lựa chọn kết quả demo và banner. */
export const demoOrders = !allApi;
/** Cho phép chọn phản hồi gateway sandbox mà vẫn dùng Orders/Payments API thật. */
export const paymentDemoControls =
  demoOrders || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYMENT_DEMO_CONTROLS === "true";
export const services = {
  products: catalogApi ? apiProducts : mockProducts,
  cart: catalogApi ? apiCart : mockCart,
  orders: allApi ? apiOrders : mockOrders,
  payments: allApi ? apiPayments : mockPayments,
  promotions: allApi ? apiPromotions : mockPromotions,
  loyalty: allApi ? apiLoyalty : mockLoyalty,
  barista: allApi ? apiBarista : mockBarista,
};
````

````typescript
import { demoProducts } from "./demo-products";
import type {
  CartService,
  ProductService,
  OrderService,
  PaymentService,
  PromotionService,
  LoyaltyService,
  BaristaOrderService,
} from "./contracts";

  CartLineInput,

  OrderStatus,
  Payment,
} from "@/types/domain";

const ORDERS = "brewlite-demo-orders-v1",
  PAYMENTS = "brewlite-demo-payments-v1",

const pause = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 350));
const read = <T>(key: string, empty: T): T => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return empty;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "null") ?? empty;
  } catch {
    return empty;
  }
};
const write = (key: string, value: unknown) =>
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
const orders = () => read<Order[]>(ORDERS, []);
const saveOrder = (order: Order) =>
  write(
    ORDERS,
    orders().map((o) => (o.id === order.id ? order : o)),
  );
const transitions: Record<OrderStatus, OrderStatus[]> = {
  PENDING: ["PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED", "CANCELLED"],
  PAYMENT_FAILED: ["PENDING", "CANCELLED"],
  PAID: ["PREPARING", "CANCELLED"],
  PREPARING: ["READY"],
  READY: ["COMPLETED"],
  COMPLETED: [],
  CANCELLED: [],

  },

type StoredLine = CartLineInput & { id: string; note: string };
const lineKey = (l: StoredLine) =>
  itemKey(l.productId, l.size, l.toppingIds, l.ice, l.sugar, l.note);
const readCart = (userId: string) =>
  read<Record<string, StoredLine[]>>(CARTS, {})[userId] ?? [];
const writeCart = (userId: string, lines: StoredLine[]) =>
  write(CARTS, { ...read<Record<string, StoredLine[]>>(CARTS, {}), [userId]: lines });
const priceLine = (l: Pick<StoredLine, "productId" | "size" | "toppingIds">) => {
  const product = demoProducts.find((p) => p.id === l.productId);
  if (!product) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy sản phẩm");
  const size = product.sizes.find((s) => s.code === l.size);
  if (!size?.available) throw new Error(`Size ${l.size} tạm hết`);
  const toppings = l.toppingIds.map((id) => {
    const t = product.toppings.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!t) throw new Error("Topping không thuộc món này");
    if (!t.available) throw new Error(`${t.name} tạm hết`);
    return t;
  });
  return { product, size, toppings };
};
const stockError = (lines: StoredLine[], productId: string, before: number) => {
  const product = demoProducts.find((p) => p.id === productId)!;
  const total = lines
    .filter((l) => l.productId === productId)
    .reduce((n, l) => n + l.quantity, 0);
  if (total > before && total > product.stock)
    throw new Error(
      product.stock === 0
        ? `${product.name} đang hết hàng`
        : `${product.name} chỉ còn ${product.stock} phần`,
    );
};
const productTotal = (lines: StoredLine[], productId: string) =>
  lines.filter((l) => l.productId === productId).reduce((n, l) => n + l.quantity, 0);
const cartView = (lines: StoredLine[]): CartView => {
  const items = lines.map((l) => {
    const { product, size, toppings } = priceLine(l);
    const issue =
      productTotal(lines, l.productId) > product.stock
        ? `${product.name} chỉ còn ${product.stock} phần`
        : undefined;
    return {
      key: l.id,
      productId: l.productId,
      name: product.name,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
      size: l.size,
      sizeOptions: product.sizes,
      toppingIds: l.toppingIds,
      toppingNames: toppings.map((t) => t.name),
      unitPrice:
        product.price + size.extraPrice + toppings.reduce((n, t) => n + t.extraPrice, 0),
      quantity: l.quantity,
      ice: l.ice,
      sugar: l.sugar,
      note: l.note || undefined,
      ...(issue ? { issue } : {}),
    };
  });
  return {
    items,
    totalQuantity: items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0),
    subtotal: cartTotal(items),
    valid: items.every((i) => !i.issue),
  };
};
const addLine = (lines: StoredLine[], input: CartLineInput) => {
  priceLine(input);
  const line: StoredLine = {
    ...input,
    toppingIds: [...new Set(input.toppingIds)].sort(),
    note: (input.note ?? "").trim(),
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  };
  const before = productTotal(lines, line.productId);
  const existing = lines.find((l) => lineKey(l) === lineKey(line));
  const next = existing
    ? lines.map((l) =>
        l === existing
          ? { ...l, quantity: Math.min(99, l.quantity + line.quantity) }
          : l,
      )
    : [...lines, line];
  stockError(next, line.productId, before);
  return next;
};
export const mockCart: CartService = {
  async get(userId) {
    await pause();
    return cartView(readCart(userId));
  },
  async add(userId, input) {
    await pause();
    const next = addLine(readCart(userId), input);
    writeCart(userId, next);
    return cartView(next);
  },
  async update(userId, itemId, patch) {
    await pause();
    const lines = readCart(userId),
      item = lines.find((l) => l.id === itemId);
    if (!item) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy món trong giỏ");
    const changed = {
      ...item,
      size: patch.size ?? item.size,
      quantity: patch.quantity ?? item.quantity,
    };
    if (changed.size !== item.size) priceLine(changed);
    const target = lines.find((l) => l.id !== item.id && lineKey(l) === lineKey(changed));
    const next = target
      ? lines
          .filter((l) => l.id !== item.id)
          .map((l) =>
            l === target
              ? { ...l, quantity: Math.min(99, l.quantity + changed.quantity) }
              : l,
          )
      : lines.map((l) => (l.id === item.id ? changed : l));
    stockError(next, item.productId, productTotal(lines, item.productId));
    writeCart(userId, next);
    return cartView(next);
  },
  async remove(userId, itemId) {
    await pause();
    const lines = readCart(userId);
    if (!lines.some((l) => l.id === itemId))
      throw new Error("Không tìm thấy món trong giỏ");
    const next = lines.filter((l) => l.id !== itemId);
    writeCart(userId, next);
    return cartView(next);
  },
  async clear(userId) {
    await pause();
    writeCart(userId, []);
    return cartView([]);
  },
  async merge(userId, inputs) {
    await pause();
    let lines = readCart(userId);
    const skipped: { productId: string; reason: string }[] = [];
    for (const input of inputs) {
      try {
        lines = addLine(lines, input);
      } catch (e) {
        skipped.push({
          productId: input.productId,
          reason: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không hợp lệ",
        });
      }
    }
    writeCart(userId, lines);
    return { ...cartView(lines), skipped };
  },
};

export const mockPayments: PaymentService = {
  async pay(orderId, method, idempotencyKey, demoOutcome) {
    await pause();
    const existing = read<Payment[]>(PAYMENTS, []).find(
      (p) => p.idempotencyKey === idempotencyKey,
    );
    if (existing) return existing;
    const order = orders().find((o) => o.id === orderId);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng");
    if (!["PENDING", "PAYMENT_FAILED"].includes(order.status))
      throw new Error("Đơn hàng không thể thanh toán");
    if (order.status === "PAYMENT_FAILED") saveOrder({ ...order, status: "PENDING" });
    // Kết quả được chọn trong màn demo; khóa ngẫu nhiên vẫn idempotent.
    const status = demoOutcome || "PAID";
    const payment: Payment = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      orderId,
      method,
      status,
      idempotencyKey,
    };
    write(PAYMENTS, [...read<Payment[]>(PAYMENTS, []), payment]);
    if (status !== "UNKNOWN")
      saveOrder({
        ...order,
        status,
        paymentMethod: method,
        error:
          status === "PAYMENT_FAILED"
            ? "Cổng thanh toán demo từ chối giao dịch"
            : undefined,
      });
    return payment;
  },
};

        )

    };

};
export const mockBarista: BaristaOrderService = {
  async list() {
    await pause();
    return orders().filter((o) =>
      ["PAID", "PREPARING", "READY", "COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(o.status),
    );
  },
  async get(id) {
    await pause();
    return orders().find((o) => o.id === id) || null;
  },
  async transition(id, status) {
    await pause();
    const order = orders().find((o) => o.id === id);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn");
    if (!transitions[order.status].includes(status))
      throw new Error("Chuyển trạng thái không hợp lệ");
    if (status === "CANCELLED")
      throw new Error("Cần ghi lý do hủy đơn");
    const next: Order = {
      ...order,
      status,
      ...(status === "COMPLETED" ? { completedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {}),
    };
    saveOrder(next);
    return next;
  },
  async cancel(id, reason) {
    await pause();
    const order = orders().find((o) => o.id === id);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn");
    if (!reason.trim()) throw new Error("Vui lòng ghi lý do hủy đơn");
    if (!["PENDING", "PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED"].includes(order.status))
      throw new Error("Không thể hủy đơn ở trạng thái hiện tại");
    const next: Order = { ...order, status: "CANCELLED", cancelReason: reason.trim() };
    saveOrder(next);
    return next;
  },
};
````

````typescript
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  parsePaymentIntent,
  paymentIntentKey,
  readPaymentIntent,
  removePaymentIntent,
  savePaymentIntent,
} from "./payment-intent";

const memoryStorage = () => {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  return {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => values.set(key, value),
    removeItem: (key: string) => values.delete(key),
    values,
  };
};

test("payment intent accepts only supported methods and outcomes", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    parsePaymentIntent(
      JSON.stringify({ method: "CARD", key: "payment-key", outcome: "PAID" }),
    ),
    { method: "CARD", key: "payment-key", outcome: "PAID" },
  );
  assert.equal(parsePaymentIntent("not-json"), null);
  assert.equal(
    parsePaymentIntent(JSON.stringify({ method: "CASH", key: "payment-key" })),
    null,
  );
  assert.equal(
    parsePaymentIntent(JSON.stringify({ method: "WALLET", key: "" })),
    null,
  );
});

test("payment intent storage preserves the selected method for retry", () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  savePaymentIntent(
    "order-1",
    { method: "CARD", key: "first-key", outcome: "PAYMENT_FAILED" },
    storage,
  );
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("order-1", storage)?.method, "CARD");
  removePaymentIntent("order-1", storage);
  assert.equal(storage.values.has(paymentIntentKey("order-1")), false);
});

test("invalid stored payment intent is discarded", () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  storage.setItem(paymentIntentKey("order-2"), "{");
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("order-2", storage), null);
  assert.equal(storage.values.has(paymentIntentKey("order-2")), false);
});
````

````typescript
import type { PaymentMethod } from "@/types/domain";

export type PaymentOutcome = "PAID" | "PAYMENT_FAILED" | "UNKNOWN";

export type PaymentIntent = {
  method: PaymentMethod;
  key: string;
  outcome?: PaymentOutcome;
};

const methods: PaymentMethod[] = ["WALLET", "CARD"];
const outcomes: PaymentOutcome[] = ["PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED", "UNKNOWN"];

export const paymentIntentKey = (orderId: string) =>
  `brewlite-payment-${orderId}`;

export function parsePaymentIntent(raw: string | null): PaymentIntent | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PaymentIntent>;
    if (
      !methods.includes(value.method as PaymentMethod) ||
      typeof value.key !== "string" ||
      !value.key.trim() ||
      (value.outcome !== undefined &&
        !outcomes.includes(value.outcome as PaymentOutcome))
    )
      return null;
    return {
      method: value.method as PaymentMethod,
      key: value.key,
      ...(value.outcome ? { outcome: value.outcome as PaymentOutcome } : {}),
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function readPaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "removeItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  const key = paymentIntentKey(orderId);
  const intent = parsePaymentIntent(storage.getItem(key));
  if (!intent) storage.removeItem(key);
  return intent;
}

export function savePaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  intent: PaymentIntent,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "setItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  storage.setItem(paymentIntentKey(orderId), JSON.stringify(intent));
}

export function removePaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "removeItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  storage.removeItem(paymentIntentKey(orderId));
}
````

````typescript
"use client";
import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist } from "zustand/middleware";
import { services } from "@/services";
import type { CartItem, CartLineInput, CartView, ProductSize } from "@/types/domain";
import { itemKey } from "@/types/domain";
/**
 * Khách vãng lai: giỏ chỉ nằm trong Zustand (localStorage).
 * Đã đăng nhập (`owner`): giỏ thuộc server, mỗi thao tác gọi CartService rồi lấy lại giỏ server trả về.
 * Các thao tác trả về `true` khi thành công; lỗi được ghi vào `error`.
 */
type CartStore = {
  items: CartItem[];
  promoCode: string;
  owner: string | null;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string;
  add: (item: CartItem) => Promise<boolean>;
  setQuantity: (key: string, quantity: number) => Promise<boolean>;
  changeSize: (key: string, size: ProductSize["code"], unitPrice: number) => Promise<boolean>;
  remove: (key: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  clear: () => Promise<boolean>;
  setPromoCode: (code: string) => void;
  /** Gắn giỏ với tài khoản: gộp giỏ khách lên server hoặc tải lại giỏ của tài khoản. */
  attach: (userId: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  /** Đăng xuất: bỏ bản sao giỏ của tài khoản khỏi máy. */
  detach: () => void;
  dismissError: () => void;
};
const clampQuantity = (n: number) => Math.max(1, Math.min(99, Math.floor(n)));
const merge = (items: CartItem[], item: CartItem) =>
  items.some((i) => i.key === item.key)
    ? items.map((i) =>
        i.key === item.key
          ? { ...i, quantity: Math.min(99, i.quantity + item.quantity) }
          : i,
      )
    : [...items, item];
const toLine = (i: CartItem): CartLineInput => ({
  productId: i.productId,
  size: i.size,
  toppingIds: i.toppingIds,
  quantity: i.quantity,
  ice: i.ice,
  sugar: i.sugar,
  note: i.note,
});
const message = (e: unknown) =>
  e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không thể cập nhật giỏ hàng";
export const useCart = create<CartStore>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => {
      const remote = async (work: (userId: string) => Promise<CartView>) => {
        const owner = get().owner;
        if (!owner) return false;
        set({ busy: true, error: "" });
        try {
          const view = await work(owner);
          // Bỏ qua kết quả nếu người dùng đã đăng xuất/đổi tài khoản trong lúc chờ.
          if (get().owner === owner) set({ items: view.items });
          return true;
        } catch (e) {
          if (get().owner === owner) set({ error: message(e) });
          return false;
        } finally {
          set({ busy: false });
        }
      };
      return {
        items: [],
        promoCode: "",
        owner: null,
        busy: false,
        error: "",
        add: async (item) => {
          if (get().owner)
            return remote((u) => services.cart.add(u, toLine(item)));
          set((s) => ({ items: merge(s.items, item) }));
          return true;
        },
        setQuantity: async (key, quantity) => {
          if (get().owner)
            return remote((u) =>
              services.cart.update(u, key, { quantity: clampQuantity(quantity) }),
            );
          set((s) => ({
            items: s.items.map((i) =>
              i.key === key ? { ...i, quantity: clampQuantity(quantity) } : i,
            ),
          }));
          return true;
        },
        // Đổi size: server tự tính giá; khách vãng lai tính khóa mới và gộp nếu trùng.
        changeSize: async (key, size, unitPrice) => {
          if (get().owner)
            return remote((u) => services.cart.update(u, key, { size }));
          set((s) => {
            const current = s.items.find((i) => i.key === key);
            if (!current || current.size === size) return s;
            const next: CartItem = {
              ...current,
              size,
              unitPrice,
              key: itemKey(
                current.productId,
                size,
                current.toppingIds,
                current.ice,
                current.sugar,
                current.note,
              ),
            };
            const index = s.items.indexOf(current),
              rest = s.items.filter((i) => i.key !== key);
            if (rest.some((i) => i.key === next.key))
              return { items: merge(rest, next) };
            rest.splice(index, 0, next);
            return { items: rest };
          });
          return true;
        },
        remove: async (key) => {
          if (get().owner) return remote((u) => services.cart.remove(u, key));
          set((s) => ({ items: s.items.filter((i) => i.key !== key) }));
          return true;
        },
        clear: async () => {
          set({ promoCode: "" });
          if (get().owner) return remote((u) => services.cart.clear(u));
          set({ items: [] });
          return true;
        },
        setPromoCode: (promoCode) => set({ promoCode }),
        attach: async (userId) => {
          const { owner, items } = get();
          if (owner === userId) return remote((u) => services.cart.get(u));
          // Giỏ khách (owner null) được gộp lên; bản sao của tài khoản khác thì bỏ.
          const guest = owner ? [] : items;
          set({ owner: userId, items: owner ? [] : items });
          if (!guest.length) return remote((u) => services.cart.get(u));
          return remote(async (u) => {
            const view = await services.cart.merge(u, guest.map(toLine));
            if (view.skipped.length)
              set({
                error: `Một số món không thể chuyển vào giỏ tài khoản: ${view.skipped
                  .map((s) => s.reason)
                  .join("; ")}`,
              });
            return view;
          });
        },
        detach: () => set({ items: [], owner: null, promoCode: "", error: "" }),
        dismissError: () => set({ error: "" }),
      };
    },
    {
      name: "brewlite-cart-v1",
      partialize: (s) => ({ items: s.items, promoCode: s.promoCode, owner: s.owner }),
    },
  ),
);
````

````typescript
export type Role = "CUSTOMER" | "BARISTA";
export type User = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: Role;
  loyaltyPoints: number;
};
export type ProductSize = {
  code: "S" | "M" | "L";
  name: string;
  extraPrice: number;
  available: boolean;
  isDefault?: boolean;
};
export type Topping = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  extraPrice: number;
  available: boolean;
};
export type Product = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: number;
  imageUrl: string;
  stock: number;
  category: string;
  sizes: ProductSize[];
  toppings: Topping[];
};
export type CartItem = {
  key: string;
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  size: ProductSize["code"];
  toppingIds: string[];
  toppingNames: string[];
  unitPrice: number;
  quantity: number;
  ice: string;
  sugar: string;
  note?: string;
  /** Các size của món, để đổi size ngay trong giỏ. */
  sizeOptions?: ProductSize[];
  /** Server báo dòng này không còn hợp lệ (hết hàng, size/topping tạm hết). */
  issue?: string;
};
/** Giỏ hàng lưu theo tài khoản; giá do server tính lại. */
export type CartView = {
  items: CartItem[];
  totalQuantity: number;
  subtotal: number;
  valid: boolean;
};
export type CartLineInput = Pick<
  CartItem,
  "productId" | "size" | "toppingIds" | "quantity" | "ice" | "sugar" | "note"
>;
export type OrderStatus =
  | "PENDING"
  | "PAID"
  | "PAYMENT_FAILED"
  | "PREPARING"
  | "READY"
  | "COMPLETED"
  | "CANCELLED";
export type PaymentMethod = "WALLET" | "CARD";
export type OrderItem = CartItem;
export type Order = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  items: OrderItem[];
  subtotal: number;
  discount: number;
  total: number;
  promotionCode?: string;
  status: OrderStatus;
  paymentMethod?: PaymentMethod;
  createdAt: string;
  completedAt?: string;
  error?: string;
  customerName?: string;
  cancelReason?: string;
};
export type Payment = {
  id: string;
  orderId: string;
  method: PaymentMethod;
  status: "PAID" | "PAYMENT_FAILED" | "UNKNOWN";
  idempotencyKey: string;
};
export type Promotion = { code: string; discount: number };
export type LoyaltyPoints = { points: number };
export const money = (n: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN").format(n) + " ₫";
export const lineTotal = (item: CartItem) => item.unitPrice * item.quantity;
export const cartTotal = (items: CartItem[]) =>
  items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + lineTotal(item), 0);
export const itemKey = (
  id: string,
  size: string,
  toppings: string[],
  ice: string,
  sugar: string,
  note = "",
) =>
  [id, size, [...toppings].sort().join(","), ice, sugar, note.trim()].join("|");
````

````typescript
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
test.skip(!process.env.BREWLITE_RUN_API_E2E, 'Chạy riêng khi frontend ở NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_MODE=api');
test('API mode menu and customization consume PostgreSQL Products API', async ({page,request}) => {
  await page.goto('/');
  await expect(page.getByText('Chế độ demo:')).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(page.locator('.product-card')).toHaveCount(10);
  const first = page.locator('.product-card').first();
  const href = await first.getByRole('link',{name:/Tùy chỉnh/}).getAttribute('href');
  const name = await first.locator('h3').textContent();
  expect(href).toBeTruthy();
  const response = await request.get('http://localhost:3001/api'+href);
  expect(response.ok()).toBeTruthy();
  const product = await response.json() as {price:number;sizes:{code:string;extraPrice:number}[];toppings:{id:string;name:string;extraPrice:number;available:boolean}[]};
  await first.getByRole('link',{name:/Tùy chỉnh/}).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:name||''})).toBeVisible();
  for (const code of ['S','M','L']) await expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:new RegExp(`Size ${code}`)})).toBeVisible();
  for (const code of ['S','L','M']) {
    await page.getByRole('button',{name:new RegExp(`Size ${code}`)}).click();
    const sizePrice=product.price+(product.sizes.find(s=>s.code===code)?.extraPrice||0);
    await expect(page.getByText(new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(sizePrice)+' ₫').last()).toBeVisible();
  }
  const topping=product.toppings.find(t=>t.available);
  if(topping) await page.getByRole('checkbox',{name:new RegExp(topping.name)}).check();
  const expected=product.price+(product.sizes.find(s=>s.code==='M')?.extraPrice||0)+(topping?.extraPrice||0);
  await expect(page.getByText(new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(expected)+' ₫').last()).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Thêm vào giỏ hàng'}).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/cart$/);
  await expect(page.getByText(name||'',{exact:true})).toBeVisible();
});
test('API mode menu handles loading, empty, error and retry', async ({page}) => {
  let state:'empty'|'error'|'real'='empty';
  await page.route('**/api/products',async route=>{
    if(state==='real') return route.continue();
    await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,500));
    await route.fulfill({status:state==='empty'?200:500,contentType:'application/json',headers:{'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'http://localhost:3000','Access-Control-Allow-Credentials':'true'},body:state==='empty'?'[]':'{"message":"API demo error"}'});
  });
  await page.goto('/');
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Không tìm thấy thức uống phù hợp.')).toBeVisible();
  state='error';
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.locator('.panel[role="alert"]')).toContainText('API demo error');
  state='real';
  await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Thử lại'}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.product-card')).toHaveCount(10);
});
````

````typescript
    const item = {key:'qa-line',productId:'ca-phe-sua',name:'Cà phê sữa đá',imageUrl:'',size:'M',toppingIds:[],toppingNames:[],unitPrice:45000,quantity:1,ice:'70% đá',sugar:'50% ít ngọt',note:'Ít đường'};
    const base = {userId:'qa-customer',items:[item],subtotal:45000,discount:0,total:45000,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};
    localStorage.setItem('brewlite-demo-orders-v1',JSON.stringify([{...base,id:orderId,status:'PAID'},{...base,id:'BL-UNPAID',status:'PENDING'}]));
  }, id);
  const staff = staffCredentials();
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByLabel('Email').fill(staff.email);
  await page.getByLabel('Mật khẩu').fill(staff.password);
  await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Đăng nhập',exact:true}).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/barista\/dashboard$/);
  await expect(page.locator('.barista-ticket').filter({hasText:id})).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('.barista-ticket').filter({hasText:'BL-UNPAID'})).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.locator('.barista-ticket').filter({hasText:id}).getByRole('button',{name:'Báo sự cố'}).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog',{name:'Xác nhận cập nhật đơn'});
  await expect(dialog.getByRole('button',{name:'Xác nhận'})).toBeDisabled();
  await dialog.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Lý do hủy đơn'}).fill('Hết nguyên liệu');
  await dialog.getByRole('button',{name:'Xác nhận'}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.barista-ticket').filter({hasText:id})).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole('link',{name:/Lịch sử xử lý/}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.barista-ticket').filter({hasText:id})).toContainText('Hết nguyên liệu');
});
test('mobile search and unknown payment remains pending', async ({page}) => {
  test.slow();
  await page.setViewportSize({width:375,height:812});
  await page.goto('/');
  await expect(page.getByText('Tạm hết',{exact:true})).toBeVisible();
````
