import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { PrismaClient } from '../../backend/node_modules/@prisma/client';

const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const api = (process.env.BREWLITE_E2E_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001/api').replace(/\/$/, '');
test.skip(!process.env.BREWLITE_RUN_ORDERS_E2E || !databaseUrl,
  'Opt in with API-mode frontend, real backend and a migrated dedicated ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL');

// Only fixtures owned by this run are removed. Auth, Cart, Products and Orders all use real APIs/DB.
const db = new PrismaClient({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl } } });
let productId: string;
let toppingId: string;
let customerId: string | undefined;

test.beforeAll(async () => { await db.$connect(); });
test.beforeEach(async () => {
  productId = randomUUID(); toppingId = randomUUID(); customerId = undefined;
  await db.topping.create({ data: { id: toppingId, name: 'Task06 topping' } });
  await db.product.create({ data: {
    id: productId, name: 'Task06 Coffee', description: 'PostgreSQL checkout fixture',
    imageUrl: '/images/products/sample-milk-coffee.svg', price: 30000, stock: 8,
    sizes: { create: [
      { code: 'S', name: 'Nhỏ (S)', extraPrice: 0 },
      { code: 'M', name: 'Vừa (M)', extraPrice: 4000, isDefault: true },
      { code: 'L', name: 'Lớn (L)', extraPrice: 9000 },
    ] },
    toppings: { create: { toppingId, extraPrice: 6000 } },
  } });
});
test.afterEach(async () => {
  await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { items: { some: { productId } } } });
  if (customerId) await db.cart.deleteMany({ where: { userId: customerId } });
  await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: productId } });
  await db.topping.deleteMany({ where: { id: toppingId } });
  if (customerId) await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: customerId } });
});
test.afterAll(async () => { await db.$disconnect(); });

async function checkout(page: import('@playwright/test').Page) {
  // Task 06 ends at PENDING. Abort the later Task 08 request, without supplying a fake payment result.
  await page.route('**/api/payments', route => route.abort('blockedbyclient'));
  await page.goto(`/products/${productId}`);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Task06 Coffee', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Size L/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /Task06 topping/ }).check();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Tăng số lượng' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Thêm vào giỏ hàng', exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/cart$/);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Tiến hành đặt hàng/ }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login\?next=/);
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Đăng ký ngay' }).click();
  const email = `task06-${randomUUID()}@example.test`;
  const password = `Task06-${randomUUID()}`;
  await page.getByLabel('Họ tên').fill('Khách Task06');
  await page.getByLabel('Email').fill(email);
  await page.getByLabel('Mật khẩu', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByLabel('Xác nhận mật khẩu').fill(password);
  const registered = page.waitForResponse(r => r.url() === `${api}/auth/register` && r.request().method() === 'POST');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Đăng ký', exact: true }).click();
  const registration = await registered;
  expect(registration.status()).toBe(201);
  customerId = (await registration.json()).user.id;
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/checkout$/);
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Kết quả thanh toán demo')).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect.poll(async () => db.cartItem.count({ where: { cart: { userId: customerId }, productId } })).toBe(1);
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Xác nhận thanh toán 90.000 ₫' })).toBeEnabled();
}

for (const width of [1440, 768, 390]) {
  test(`Task 06 API checkout persists a PENDING order at ${width}px`, async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 1000 });
    await checkout(page);
    await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath(`checkout-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
    const created = page.waitForResponse(r => r.url() === `${api}/orders` && r.request().method() === 'POST');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Xác nhận thanh toán 90.000 ₫' }).click();
    const response = await created;
    expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
    const body = await response.json();
    expect(body).toMatchObject({ userId: customerId, status: 'PENDING', subtotal: 90000, discount: 0, total: 90000 });
    const sent = response.request().postDataJSON();
    expect(sent).not.toHaveProperty('userId');
    expect(sent).not.toHaveProperty('total');
    expect(sent.items[0]).not.toHaveProperty('unitPrice');
    const stored = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: body.id }, include: { items: true, statusHistory: true } });
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({ status: 'PENDING', userId: customerId, total: 90000, inventoryHeld: true });
    expect(stored.items[0]).toMatchObject({ productId, size: 'L', qty: 2, unitPrice: 45000, lineTotal: 90000 });
    expect(stored.statusHistory).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).toMatchObject({ stock: 6, version: 2 });
    expect(await db.cartItem.count({ where: { cart: { userId: customerId }, productId } })).toBe(1);
    expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId: body.id } })).toBe(0);
    await page.goto(`/orders/${body.id}`);
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: `Mã đơn #${body.id}` })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('.status.PENDING')).toBeVisible();
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.locator('.status.PENDING')).toBeVisible();
    expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId: customerId } })).toBe(1);
    await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath(`pending-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
  });
}

test('Task 06 API stock conflict keeps checkout/cart and creates no order', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 1000 });
  await checkout(page);
  await db.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { stock: 0, version: { increment: 1 } } });
  const created = page.waitForResponse(r => r.url() === `${api}/orders` && r.request().method() === 'POST');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Xác nhận thanh toán 90.000 ₫' }).click();
  expect((await created).status()).toBe(409);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/checkout$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('alert').filter({ hasText: 'không đủ tồn kho' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Giỏ hàng 2 món')).toBeVisible();
  expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId: customerId } })).toBe(0);
  expect(await db.cartItem.count({ where: { cart: { userId: customerId }, productId } })).toBe(1);
});

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a refined digital flagship for artisanal Vietnamese coffee culture. Drawing from modern editorial minimalism intertwined with tactile, warm hospitality, the interface marries the timeless ritual of phin brewing with friction-free modern digital commerce.

### Brand Personality & Core Tenets
- **Artisanal & Sophisticated:** Evoking the aroma of slow-dripped Robusta, dark roast blends, and warm condensed milk without clutter or cliché. High-contrast typography paired with measured negative space conveys curation and culinary precision.
- **Warm & Welcoming:** Grounded in Vietnamese cafe culture (*cà phê la cà*), the emotional tone is hospitable, sensory, and approachable rather than cold or aloof.
- **Convenient & Trustworthy:** Streamlined ordering, transparent order progress, and seamless cashless checkouts evoke certainty and speed during peak morning and midday rush hours.

### Visual Style Movement
The design blends **Warm Editorial Minimalism** with soft **Tactile Depth**. It uses crisp, high-contrast serif headers paired with clear, humanist body copy, placed atop creamy, textured backgrounds. Surfaces rely on warm neutral borders, subtle elevation steps, and carefully balanced inner margins to evoke tactile menus, packaging labels, and contemporary boutique cafe interiors.

## Colors

The palette draws directly from the roasting spectrum, slow phin extractions, and natural cream pairings. The default display mode is light, capturing an open, sunlit cafe ambience.

### Palette Roles & Application

- **Primary (`#4B2E2B` - Deep Espresso):** The core anchor. Used for primary call-to-actions, prominent headers, navigation accents, active states, and dominant visual weights.
- **Secondary (`#6F4E37` - Roast Brown):** Supporting structural color. Applied to category headers, sub-navigation tabs, step indicators, and interactive borders.
- **Tertiary (`#C58B55` - Warm Caramel):** Used selectively for highlights, promotion badges, loyalty point rewards, order confirmation cues, and key conversion accents.
- **Canvas & Surfaces:**
  - Base Background: `#FAF7F2` (Pure Warm Cream) creates an organic canvas softer than harsh sterile white.
  - Card & Container Fill: `#FFFFFF` (Surface White) provides pristine contrast for drink imagery and product modifiers.
  - Muted Inset / Subtle Fill: `#EFE6DA` (Soft Beige) provides structure for disabled fields, nested card groupings, and item counter controls.
- **Typographic Contrast:**
  - Primary Text: `#27211E` (Dark Roast Charcoal) ensures WCAG AAA accessibility across light surfaces.
  - Secondary Text: `#786F69` (Subtle Earth) reserved for metadata, descriptions, pricing comparisons, and phin brew origin tags.
  - Border & Dividers: `#E8DFD5` creates clean structural separation without high-contrast visual noise.
- **Feedback & Semantics:**
  - Success: `#2E7D5B` (Botanical Green) for payment complete, loyalty verified, and customized additions.
  - Warning: `#D99836` (Golden Toast) for low stock, peak queue wait-times, and table transfer alerts.
  - Error: `#C84C4C` (Red Ochre) for payment failures, validation errors, and item stock-outs.

## Typography

Typography balances heritage and practical mobile clarity. All diacritics and complex tone marks inherent to Vietnamese receive ample vertical clearance via relaxed line heights.

### Editorial Headings (`Noto Serif`)
- Reserved for page titles, category headers (e.g., *Cà Phê Phin Truyền Thống*, *Trà & Tráng Miệng*), promotional banners, and receipt headlines.
- Adds an editorial, curated aura reminiscent of high-end culinary publications and historical Vietnamese coffee salons.

### Functional Body & Labels (`Be Vietnam Pro`)
- Designed natively for the Vietnamese writing system, preventing tone clip issues and uneven vowel rendering.
- Applied across all interactive elements, customization controls (ice levels, sweetness options, milk choices), cart tallies, and transactional checkout flows.
- Maintains strict legibility at dense mobile viewports with weights spanning Regular (400) for descriptions, Medium (500) for chips and buttons, and Semi-Bold (600) for item titles and pricing.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an 8pt baseline rhythm with responsive adaptation targeted at mobile-first in-store table QR scanning, as well as desktop pre-ordering.

### Grid & Viewport Adaptation
- **Mobile (< 768px):** Single-column fluid feed with a fixed sticky bottom cart/action drawer. Canvas padding uses `margin-mobile` (16px), with `gutter-mobile` (12px) separating menu item cards in two-column grid sections.
- **Tablet (768px - 1024px):** 8-column layout. Split layout displays categorized menus on the left 5 columns, with persistent checkout orders on the right 3 columns.
- **Desktop (> 1024px):** Max container width bounded at 1200px centered. 12-column layout with 24px gutters and 32px canvas margins. Category anchor navigation fixes to the left side, menu grids occupy the central region, and active cart/receipt summaries dock to the right.

### Vertical Rhythm
Section transitions use `space-xl` (40px) to give menu categories breathing room. Card internals preserve a minimum of `space-md` (16px) padding to prevent tap target crowding around quantity adjusters and customization pills.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth is conveyed through delicate, warm-tinted ambient shadows and structured surface borders rather than abrupt heavy drops. Shadows are tinted with `#4B2E2B` at low opacities to echo warm ambient cafe lighting.

### Elevation Hierarchy
- **Level 0 (Flat / Canvas):** Applied to the base canvas (`#FAF7F2`) and inactive option containers. Completely flat, bounded by a 1px solid `#E8DFD5` border.
- **Level 1 (Resting Cards):** Applied to product cards, drink item listings, and modifier groups. Features a white background with a subtle ambient tint: `box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.05), 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.03)` with a 1px border in `#E8DFD5`.
- **Level 2 (Hover & Active Surfaces):** Used when hovering cards or tapping selectable add-on options. Shadow deepens: `box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.08), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.04)`. The border shifts to `#C58B55` or `#4B2E2B`.
- **Level 3 (Floating Bars & Bottom Drawers):** Reserved for sticky mobile checkout trays, floating order progress pill badges, and option customization sheets: `box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -6px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.12), 0 4px 12px 0 rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.06)`.
- **Level 4 (Modal Dialogs & Payment Confirmations):** Overlays with high visual focus, centered over a 40% opacity espresso-toned backdrop blur: `box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(39, 33, 30, 0.25)`.

## Shapes

The shape vocabulary uses gentle, organic geometry (level 2 roundedness), mirroring the smoothed rim of ceramic phin cups and custom cafe glassware.

### Curvature Scale
- **Base Components (`rounded`, 8px / 0.5rem):** Form inputs, modifier choice tiles, counter increment buttons, and table QR code cards.
- **Mid-Tier Elements (`rounded-lg`, 16px / 1rem):** Coffee card containers, loyalty stamp cards, modal confirmation boxes, and banner displays.
- **Containers & Drawers (`rounded-xl`, 24px / 1.5rem):** Floating bottom checkout bars, sliding product modifier sheets, and hero promotional showcases.
- **Pills (`rounded-full`):** Filter tags, sugar/ice selection chips, status badges (e.g., *Đang pha chế*, *Đã thanh toán*), and floating action triggers.

## Components

All components are tailored for Vietnamese language strings, ensuring sufficient horizontal padding for compound words (e.g., *Thanh toán ngay*, *Tùy chỉnh món*).

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Thanh toán / Thêm vào giỏ):** Background `#4B2E2B`, text `#FFFFFF`, rounded 8px (`rounded`), font weight Semi-Bold (600). Hover shifts background to `#6F4E37`. Minimum height 48px for effortless thumb tap targets.
- **Secondary Action (Xem lại đơn / Chọn lại):** Background `#EFE6DA`, text `#4B2E2B`, border 1px solid `#E8DFD5`. Hover transitions background to `#E8DFD5`.
- **Accent Action (Áp dụng ưu đãi / Tích điểm):** Background `#C58B55`, text `#FFFFFF`. Used for high-value transactional perks.

### Chips & Attribute Selectors (Mức đường, Mức đá, Loại sữa)
- **Unselected:** Border 1px solid `#E8DFD5`, background `#FFFFFF`, text `#786F69`. Shape is pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or soft rectangle (`rounded`).
- **Selected:** Border 1.5px solid `#4B2E2B`, background `#FAF7F2`, text `#4B2E2B`, font weight 600. Accompanied by a subtle caramel checkmark indicator or bold ring highlight.

### Coffee Menu Cards
- Elevated at Level 1, framed by a 1px `#E8DFD5` border, rounded 16px (`rounded-lg`).
- High-contrast layout: Crisp square or 4:3 product photography on top or left, followed by the item title in `title-md` (`Be Vietnam Pro`), origin/blend note in `body-sm` (`#786F69`), and currency-formatted price (e.g., `45.000 ₫`) anchored in `title-md` `#4B2E2B`.
- Integrated quick-add button (`+`) positioned at the bottom right corner in `#4B2E2B` with inverse white icon.

### Form Inputs & Voucher Fields
- Background `#FFFFFF`, border 1.5px solid `#E8DFD5`, border-radius 8px (`rounded`), text `#27211E`.
- Focus state: Border transitions to `#4B2E2B` with a 2px outer aura ring in `rgba(197, 139, 85, 0.25)`. Error state uses `#C84C4C` border and helper text.
- Text placeholders rendered in `#786F69` (e.g., *Nhập mã giảm giá...*, *Ghi chú cho quán...*).

### Checkboxes & Radio Controls (Topping & Milk Add-ons)
- 20px x 20px control footprint with 8px clearance.
- Checked state fills with `#4B2E2B` carrying a pure white icon mark.
- Unchecked state features an inset white background with 1.5px `#E8DFD5` outline.

### Quantity Stepper Controls
- Encased pill or compact box in `#EFE6DA`.
- Plus/minus buttons in `#4B2E2B` (hovering to `#6F4E37`), sandwiching a center numerical count in `title-sm` `#27211E`.

### Order Status & Payment Badge (Trạng thái đơn hàng)
- Compact pill element (`rounded-full`) with an 8px colored dot and `label-sm` copy.
- Unpaid/Pending: `#FAF7F2` background, `#D99836` border and text (*Chờ thanh toán*).
- Processing/Brewing: `#FAF7F2` background, `#C58B55` border and text (*Đang pha chế*).
- Ready/Delivered: `#FAF7F2` background, `#2E7D5B` border and text (*Mời nhận món*).
````

    function openCancellationModal(orderId) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('cancellation-modal');
      const orderSpan = document.getElementById('modal-order-id');
      if (orderSpan) {
        orderSpan.textContent = '#' + (orderId || 'BL-1042');
      }
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    }

    function closeCancellationModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('cancellation-modal');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('open-emergency-btn')?.addEventListener('click', function() {
      openCancellationModal('BL-1042');
    });

    function handleCancelSubmit(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      alert('Đã gửi yêu cầu hủy đơn thành công. Hệ thống tự động cập nhật log kiểm toán cho Barista BAR-08.');
      closeCancellationModal();
    }
  </script>

<div class="flex flex-col gap-space-sm pt-space-xs">
<div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch gap-space-sm">
<button class="flex-1 min-h-[52px] px-space-lg py-space-sm rounded-lg bg-primary hover:bg-primary-container text-on-primary font-title-sm text-title-sm font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-space-sm shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.99]" onclick="handleAddToCart()" type="button">

</button>

</div>

<!-- Inline Logic for Dynamic Calculation and Micro-interactions -->
<script>
    let quantity = 2;
    const basePrice = 35000;

    function formatVND(amount) {
      return amount.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫';
    }

    function adjustQuantity(delta) {
      quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, quantity + delta));
      updateCalculations();
    }

    function selectThumbnail(index, element) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.thumbnail-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('outline', 'outline-2', 'outline-primary');
      });
      element.classList.add('outline', 'outline-2', 'outline-primary');
      
      const newSrc = element.querySelector('img').getAttribute('src');
      const newAlt = element.querySelector('img').getAttribute('data-alt');
      const mainImg = document.getElementById('main-product-image');
      
      mainImg.style.opacity = '0.5';
      setTimeout(() => {
        mainImg.setAttribute('src', newSrc);
        mainImg.setAttribute('data-alt', newAlt);
        mainImg.style.opacity = '1';
      }, 150);
    }

    function selectPill(button, group, labelText) {
      const parent = button.parentElement;
      parent.querySelectorAll('.pill-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active', 'bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'shadow-sm', 'font-semibold');
        b.classList.add('bg-surface-container', 'text-on-surface-variant', 'font-medium');
      });
      
      button.classList.add('active', 'bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'shadow-sm', 'font-semibold');
      button.classList.remove('bg-surface-container', 'text-on-surface-variant', 'font-medium');

      if (group === 'ice') {
        document.getElementById('selected-ice-label').innerText = labelText;
      } else if (group === 'sweetness') {
        document.getElementById('selected-sweetness-label').innerText = labelText;
      }
    }

    function updateCalculations() {
      // 1. Quantity Display
      document.getElementById('quantity-display').innerText = quantity;
      document.querySelectorAll('.qty-mirror').forEach(el => el.innerText = quantity);

      // 2. Size calculations
      const sizeInputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="size_option"]');
      let sizeExtra = 0;
      let sizeName = "Size S";
      sizeInputs.forEach(input => {
        const card = input.closest('.size-card');
        const indicator = card.querySelector('.radio-indicator');
        if (input.checked) {
          sizeExtra = parseInt(input.dataset.extra || 0);
          sizeName = "Size " + input.value;
          card.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary', 'bg-surface-container');
          card.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low');
          indicator.className = 'radio-indicator w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-on-primary';
          indicator.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">check</span>';
        } else {
          card.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary', 'bg-surface-container');
          card.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low');
          indicator.className = 'radio-indicator w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-lowest flex items-center justify-center';
          indicator.innerHTML = '<div class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-transparent"></div>';
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('size-name-summary').innerText = sizeName;

      // 3. Topping calculations
      const toppingCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="toppings"]:checked');
      let toppingsExtraPerUnit = 0;
      toppingCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
        toppingsExtraPerUnit += parseInt(cb.dataset.price || 0);
      });
      document.getElementById('topping-count-summary').innerText = toppingCheckboxes.length + ' loại';

      // 4. Subtotals and Grand Total
      const totalBase = basePrice * quantity;
      const totalSizeExtra = sizeExtra * quantity;
      const totalToppingsExtra = toppingsExtraPerUnit * quantity;
      const grandTotal = totalBase + totalSizeExtra + totalToppingsExtra;

      document.getElementById('base-subtotal').innerText = formatVND(totalBase);
      document.getElementById('size-subtotal').innerText = '+' + formatVND(totalSizeExtra);
      document.getElementById('topping-subtotal').innerText = '+' + formatVND(totalToppingsExtra);
      document.getElementById('grand-total-display').innerText = formatVND(grandTotal);
      document.getElementById('cta-button-text').innerText = 'Thêm vào giỏ hàng • ' + formatVND(grandTotal);
    }

    function handleAddToCart() {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast-notification');
      toast.classList.remove('hidden');
      toast.classList.remove('translate-y-4', 'opacity-0');
      toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');

      // Auto hide after 4 seconds
      clearTimeout(window._toastTimeout);
      window._toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
        setTimeout(() => toast.classList.add('hidden'), 300);
      }, 4000);
    }

    // Initialize display on load
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      updateCalculations();
    });
  </script>

<script>
    const itemPrices = {
      'item-1': 55000,
      'item-2': 59000
    };

    let cartQuantities = {
      'item-1': 2,
      'item-2': 1
    };

    function recalculateTotal() {
      const subtotal = (cartQuantities['item-1'] * itemPrices['item-1']) + (cartQuantities['item-2'] * itemPrices['item-2']);
      const totalQty = cartQuantities['item-1'] + cartQuantities['item-2'];
      
      const discount = subtotal > 0 ? Math.round(subtotal * 0.2) : 0;
      const finalTotal = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount);
      const points = Math.floor(finalTotal / 10000);

      const subtotalEl = document.getElementById('summary-subtotal');
      const discountEl = document.getElementById('summary-discount');
      const finalTotalEl = document.getElementById('summary-final-total');
      const ctaBtnText = document.getElementById('cta-button-text');
      const badgeCountEl = document.getElementById('cart-total-badge');
      const summaryTotalQtyEl = document.getElementById('summary-total-qty');

      if (subtotalEl) subtotalEl.textContent = subtotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
      if (discountEl) discountEl.textContent = '-' + discount.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
      if (finalTotalEl) finalTotalEl.textContent = finalTotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
      if (ctaBtnText) ctaBtnText.textContent = 'Tiến hành thanh toán (' + finalTotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫)';
      if (badgeCountEl) badgeCountEl.textContent = totalQty + ' món';
      if (summaryTotalQtyEl) summaryTotalQtyEl.textContent = totalQty + ' sản phẩm';
    }

    function updateQty(itemId, delta) {
      if (!cartQuantities[itemId]) return;
      const newQty = cartQuantities[itemId] + delta;
      if (newQty < 1) return;

      cartQuantities[itemId] = newQty;
      const qtyEl = document.getElementById('qty-' + itemId);
      const subtotalEl = document.getElementById('subtotal-' + itemId);

      if (qtyEl) qtyEl.textContent = newQty;
      if (subtotalEl) subtotalEl.textContent = (newQty * itemPrices[itemId]).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';

      recalculateTotal();
    }

    function removeItem(cardId, price, count) {
      const card = document.getElementById(cardId);
      if (card) {
        card.style.opacity = '0';
        card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          card.remove();
          if (cardId === 'cart-item-1') cartQuantities['item-1'] = 0;
          if (cardId === 'cart-item-2') cartQuantities['item-2'] = 0;
          recalculateTotal();
        }, 250);
      }
    }

    function clearCartSim() {
      const list = document.getElementById('cart-item-list');
      if (list) {
        list.innerHTML = `
          <div class="p-space-lg bg-surface-container-low rounded-xl text-center text-on-surface-variant font-body-md">
            Bạn vừa dọn sạch giỏ hàng. <a href="#" data-path="thuc-don" class="text-primary font-semibold underline ml-1">Chọn món mới</a>
          </div>
        `;
        cartQuantities['item-1'] = 0;
        cartQuantities['item-2'] = 0;
        recalculateTotal();
      }
    }

    function applyPromoCode() {
      const input = document.getElementById('promo-input');
      const badge = document.getElementById('voucher-success-badge');
      if (input && badge) {
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
        badge.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    }

    function checkoutProcess() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('cta-button-text');
      if (btn) {
        btn.textContent = 'Đang khởi tạo đơn hàng PENDING...';
        setTimeout(() => {
          alert('Đơn hàng đã được khởi tạo thành công! Chuyển hướng tới cổng thanh toán an toàn...');
          btn.textContent = 'Tiến hành thanh toán (135.200₫)';
        }, 800);
      }
    }
  </script>

<script>
  function copyVoucher(code, btnElement) {
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
        const originalContent = btnElement.innerHTML;
        btnElement.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">check</span><span>Đã chép!</span>';
        btnElement.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-high', 'bg-primary');
        btnElement.classList.add('bg-[#2e7d5b]', 'text-white');
        setTimeout(() => {
          btnElement.innerHTML = originalContent;
          btnElement.classList.remove('bg-[#2e7d5b]', 'text-white');
          btnElement.classList.add('bg-surface-container-high');
        }, 2000);
      });
    }
  }

  function handleLogout() {
    if (confirm('Bạn có chắc chắn muốn đăng xuất khỏi tài khoản BrewLite?')) {
      alert('Đã đăng xuất thành công. Hẹn gặp lại quý khách!');
    }
  }
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface py-space-xl"><div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl pb-space-xl"><div class="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-space-md"><div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm"><img alt="BrewLite Logo" class="h-7 w-auto object-contain" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDQQPSEeE0NKrtWlD36-6QGwv6hEZPy48XA96VPbaxMinQV8jWZBuC1LAROusExxXDS1G9N2mKgudlz7JwsSs3PecCz-63FvVMTFaDw8dqoQ50KkIqeiqZbVZg6vFE-D9GHUdlmOlo8O5cLdcz_2VEXPILux8BcbV1U0poKYzTcB6VnWaEPVOpsg39Ct1hCvgH_WsLFj_Cfh3PehWwwnV7h5NNZMaaAmmU0J8gXWRuPlsyYtUrXFAITFw"/><span class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">BrewLite</span></div><p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant max-w-sm leading-relaxed">Trải nghiệm cà phê thủ công tinh túy Việt Nam, đặt món nhanh chóng và thanh toán không tiền mặt an toàn.</p></div><div class="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Khám phá</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="ve-brewlite" href="#">Về BrewLite</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="thuc-don" href="#">Thực đơn</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="khuyen-mai" href="#">Khuyến mãi</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="huong-dan-dat-hang" href="#">Hướng dẫn đặt hàng</a></li></ul></div><div class="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Liên hệ &amp; <script>
  function switchState(targetState) {
    // Hide all views
    document.querySelectorAll('.state-view').forEach(function(view) {
      view.classList.add('hidden');
      view.classList.remove('flex');
    });

    // Reset button styles
    const buttons = ['success', 'failed', 'verifying'];
    buttons.forEach(function(s) {
      const btn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + s);
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');
        btn.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
      }
    });

    // Show target view
    const activeView = document.getElementById('view-' + targetState);
    if (activeView) {
      activeView.classList.remove('hidden');
      activeView.classList.add('flex');
    }

    // Highlight target button
    const activeBtn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + targetState);
    if (activeBtn) {
      activeBtn.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');
      activeBtn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
    }
  }

  function triggerVerificationCheck() {
    const timerElem = document.getElementById('countdown-timer');
    if (timerElem) {
      timerElem.innerText = 'Đang kiểm tra kết nối cổng...';
      setTimeout(function() {
        switchState('success');
      }, 1200);
    }
  }

<script>
  // Tab Filtering Logic
  function switchTab(btn, status) {
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
    tabs.forEach(t => {
      t.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');
      t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-primary', 'hover:bg-surface-container-low');
    });

    btn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-primary', 'hover:bg-surface-container-low');
    btn.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');

    const trackingSection = document.getElementById('active-order-tracking-section');
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.order-card');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('orders-empty-state');
    let visibleCount = 0;

    if (status === 'all') {
      if (trackingSection) trackingSection.style.display = 'block';
      cards.forEach(c => {
        c.style.display = 'flex';
        visibleCount++;
      });
    } else if (status === 'active') {
      if (trackingSection) trackingSection.style.display = 'block';
      cards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'none');
      visibleCount = 1;
    } else {
      if (trackingSection) trackingSection.style.display = 'none';
      cards.forEach(c => {
        if (c.getAttribute('data-status') === status) {
          c.style.display = 'flex';
          visibleCount++;
        } else {
          c.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    if (visibleCount === 0) {
      emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.add('flex');
    } else {
      emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.remove('flex');
    }
  }

  // Real-time Search Handler
  function handleSearch(query) {
    const term = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.order-card');
    const trackingSection = document.getElementById('active-order-tracking-section');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('orders-empty-state');
    let matchCount = 0;

    const matchesTracking = 'bl-1042 ca phe sua da sai gon tra dao cam sa'.includes(term);
    if (trackingSection) {
      if (term === '' || matchesTracking) {
        trackingSection.style.display = 'block';
        if (matchesTracking && term !== '') matchCount++;
      } else {
        trackingSection.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    cards.forEach(card => {
      const searchData = card.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
      if (term === '' || searchData.includes(term)) {
        card.style.display = 'flex';
        matchCount++;
      } else {
        card.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });

    if (matchCount === 0 && term !== '') {
      emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.add('flex');
    } else {
      emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.remove('flex');
    }
  }

  // Refresh Timeline animation simulator
  function refreshTrackingStatus() {
    const icon = document.getElementById('refresh-icon');
    if (!icon) return;
    icon.classList.add('rotate-180');
    
    showToast('Đang đồng bộ trạng thái đơn hàng thời gian thực...');

    setTimeout(() => {
      icon.classList.remove('rotate-180');
      showToast('Đã làm mới: Barista đang đóng nắp và thêm đá!');
    }, 900);
  }

  // Reorder action
  function reorderItem(orderCode) {
    showToast('Đã thêm các món của đơn #' + orderCode + ' vào giỏ hàng thành công!');
  }

  // Invoice Modal
  function viewInvoiceModal(orderCode, price, itemName) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('invoice-modal');
    const card = document.getElementById('invoice-modal-card');
    
    document.getElementById('modal-order-id').innerText = 'Hóa đơn #' + orderCode;
    document.getElementById('modal-order-price').innerText = price;
    document.getElementById('modal-order-item').innerText = itemName;

    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => {
      modal.classList.remove('opacity-0');
      card.classList.remove('scale-95');
      card.classList.add('scale-100');
    }, 10);
  }

  function closeInvoiceModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('invoice-modal');
    const card = document.getElementById('invoice-modal-card');
    modal.classList.add('opacity-0');
    card.classList.remove('scale-100');
    card.classList.add('scale-95');
    setTimeout(() => {
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }, 250);
  }

  // Global Toast
  function showToast(text) {
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast-notify');
    const msg = document.getElementById('toast-message');
    if (!toast || !msg) return;
    msg.innerText = text;
    toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
    toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');

    setTimeout(() => {
      toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
      toast.classList.add('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
    }, 3200);
  }
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface py-space-xl"><div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl pb-space-xl"><div class="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-space-md"><div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm"><img alt="BrewLite Logo" class="h-7 w-auto object-contain" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDQQPSEeE0NKrtWlD36-6QGwv6hEZPy48XA96VPbaxMinQV8jWZBuC1LAROusExxXDS1G9N2mKgudlz7JwsSs3PecCz-63FvVMTFaDw8dqoQ50KkIqeiqZbVZg6vFE-D9GHUdlmOlo8O5cLdcz_2VEXPILux8BcbV1U0poKYzTcB6VnWaEPVOpsg39Ct1hCvgH_WsLFj_Cfh3PehWwwnV7h5NNZMaaAmmU0J8gXWRuPlsyYtUrXFAITFw"/><span class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">BrewLite</span></div><p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant max-w-sm leading-relaxed">Trải nghiệm cà phê thủ công tinh túy Việt Nam, đặt món nhanh chóng và thanh toán không tiền mặt an toàn.</p></div><div class="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Khám phá</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="ve-brewlite" href="#">Về BrewLite</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="thuc-don" href="#">Thực đơn</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="khuyen-mai" href="#">Khuyến mãi</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="huong-dan-dat-hang" href="#">Hướng dẫn đặt hàng</a></li></ul></div><div class="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Liên hệ &amp; <span>Google</span>
</button>
<button class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-3 rounded bg-surface-container-low hover:bg-surface-container text-on-surface font-title-sm text-title-sm transition-colors" onclick="showQuickToast('Đang liên kết tài khoản Apple...')" type="button">
<svg class="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 fill-current" viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18.71 19.5c-.83 1.24-1.71 2.45-3.05 2.47-1.34.03-1.77-.79-3.29-.79-1.53 0-2 .77-3.27.82-1.31.05-2.3-1.32-3.14-2.53C4.25 17 2.94 12.45 4.7 9.39c.87-1.52 2.43-2.48 4.12-2.51 1.28-.02 2.5.87 3.29.87.78 0 2.26-1.07 3.81-.91.65.03 2.47.26 3.64 1.98-.09.06-2.17 1.28-2.15 3.81.03 3.02 2.65 4.03 2.68 4.04-.03.07-.42 1.44-1.38 2.83M15.97 6.84c.66-.8 1.11-1.92.99-3.04-.96.04-2.12.64-2.8 1.44-.6.69-1.12 1.83-.98 2.92 1.07.08 2.14-.52 2.79-1.32z"></path></svg>
<span>Apple ID</span>
</button>

<div class="flex flex-col gap-1">

<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">
            Vui lòng đăng nhập hoặc tạo tài khoản để hoàn tất đặt hàng và tích lũy điểm thưởng. Giỏ hàng của bạn vẫn sẽ được bảo lưu nguyên vẹn.
          </p>
</div>

<!-- Preview tóm tắt giỏ hàng hiện thời -->
<div class="p-space-md rounded bg-surface-container-low flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary text-headline-sm">shopping_bag</span>

<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface">Giỏ hàng của bạn</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">2 thức uống sẵn sàng</span>
</div>

<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-lg">login</span>
<span>Đăng nhập ngay</span>
</button>
<!-- 2. Tạo tài khoản mới (Secondary Button - Light surface with distinct tone) -->

<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-lg">person_add</span>
<span>Tạo tài khoản mới</span>
</button>
<!-- 3. Tiếp tục xem thực đơn (Text Link) -->
<button class="w-full py-2 text-center font-label-lg text-label-lg text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1" onclick="closeAuthModal()" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-sm">arrow_back</span>
<span>Tiếp tục xem thực đơn</span>
</button>
</div>

<!-- TOAST FEEDBACK NOTIFICATION -->
<div class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-space-lg py-3 rounded-full bg-inverse-surface text-inverse-on-surface shadow-xl flex items-center gap-space-sm opacity-0 pointer-events-none transition-all duration-300 max-w-md w-max" id="quick-toast">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary-fixed text-body-lg" id="toast-icon">check_circle</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm" id="toast-text">Thông báo thao tác thành công</span>
</div>
<script>
    function switchAuthTab(tab) {
      const loginBtn = document.getElementById('tab-login-btn');
      const regBtn = document.getElementById('tab-register-btn');
      const formLogin = document.getElementById('form-login');
      const formRegister = document.getElementById('form-register');

      if (tab === 'login') {
        loginBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-primary bg-primary shadow-sm transition-all text-center';
        regBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-all text-center';
        formLogin.classList.remove('hidden');
        formLogin.classList.add('flex');
        formRegister.classList.add('hidden');
        formRegister.classList.remove('flex');
      } else {
        regBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-primary bg-primary shadow-sm transition-all text-center';
        loginBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-all text-center';
        formRegister.classList.remove('hidden');
        formRegister.classList.add('flex');
        formLogin.classList.add('hidden');
        formLogin.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function togglePasswordVisibility(inputId, btn) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      const icon = btn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.textContent = 'visibility';
      }
    }

    function openAuthModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('auth-required-modal');
      const container = document.getElementById('modal-container');
      modal.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
      modal.classList.add('opacity-100', 'pointer-events-auto');
      container.classList.remove('scale-95');
      container.classList.add('scale-100');
    }

    function closeAuthModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('auth-required-modal');
      const container = document.getElementById('modal-container');
      modal.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
      modal.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'pointer-events-auto');
      container.classList.add('scale-95');
      container.classList.remove('scale-100');
    }

    function showQuickToast(msg, icon = 'info') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('quick-toast');
      const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
      const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');
      toastText.textContent = msg;
      toastIcon.textContent = icon;
      toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
      toast.classList.add('opacity-100');

      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        toast.classList.remove('opacity-100');
      }, 3500);
    }

    function simulateLoginSuccess() {
      showQuickToast('Đăng nhập thành công! Đang chuyển hướng về giỏ hàng...', 'check_circle');
    }

    function simulateRegisterSuccess() {
      showQuickToast('Tài khoản Khách hàng đã được tạo! Mời bạn đăng nhập.', 'verified');
      setTimeout(() => {
        switchAuthTab('login');
      }, 1200);
    }
  </script>

<script>
    (function() {
      const payButton = document.getElementById('btn-pay-now');
      const modal = document.getElementById('payment-modal');
      const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('btn-cancel-modal');
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('modal-progress');
      let progressInterval;

      if (payButton && modal) {
        payButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
          modal.classList.remove('hidden');
          let width = 25;
          progressBar.style.width = width + '%';
          
          progressInterval = setInterval(function() {
            if (width < 90) {
              width += 15;
              progressBar.style.width = width + '%';
            }
          }, 600);
        });
      }

      if (cancelBtn && modal) {
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          modal.classList.add('hidden');
          clearInterval(progressInterval);
          progressBar.style.width = '25%';
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>

<script>
  (function initBrewLiteMenu() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('coffee-search');
    const clearBtn = document.getElementById('btn-clear-search');
    const categoryTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.category-pill');
    const productItems = document.querySelectorAll('.product-item');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');
    const productGrid = document.getElementById('product-grid');
    const countDisplay = document.getElementById('visible-count');
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset-filters');

    let currentCategory = 'all';
    let currentSearchTerm = '';

    function filterItems() {
      let visibleCount = 0;
      const term = currentSearchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();

      productItems.forEach(item => {
        const itemCategory = item.getAttribute('data-category');
        const itemName = (item.getAttribute('data-name') || '').toLowerCase();
        
        const matchesCategory = (currentCategory === 'all' || itemCategory === currentCategory);
        const matchesSearch = !term || itemName.includes(term);

        if (matchesCategory && matchesSearch) {
          item.classList.remove('hidden');
          visibleCount++;
        } else {
          item.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });

      countDisplay.textContent = visibleCount;

      if (visibleCount === 0) {
        productGrid.classList.add('hidden');
        emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        productGrid.classList.remove('hidden');
        emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        currentSearchTerm = e.target.value;
        if (currentSearchTerm.length > 0) {
          clearBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          clearBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        filterItems();
      });
    }

    if (clearBtn) {
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        searchInput.value = '';
        currentSearchTerm = '';
        clearBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        searchInput.focus();
        filterItems();
      });
    }

    categoryTabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        categoryTabs.forEach(t => {
          t.classList.remove('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');
          t.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        });

        tab.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        tab.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');

        currentCategory = tab.getAttribute('data-category');
        filterItems();
      });
    });

    if (resetBtn) {
      resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (searchInput) {
          searchInput.value = '';
          currentSearchTerm = '';
          clearBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        currentCategory = 'all';
        categoryTabs.forEach(t => {
          if (t.getAttribute('data-category') === 'all') {
            t.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            t.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');
          } else {
            t.classList.remove('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');
            t.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
          }
        });
        filterItems();
      });
    }
  })();
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface py-space-xl"><div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl pb-space-xl"><div class="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-space-md"><div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm"><img alt="BrewLite Logo" class="h-7 w-auto object-contain" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDQQPSEeE0NKrtWlD36-6QGwv6hEZPy48XA96VPbaxMinQV8jWZBuC1LAROusExxXDS1G9N2mKgudlz7JwsSs3PecCz-63FvVMTFaDw8dqoQ50KkIqeiqZbVZg6vFE-D9GHUdlmOlo8O5cLdcz_2VEXPILux8BcbV1U0poKYzTcB6VnWaEPVOpsg39Ct1hCvgH_WsLFj_Cfh3PehWwwnV7h5NNZMaaAmmU0J8gXWRuPlsyYtUrXFAITFw"/><span class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">BrewLite</span></div><p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant max-w-sm leading-relaxed">Trải nghiệm cà phê thủ công tinh túy Việt Nam, đặt món nhanh chóng và thanh toán không tiền mặt an toàn.</p></div><div class="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Khám phá</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="ve-brewlite" href="#">Về BrewLite</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="thuc-don" href="#">Thực đơn</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="khuyen-mai" href="#">Khuyến mãi</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="huong-dan-dat-hang" href="#">Hướng dẫn đặt hàng</a></li></ul></div><div class="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Liên hệ &amp; import os

root_output_path = 'BREWLITE_PROJECT_FULL_EXPORT.md'

# Exclude patterns
exclude_dirs = {'.git', 'node_modules', '.next', 'dist', 'build', '.turbo', 'coverage', '.vscode', '.idea', '__pycache__'}
exclude_exts = {'.png', '.webp', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.pdf', '.docx', '.zip', '.gz', '.tar', '.log', '.exe', '.dll', '.map', '.tsbuildinfo', '.pyc'}
exclude_files = {'package-lock.json', '.env'}

def get_lang(path):
    filename = os.path.basename(path).lower()
    if filename == 'dockerfile':
        return 'dockerfile'
    if filename in ['.gitignore', '.dockerignore']:
        return 'text'
    if filename == '.prettierrc':
        return 'json'
    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()
    mapping = {
        '.ts': 'typescript',
        '.tsx': 'tsx',
        '.js': 'javascript',
        '.jsx': 'jsx',
        '.cjs': 'javascript',
        '.mjs': 'javascript',
        '.json': 'json',
        '.md': 'markdown',
        '.css': 'css',
        '.html': 'html',
        '.sql': 'sql',
        '.prisma': 'prisma',
        '.yml': 'yaml',
        '.yaml': 'yaml',
        '.puml': 'plantuml',
        '.sh': 'bash',
        '.ps1': 'powershell',
        '.svg': 'xml',
        '.txt': 'text',
        '.toml': 'toml',
        '.py': 'python',
        '.example': 'bash',
    }
    return mapping.get(ext, 'text')

def sort_key(p):
    # Root configs and main docs
    if p in ['README.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'TV4_CODE_GIAI_THICH.md', 'docker-compose.yml', 'package.json', '.env.example', '.gitignore']:
        order = ['README.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'TV4_CODE_GIAI_THICH.md', 'docker-compose.yml', 'package.json', '.env.example', '.gitignore']
        return (0, order.index(p) if p in order else 99, p)
    if p.startswith('docs/'):
        if '/' not in p[5:]:  # docs/*.md
            return (1, 0, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/requirements/'):
            return (1, 1, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/diagrams/'):
            return (1, 2, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/architecture/'):
            return (1, 3, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/assignment2/'):

        else:

    if p.startswith('backend/prisma/'):

        return (2, 2, p)

    if p.startswith('stitch/'):
        return (5, 0, p)

def make_anchor(index, path):
    clean = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]', '-', path).lower()
    return f'file-{index}-{clean}'

def get_max_consecutive_backticks(content):
    bt = chr(96)
    max_c = 0
    curr = 0
    for ch in content:
        if ch == bt:
            curr += 1
            if curr > max_c:
                max_c = curr
        else:
            curr = 0
    return max_c

def build_tree(path='.', prefix=''):
    entries = sorted(os.listdir(path))
    filtered = []
    for e in entries:
        if e in exclude_dirs or e in exclude_files:
            continue
        if 'FULL_EXPORT' in e:
            continue
        filtered.append(e)
    
    lines = []
    for i, entry in enumerate(filtered):
        is_last = (i == len(filtered) - 1)
        connector = '└── ' if is_last else '├── '
        full_path = os.path.join(path, entry)
        if os.path.isdir(full_path):
            lines.append(f'{prefix}{connector}{entry}/')
            sub_prefix = prefix + ('    ' if is_last else '│   ')
            lines.extend(build_tree(full_path, sub_prefix))
        else:
            lines.append(f'{prefix}{connector}{entry}')
    return lines

print('Collecting files...')

for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):

    out.write('   - **Luồng Thanh toán (POST /api/payments):** Kiểm tra Idempotency Key (`idempotencyKey`), khóa dòng đơn hàng (`row-level lock SELECT FOR UPDATE`), ghi nhận nhật ký `gatewayStatus`, cập nhật trạng thái đơn sang `PAID` nếu thành công, hoặc `PAYMENT_FAILED` nếu thất bại (kèm tự động hoàn lại tồn kho), hoặc giữ `PENDING` nếu trạng thái là `UNKNOWN`.\n')
    out.write('   - **Màn hình Barista KDS (Staff):** Đơn chuyển tuần tự: `PAID`/`PENDING` -> `PREPARING` -> `READY` -> `COMPLETED` (ghi nhận `completedAt`). Cho phép hủy đơn kèm lý do bắt buộc (1-300 ký tự) từ trạng thái hợp lệ, tự động hoàn trả tồn kho.\n\n')
    out.write('---\n\n')

    # Project Tree
    out.write('## 2. SƠ ĐỒ CÂY THƯ MỤC DỰ ÁN (PROJECT DIRECTORY TREE)\n\n')
    out.write('```text\n')
    out.write('Brewlite_swe_project1/\n')
    tree_lines = build_tree('.')
    for tl in tree_lines:
        out.write(f'{tl}\n')
    out.write('```\n\n')
    out.write('---\n\n')

    # Summary Statistics
    out.write('## 3. BẢNG THỐNG KÊ DỮ LIỆU XUẤT (EXPORT SUMMARY)\n\n')
    out.write(f'- **Tổng số tệp mã nguồn & tài liệu được xuất nguyên văn:** `{len(files_to_export)}` tệp\n')
    out.write(f'- **Tổng số dòng văn bản (Lines of Code/Docs):** `{stats["total_lines"]:,}` dòng\n')
    out.write(f'- **Tổng dung lượng văn bản:** `{stats["total_bytes"]:,}` bytes (~{stats["total_bytes"] / (1024 * 1024):.2f} MB)\n')
    out.write(f'- **Tổng số tài nguyên nhị phân được lập danh mục:** `{len(binary_files)}` tệp (mockup UI, hình ảnh, tài liệu docx)\n\n')
    out.write('### Phân bố theo ngôn ngữ & định dạng:\n\n')
    out.write('| Định dạng / Ngôn ngữ | Số lượng tệp |\n')
    out.write('| :--- | :--- |\n')
    for lang_name, count in sorted(stats['by_type'].items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
        out.write(f'| `{lang_name}` | {count} |\n')
    out.write('\n---\n\n')

    # Binary Assets Table
    out.write('## 4. DANH MỤC TÀI NGUYÊN NHỊ PHÂN (BINARY & MEDIA ASSETS)\n\n')
    out.write('> Ghi chú: Các tệp nhị phân (hình ảnh webp, png, tài liệu docx) không thể nhúng dưới dạng văn bản code block nhưng được lưu giữ đầy đủ tại vị trí đường dẫn tương ứng trong thư mục dự án:\n\n')
    out.write('| STT | Đường dẫn tệp | Dung lượng | Loại tài nguyên |\n')
    out.write('| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n')
    for idx, (b_path, b_size) in enumerate(binary_files, 1):
        b_ext = os.path.splitext(b_path)[1].lower()
        b_type = 'Ảnh chụp giao diện kiểm thử' if 'evidence' in b_path else ('Thiết kế giao diện Stitch UI Mockup' if 'stitch' in b_path else ('Hồ sơ tài liệu Word (DOCX)' if b_ext == '.docx' else 'Tài nguyên đồ họa hệ thống'))
        out.write(f'| {idx} | `{b_path}` | {b_size:,} bytes | {b_type} |\n')
    out.write('\n---\n\n')

    # Table of Contents
    out.write('## 5. MỤC LỤC CHI TIẾT TỪNG TỆP (TABLE OF CONTENTS)\n\n')
    out.write('| STT | Đường dẫn tệp | Dòng | Dung lượng | Ngôn ngữ | Liên kết |\n')
    out.write('| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n')
    for idx, meta in enumerate(file_meta, 1):
        anchor = make_anchor(idx, meta['path'])
        out.write(f'| {idx} | `{meta["path"]}` | {meta["lines"]:,} | {meta["size"]:,} B | `{meta["lang"]}` | [Xem nội dung](#{anchor}) |\n')
    out.write('\n---\n\n')

    # Verbatim File Contents
    out.write('## 6. TOÀN BỘ NỘI DUNG NGUYÊN VĂN TỪNG TỆP TRONG DỰ ÁN\n\n')

    for idx, meta in enumerate(file_meta, 1):
        path = meta['path']
        lang = meta['lang']
        content = meta['content']
        anchor = make_anchor(idx, path)
        max_bt = get_max_consecutive_backticks(content)
        fence_len = max(4, max_bt + 1)
        fence = chr(96) * fence_len

        out.write(f'<a id="{anchor}"></a>\n')
        out.write(f'{separator_line}\n')
        out.write(f'FILE #{idx}: {path}\n')
        out.write(f'Dung lượng: {meta["size"]:,} bytes | Tổng số dòng: {meta["lines"]:,} | Định dạng: {lang}\n')
        out.write(f'{separator_line}\n\n')
        out.write(f'{fence}{lang}\n')
        out.write(content)
        if not content.endswith('\n'):
            out.write('\n')
        out.write(f'{fence}\n\n')
        out.write(f'[↑ Trở lại Mục lục](#5-mục-lục-chi-tiết-từng-tệp-table-of-contents)\n\n')

print(f'Done writing to {output_path}!')

# Copy to root
shutil.copyfile(output_path, root_output_path)
print(f'Successfully copied full export to root: {root_output_path}!')
````

"""Smoke test the local Compose stack. Creates one disposable CUSTOMER account."""
import http.cookiejar
import json
import os
import secrets
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

BASE = os.getenv('BREWLITE_SMOKE_API', 'http://localhost:3001/api').rstrip('/')
if urllib.parse.urlparse(BASE).hostname not in {'localhost', '127.0.0.1'}:
    raise SystemExit('Smoke test chỉ chạy với API cục bộ')
ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000'

def client():
    jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
    return urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar)), jar

def call(opener, path, method='GET', body=None, origin=ORIGIN):
    headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    if method != 'GET' and origin is not None:
        headers['Origin'] = origin
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        BASE + path,
        data=json.dumps(body or {}).encode() if method != 'GET' else None,
        headers=headers,
        method=method,
    )
    try:
        with opener.open(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return error.code, json.load(error)

opener, _ = client()
status, products = call(opener, '/products')
assert status == 200 and products and 'stock' in products[0]
status, detail = call(opener, '/products/' + products[0]['id'])
assert status == 200 and len(detail['sizes']) == 3

email = 'smoke-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] + '@example.test'
password = 'A' + secrets.token_urlsafe(16) + '9'
customer, cookies = client()
assert call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test', 'email': email, 'password': password, 'role': 'BARISTA'})[0] == 400
assert call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test', 'email': 'bad', 'password': password})[0] == 400
status, registered = call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test Customer', 'email': email, 'password': password})
assert status == 201 and registered['user']['role'] == 'CUSTOMER'
assert 'accessToken' not in registered and 'passwordHash' not in registered['user']
assert len(list(cookies)) == 1 and list(cookies)[0].has_nonstandard_attr('HttpOnly')
old_cookie = list(cookies)[0].value
assert call(customer, '/auth/me')[0] == 200
assert call(customer, '/barista/dashboard')[0] == 403
assert call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test', 'email': email, 'password': password})[0] == 409
assert call(customer, '/auth/logout', 'POST')[0] == 201
assert call(customer, '/auth/me')[0] == 401
# A copied JWT must also fail after logout, even if a client ignores Set-Cookie deletion.
stale_request = urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/auth/me', headers={'Cookie': f'brewlite_session={old_cookie}'})
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen(stale_request, timeout=5)
    raise AssertionError('Old session was accepted after logout')
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    assert error.code == 401
assert call(customer, '/auth/login', 'POST', {'email': email, 'password': 'WrongPassword123'})[0] == 401
assert call(customer, '/auth/login', 'POST', {'email': email, 'password': password})[0] == 201
assert call(customer, '/auth/logout', 'POST', origin='https://other.example')[0] == 403

config = {}
for line in Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1].joinpath('.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
        key, value = line.split('=', 1)
        config[key] = value.strip('"')
if config.get('BARISTA_EMAIL') and config.get('BARISTA_PASSWORD'):
    staff, _ = client()
    status, login = call(staff, '/auth/login', 'POST', {'email': config['BARISTA_EMAIL'], 'password': config['BARISTA_PASSWORD']})
    assert status == 201 and login['user']['role'] == 'BARISTA'
    assert call(staff, '/barista/dashboard')[0] == 200
print('PASS: Products list/detail, auth validation/session/logout, CSRF, CUSTOMER 403, BARISTA 200')
